ST_BootFlow.ID_BOOTFLOW_TECH_TEST_WELCOME_BODY:
You’re about to experience ARC Raiders, in our second public Tech Test. 
The test kicks off on April 30 and will end on May 4, and just like the test that we ran last fall, its purpose is to evaluate the player experience across several areas — with a special emphasis on improvements and additions that have been made over the past six months. 
This time, we’re opening up access for players on consoles, in addition to PC. That also means we’ve added better and more robust support for gamepads, so feel free to try that out!
Results and the feedback from this test will be crucial for us, as we prepare for ARC Raiders’ full release later this year. As with any game in development, you may encounter issues; a huge thanks in advance for reporting issues or bugs that you may experience while playing.
This time around, you’re free to share or stream gameplay capture, and tell the world of your experience in ARC Raiders — in other words, the playtest is not confidential. 
By participating in this playtest, you will unlock an exclusive skin, available when you purchase the full game at launch. Just make sure to confirm your email address in Embark ID to get it.
For more info and troubleshooting, please head over to our Discord!

ST_CommunityEvents.ID_COMMUNITYEVENT_WINTER_POPUP_START_DES: As fierce snowfalls cover Topside in a frigid blanket, the inhabitants of Speranza gather together to salvage whatever warmth and community they can. The candleberry bush forms the centerpiece of these festivities, with Speranzans fashioning the hardy plant into a surprisingly lavish banquet.

ST_CommunityEvents.ID_COMMUNITYEVENT_WINTER_POPUP_START_DES: During the event, the Cold Snap map condition will allow you to gather rare Candleberries, which can be used to prepare your own Candleberry Banquet. However, the risk of frostbite means going topside is even more dangerous than usual.
ST_CommunityEvents.ID_COMMUNITYEVENT_WINTER_DESCRIPTION: Earn Merits by gathering rare Candleberries during the Cold Snap map condition, and use them to prepare your own Candleberry Banquet.

ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_PATIENTZERO: "I don't see the problem with eating surface plants, it's probably safe." - Timothy, patient zero for a new disease
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_SOUVENIR: "They clearly liked you and wanted a souvenir."
ST_EOR.QUOTE01: "Thought I hit the jackpot. Turns out, I was the jackpot." - Unlucky Dan
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_FRIEND_REQUEST_MESSAGE: A friend request will be sent to {0}
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_SAFEPOCKET: And that’s why you have a Safe Pocket. Backup loot.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_INSTYLE: At least you went out in style.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_DONTGIVEUP: Doesn’t matter if you’re beaten down, bruised, or bloodied. Raiders don’t give up.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_DUSTOFF: Dust yourself off, patch together a new gun, and get back out there.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_LEARNINGEXPERIENCE: Every failure is a learning experience.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_LANCESPECIALTY: Fixing up Raiders like you is Lance’s speciality.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_PRACTICEROUND: It’s fine. That was just a practice round.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_LUCKYSOCKS: Maybe you forgot your lucky socks in the wash?
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_RESILIENCE: Resilience pays off. Don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_UNDERDOG: The underdog always wins in the end. Keep going.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_COMEBACK: The universe is just setting you up for an epic comeback.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_VILLAINARC: This would be the perfect start to your villain arc.
ST_EOR.DEFEAT_INFO: You didn't make it back home this time, Raider!
ST_EOR.VICTORY_INFO: You made it back to Speranza!
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_STILLTOCOME: Your moment to shine is still to come.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_OPTIMISM: Your optimism in the face of empty pockets is your true superpower.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_CRED_NO_CREDS_NOTICE: You’ve reached the Cred limit. Spend Cred on Raider Deck rewards or Shani’s offers.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_CRED_PARTIAL_CREDS_NOTICE: You’ve received partial Creds because you’ve reached the Cred limit during the round.
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_CANTSMELLYOU: “ARC can’t smell you when you stand still. But they can still see you and shoot you, so...” - Old Man Ulysses
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_BREATHE: “Breathe. Let your body settle into a slower rhythm.” - Meditation Tape
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_STICKWITHIT: “I can’t tell you how many times I came crawling back home with empty pockets. The trick is to stick with it.” - Veteran Raider
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_SHORTCAREER: “If I gave up every time I got shot, I would have had a very short career.” - Veteran Raider
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_LAUNDRY: “If you have a child, don’t let them become a Raider. It is way too much laundry.” - Someone’s Mom
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_GOODFORBUSINESS: “Lots of Raider infighting going on. If nothing else, I guess it’s good for business.” - Tian Wen
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_SIXOUTOFTEN: “Out of my current clients, seven out of ten of them are still around. Oh. Make that six out of ten.” - Velvet Veracity, Raider Guru
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_SMOOTHRAIDS: “Smooth raids do not make skilled Raiders. But they do involve considerably fewer bullet holes.” - Celeste
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_ROLLAGAIN: “Sometimes the dice roll in your favor, and sometimes they don’t. Not much you can do besides roll them again.” - Bilguun
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_STATISTICALLY: “Statistically, street sweepers have a much lower chance of being shot in the face.” - Unemployed Former Raiders Association
ST_EOR.ID_EOR_DEATHQUOTE_ONEARM: “We experimented with using ARC parts as full plate armor. Took one magnetic explosive for us to realize that was a mistake.” - Olaf One-Arm (formerly just Olaf)

ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_RIVENTIDES_HATCH2_DE: A last-ditch escape for many a Raider set upon by the riverbed.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_BLUEGATE_CONSTRUCTIO: A surprising amount of boreholes already ran deep into the earth here, making this hatch a breeze to construct.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_MOUNTAINCOMPOUND_SEE: After all this time, this marvel of indoor climate control still whirrs away undisturbed.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_BLUEGATE_WRECKAGEHAT: After one glance at the surroundings, the foreman building this hatch made sure to use reinforced steel and extra-sturdy latches.
ST_ExtractionPoints.BURIEDCITY_COLLAPSEDSTORE_DESC: An adapted sewer entrance near a collapsed supermarket. All wares are on deep discount.
ST_ExtractionPoints.BURIEDCITY_TRAINSTATION_DESC: An old access hatch near the train station. Last stop.
ST_ExtractionPoints.DAM_REDLAKEBALCONY_DESC: At the bottom of this elevator shaft, a rare type of fungi thrives on the metal-rich mud.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_RIVENTIDES_ELEVATOR1: Built in convenient proximity to the nearby cranes, some speculate it may have have tempted a crane operator or two.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_BLUEGATE_VILLAGEHATC: Built on top of an old well, the engineers building this hatch now share an impressive collection of ancient coins.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_BURIEDCITY_EASTERN_S: Centro Storico used to be the old town metro station. It's not very charming, but to be fair, it probably never was.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_RIVENTIDES_ELEVATOR2: For transporting heavy-weight goods, and even heavier stacks of paperwork.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_MOUNTAINCOMPOUND_HAT: Given its proximity to the sandbox, tube engineers recommend that you brush the dirt and grass off your shoes before entering this hatch.
ST_ExtractionPoints.DAM_PUMPHOUSE_DESC: If you suffer from claustrophobia and fear of drowning, consider using a different hatch.
ST_ExtractionPoints.SPACEPORT_DEPARTURE_DESC: Lance was once trapped within this tunnel for an entire month due to a massive cave-in.
ST_ExtractionPoints.DAM_LAINES_DESC: Nasty water from the swamp perpetually fills the tunnel below this hatch so make sure the pumps are running.
ST_ExtractionPoints.DAM_TRALICCIO_DESC: On first inspection, this seemed just like any old hatch – rusted hinges, cool to the touch. Who would have thought it was someone's home?
ST_ExtractionPoints.BURIEDCITY_OLDTOWN_DESC: Pretty sure there was a nice cafe around here somewhere.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_MOUNTAINCOMPOUND_HAT: Rusted mechanical arms loom like giants above this hatch.
ST_ExtractionPoints.DAM_NORTHCOMPLEX_DESC: Sections of these tunnels exhibit a curious phenomenon where magnetic anomalies cause compasses to misbehave.
ST_ExtractionPoints.SPACEPORT_CONTROL_DESC: Some walls in this tunnel show intricate patterns formed by the slow cooling of volcanic rock.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_RIVENTIDES_HATCH3_DE: Some who've used this hatch claim to hear the gunshots emanating from Buried City.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_MOUNTAINCOMPOUND_LOB: Swanky and comfortable, the walkways around this station feel like a meticulously curated experience.
ST_ExtractionPoints.SPACEPORT_TRENCH_EAST_DESC: Taking this path back to Speranza you have to go right through the dreaded Caverna Ignis, so don't linger.
ST_ExtractionPoints.SPACEPORT_EAST_DESC: The East Elevator was the first to connect Speranza to Acerra Spaceport.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_BURIEDCITY_WESTERN_S: The Municipio metro station is closest to the sea. Water erodes its train tunnels and they require constant maintenance.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_BURIEDCITY_NORTHERN_: The Nuovo Distretto station is the best preserved of the old metro stations.
ST_ExtractionPoints.SPACEPORT_CENTRAL_DESC: The acoustics in this shaft create unique echoing effects. Sometimes it sounds as if the walls are whispering.
ST_ExtractionPoints.SPACEPORT_WEST_DESC: The air down here is thick and eye-watering. It carries the heavy, unmistakable scent of stale kerosene and rust.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_BLUEGATE_OLIVEGROVEH: The aromas drifting from the nearby olive grove makes this a particularly pleasant descent.
ST_ExtractionPoints.DAM_SWAMPLIFT_DESC: The decomposing organic material from the swamp seeps into these tunnels and create pockets of dangerous gases.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_CLIFFSIDE_AIRSHAFT_D: The engineers who connected this airshaft found it adorned with colorful chalk paintings from a nearby kindergarten.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_RIVENTIDES_HATCH1_DE: The hinges creak under the weight of salt corrosion and seagull abuse.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_OVERLOOK_AIRSHAFT_DE: The panoramic view from atop the hill makes up for the faint smell of bat droppings and stale grease.
ST_ExtractionPoints.BURIEDCITY_OVERPASS_DESC: The traffic jams are absolutely ridiculous this time of year.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_RED_LAKES_HATCH_DESC: The tunnels in this area are almost impossible to keep open. The red, contaminated water pose a constant challenge.
ST_ExtractionPoints.DAM_SPILLWAY_DESC: The tunnels in this area are almost impossible to keep open. Tremors and underground streams pose a constant challenge.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_FOREST_AIRSHAFT_DESC: This airshaft is often clogged with fallen leaves, making for an escape that is as slippery as it is autumnal.
ST_ExtractionPoints.SPACEPORT_SOUTH_DESC: This is one of Speranza's best maintained elevators - but it is also one of the least deteriorated.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_MOUNTAINCOMPOUND_HAT: This lonely hatch sits hidden in the tunnels beneath the cultural archives.
ST_ExtractionPoints.SPACEPORT_TRENCH_WEST_DESC: This part of the trench tunnels was partially cleared only a few months back. Watch your head!
ST_ExtractionPoints.DAM_OLDBARON_DESC: This tunnel runs past an underground cistern filled to the brim with red, iron-rich sludge.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_BURIEDCITY_SOUTHERN_: This used to be the Salini metro station. Shifting sands and seismic activity has collapsed most of it.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_MOUNTAINCOMPOUND_LOA: Tucked away deep inside the facility, the doors in this station creak and squeak from disuse.
ST_ExtractionPoints.SPACEPORT_NORTH_DESC: When the North Elevator shaft was cleared, the diggers discovered dozens of trapped, disoriented first-generation ARC drones.
ST_ExtractionPoints.ID_EXTRACTIONPOINTS_HANGAR_AIRSHAFT_DESC: When this airshaft was connected to the Tubes, Apollo's crew spent several days clearing out packing peanuts and bubble wrap.
ST_ExtractionPoints.DAM_SWAMPSIDE_DESC: You'd think this elevator would win the "worst smell" category by a landslide, but the competition is surprisingly strong.

ST_GameModeLocations.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_MOUNTAINCOMPOUND: A secluded research facility amidst snow-draped peaks, Stella Montis is said to have been the last bulwark of humanity's preservation.
ST_GameModeLocations.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_SPACEPORT: Acerra Spaceport is a majestic testament to humanity's past ambitions. This is where the Exodus shuttles, vessels of hope and desperation, once roared into the heavens, leaving a beleaguered Earth behind.
ST_GameModeLocations.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_WATERTREATMENTFACIL: Alcantara Power Plant, or "The Dam", stands as a silent sentinel amidst a toxic, waterlogged land, nourishing a riot of resilient vegetation and fauna. A monument echoing with the memories of power once generated.
ST_GameModeLocations.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_BURIEDCITY: Amidst the sand dunes in this arid wasteland you will find a remnant of the old world quite unlike the cold steel spires of the Exodus age. Walk these narrow streets and empty plazas, and know that people once lived here.
ST_GameModeLocations.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_PRACTICERANGE: Nestled in a secluded mountain hollow, the echoed gunshots from this practice range seem to confuse ARC's sense of direction, creating a rare pocket of open-air safety. Raiders use the Backyard to hone their skills, and catch up on some long-overdue stargazing.
ST_GameModeLocations.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_THEBLUEGATE: Once a steadfast symbol of defiant connection, the Blue Gate now serves as a daunting entryway into the perilous mountain ranges. The surrounding valley bears scars both new and old.

ST_Inbox.ID_INBOX_MESSAGE_CHARGEBACK_PROCESSED_BO: After a thorough investigation, we identified that one or more purchases on your account were made with an invalid or unauthorized payment method. If you have any questions or concerns, our Player Support team is always here to help.

ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_ADHESIVE: A concerning amount of things in Speranza are held together with "spit and glue" according to Apollo.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_MUZZLECOMPONENTS: A crucial component for crafting muzzles for your weapons.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_ELECTRICALCOMPONENTS: A handy pile of fuses, cable spools, resistors, and other similar items.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_ANTISEPTIC: A key ingredient for making Vita.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_ALIENDUCK: A long, long way from home.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_BOATMODEL_C_PLACEHOL: A majestic sight in any era, this fierce merchant ship is indifferent to the aerodynamic benefits of fiberglass technology.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_PLASTICSPINNER: A miniature dynamo of unparalleled efficiency, far beyond our comprehension. Must have powered great machines.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_AGAVE: A piece of an agave leaf. Can be used to regain a small amount of health.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_TUBEBRUSH: A reliable tool for removing rust from narrow spaces.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_RIPPEDSAFETYVEST: A remnant of a time long lost, when it was fashionable to stand out.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_SILVER_TEASPOON_SET: A shining, shimmering set of refinement and elegance.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_FADEDPHOTOGRAPH: A snapshot of the world before, faded by sunlight and time.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_BOATMODEL_B_PLACEHOL: A spirited up-and-comer, this two-master has been known to sail ever so slightly beyond the horizon.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_REFINEDPOLYMER: A staple of the old world, for better or worse.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_APRICOT: A sun ripe apricot. Can be consumed for a small amount of stamina.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_BOOM_PART: A throwable ARC part that triggers after a short time, sending an explosive straight down.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_DUCTTAPE: A trusted solution to all of life's little emergencies. Sometimes the big ones too.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_CANDLEBERRIES: A waxy berry that grows only during a small window each year. People have depended on them to make candles, foods and medicine for ages.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_DOGCOLLAR: After all this time, you can still smell the goodness.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_BURNTOUTCANDLES: After the grid fell candles became the preferred source of light for many. Unlike electricity, a good old candle will never fail you. Unless it's windy. Or raining. Or...
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_RUBBERDUCK: Always there to lend an ear, should you need it.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_ENERGYAMMO: Ammo used for energy weapons. One clip will fully charge a single weapon.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_REFINEDRUBBER: An elastic sheet of synthetic rubber.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_EXPIRED_SECURITYCODE: An expired security code. Has no more practical use.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_LEAKYCANISTER: An old, corroded canister containing some presumably hazardous liquid.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_LAUNCHERAMMO: Anti-ARC payloads used mainly by the Hullcracker.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_MECHANICALCOMPONENTS: Assorted metal hardware, bound to have some kind of use.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_LIGHTGUNPARTS: Assorted spare parts used for pistols and SMGs.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_MEDIUMGUNPARTS: Assorted spare parts used for rifles.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_HEAVYGUNPARTS: Assorted spare parts used to improve handcannons and snipers.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_CAT_BED: At least a tiny bit more comfortable than your face.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_BROKENBATON: Bent and broken, this baton looks more like an art project than a weapon.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_LEMON: Can be consumed for a small amount of stamina.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_OLIVES: Can be consumed for a small amount of stamina.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_PRICKLYPEAR: Can be consumed for a small amount of stamina.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_MUSHROOM: Can be consumed to regain a small amount of health.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENTATIONS: Can be equipped to gain more loadout space and carry capacity. Allows you to equip better shields as well.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_PLANTSANDSEEDS: Can be found in the wild or grown in your chambers.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_JUNK: Can be refined into more useful material.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_RESIN: Can be used to gradually restore a small amount of health over time.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_MOSS: Can be used to regain a small amount of health.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_AIRFRESHENER: Contains hints of pine, lavender, and traffic jam-induced despair.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_RUSTREMOVER: Dissolves rust without damaging the affected object too much in the process.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_DOODLYDUCK: Everything is a canvas to a creative child.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_TORCHGINGERSEEDS: For optimal growth, plant these in a garden exposed to partial shade. Or just somewhere in your chambers.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_CLEANWATER: Fresh water. A sight for sore eyes in this day and age.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_MAGNET: Fun thing to put on a fridgerator.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_HEAVYAMMO: Heavy bullets used mainly with sniper rifles and hand cannons.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_BENTCLOTHESHANGER: If you encounter a matching set, consider yourself lucky.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_POSTER_NATURAL_WONDERS: If you stand close and squint your eyes, it's like the world never came crumbling down.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_SCRATCHEDSUNGLASSES: Impossible to see through, but walking into things never looked so good.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_ICECREAMSCOOPER: It is theorized that scooping things was a favorite pastime in the world before.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_TROPICALDUCK: It quietly dreams of taking to the skies with its brethren.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_GARLICPRESS: It'll press garlic, olives, and probably many other things.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_DEFLATEDFOOTBALL: Just by looking at this, you too start to feel slightly deflated.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_TORCHGINGER: Lance grows these in the Med Bay. He also talks tenderly to them in the evenings.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_LANCESMIXTAPE5THEDITION: Lance has personally planted a number of these around the Rust Belt, for some reason.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_BUNKER_KEY_IN_STOCK: Lets you purchase more Outskirts Bunker Keys from Tian Wen.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_LIGHTAMMO: Light bullets used mainly with SMGs and light handguns.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_FLASHYDUCK: Lovingly hand-painted by someone of great talent—clearly. Any guesses who?
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_MEDIUMAMMO: Medium bullets used with some assault rifles and battle rifles.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_METALFILE: Not in the best shape, but still useful for smoothing out rough edges.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_OLDCIRCUITBOARD: Once considered state-of-the-art technology, now its only worth lies in the materials you can salvage from it.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_BOATMODEL_D_PLACEHOL: Optimized for performance, this marvel of technology sure hopes you weren't planning on packing a particularly elaborate lunch.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_MUSIC_ALBUM: Perfect for relaxing nights at home, casual get-togethers, and private air guitar concerts.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_FINE_WRISTWATCH: Perfect for telling the time, and showcasing that you're an exceedingly dignified person.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_SURGICALNEEDLE: Probably the cleanest thing within a 100-mile radius.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_REFINEDMATERIAL: Processed material ready to be used or converted into crafting components.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_SCARYWOODENDOLL: Raiders like to prank each other by leaving these in dimly-lit places.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_TRANSPONDER: Receives and emits signals. It's in pretty rough shape, but still functional.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_BLOWNFUSES: Scorched and useless. The burnt metal smells faintly like Apollo's workshop.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_ALUMINUMPLATES: Shiny. You can almost see your own reflection on the surface.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_SCRAPMETAL: So many things in the old world were constructed out of metal.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_DART_BOARD: Some Raiders use it to practice dexterity. Others just like throwing things at other things.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_BLOATEDTUNACAN: Something tells you that you don't want to open this...
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_INDUSTRIALBATTERY: Speranza gets most of its power from a large, repaired solar grid system above ground and relies on batteries to supply the rest.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_PLAYINGCARDS: Speranzans love to see who can build the tallest tower - before the tremors knock them down.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_INDUSTRIALMAGNET: Surprisingly strong. Fortunately, it has a release mechanism so you can carry it safely in your pack.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_SIMPLEGRENADECASINGS: Take them to the Tinkering Bench and pour something into them.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_SECURITYCODE: Temporary security code to unlock the main gate.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_SECURITYCODE_ALT2:
Temporary security code to unlock the main gate.

Will expire upon returning to Speranza.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_VERY_COMFORTABLE_PILLOW: The envy of every Raider. Like sleeping on an especially ergonomic cloud.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_SNOWGLOBES: The envy of every Speranzan. Proof that this world was once thriving and magical.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_EXPIREDRESPIRATOR: The filters are clogged with sand and noxious fumes. Long past its lifespan.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_GUNPOWDER: The first step towards crafting some bullets.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_FIREBALLBURNER: The nasty, but useful, part of the Fireball's innards.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_COFFEEPOT: The power to face a new day, one drip at a time.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_BROKENACCORDION: The torn bellows are sadder than any song one could have played on this instrument.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_FOODWRAPPER: The vibrant colors and natural stickiness have made them a favorite among the more artistic Speranzans.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_SPEAKER: There are speakers in all common areas as part of the Speranza-wide PA system. Some of them have been repurposed into playing music between announcements, a welcome respite for those who gather in these areas.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_TORNLACETABLECLOTH: There's craftsmanship in every stitch, long lost to time.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_HUSKLILY: These beautiful, but toxic flowers only grow around Baron husks. As for why, your guess is as good as anyone's.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_SENSORS: These have a wide range of uses.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_OILSHROOM: These mushrooms thrive on a wide range of pollutants: oil spills, heavy metals, pesticides, you name it! It goes without saying that you shouldn't eat them.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_OLDBATTERIES: They used to power meaningful things, but those days are long gone.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_RAIDERHATCHKEY: This could be your ticket back home, if you can find a place to use it at.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_BROKENPARACHUTE: Torn and mangled beyond repair. Seems like someone had a rough landing.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_BOATMODEL_A_PLACEHOL: Undaunted in the face of its larger brethren, this nimble one-master has been known to brave even the most just-above-average of waves.
ST_ItemDescriptions.ID_ITEMDESC_FAMILIARDUCK: Unlike the real one, this one fits in your pack.

ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_AUGMENTESSENTIAL: An Augment is just as essential as shoes when you're going topside.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDERCAUTION1: Assume the best, prepare for the worst.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREENTIPS_FIELDCRATES: Deliver field crates to Field Depots to earn useful resources.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_BARRICADEREPACK: Deployables, such as barricade kits, can be re-packed and re-used.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_SCAVENGEDRONES: Destroyed ARC enemies can be scavenged for valuable resources.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_SAFEPOCKET: Don't ask me how the safe pocket works. You're not ready for that knowledge.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDER: Every Raider has their own reason for going out there. But at the end of the day, we all return to the same place.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARCTHRUSTERS: Flying ARC drones rely on their thrusters to stay in the air.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_HURT: Have you tried NOT getting hurt?
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDERCAUTION4: I've treated many, many injuries. Not all of them were caused by ARC.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_DODGEROLL: If you find yourself falling, you can sometimes save your ankles and your dignity by rolling as you land.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_SAFEPOCKETPROTECTION: Items stored in a Safe Pocket will not be lost if you're knocked out.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARMORUPGRADET1: Light Shields can be modded from Upgrade Tier 1.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_LOCKEDDOORS: Locked doors often guard the most valuable of treasures.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_EMOTEWHEEL: Many a tense situation has been deescalated with the Emote Wheel.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARMORUPGRADET2: Medium and Heavy Shields can be modded from Upgrade Tier 2.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARMORWEIGHT: Medium and Heavy Shields protect you at the cost of slowing you down.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_OPENSPACES: Open spaces are often littered with downed Raiders.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_CONTAINERITEMS: Ping items in containers to let your squad know what you've found.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_QUESTS: Ping quests to let your squad know what you're trying to accomplish.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_TRACKEDITEMS: Ping tracked items to let your squad know what you're looking for.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_HATCH: Raider Hatches get you home quickly and discreetly - so long as you have a key.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_HIDDENLOOT: Raiders often discard old gear when they find something better - but one person's trash is another one's treasure.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ENERGYAMMO: Reloading a partially loaded energy weapon will consume the entire energy clip.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_REQUESTAMMO: Request ammo by pinging an equipped weapon.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_REQUESTWEAPON: Request weapons by pinging an empty weapon slot.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_TRADERRUN: Running low on weapons? Use a Free Loadout on your next run.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RECYCLE: Short on basic materials? Recycle spare items!
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDERCAUTION3: Smoke grenades let you vanish from uneasy standoffs.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARCPLATING: Some ARC enemies have heavy duty plating. You'll need the right gun to pierce through it.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_USABLEARCPARTS: Some lootable ARC parts have a secondary use.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_SCAVENGE: Sometimes the best stuff can be found in the most unassuming of places.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RECOIL: Stray bullets are often a sign of a trigger held too long.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PINGBUTTON: The Ping Wheel lets you point out dangers and destinations to your Squad.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ELEVATORSHUTDOWN: The longer you stay topside, the fewer ways back remain.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_DONTSHOOT: The sound of gunfire can attract ARC to your location.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_MULTIPLESOLUTIONS: There are many problems that bullets can't solve - or so I've learned.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_MATRIARCHSOLO: There's brave, there's stupid, and then there's "I'm gonna take on a Matriarch alone." Guess which one's extinct.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PREPARED: There's no such thing as being too prepared.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_EVERYSHOTMATTERS: Think first, shoot later. Or was it the other way around?
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_TRACKING: Tracking crafting blueprints or quests can help you bring back the right loot.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDERCAUTION2: Trust your gut when encountering fellow Raiders.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ARMORBENCH: Use the Gear Bench to upgrade your Shields.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_FREERESOURCES: Visit Scrappy in your Workshop to claim free resources.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_MATRIARCHBASTIONS: We were quite sure it couldn't get any worse - but then the Matriarch called in her Bastions.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_RAIDERCAUTION5: Words of peace are more convincing with a gun to back them up.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREENTOOLTIPS_PRACTICERANGE: You can bring your new weapons to the Practice Range to try them out.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_PING_AUDIBLEBARKS: You can toggle whether pings can be heard by any nearby Raider, or only by your squad.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_WEAPONBENCH: You can upgrade your weapons from your Inventory.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREENTIPS_UNARMED: You move and vault faster when your weapon is stowed.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_ACCURACY: You're more accurate when standing still - and your duels look far more impressive.
ST_LoadingScreenTips.ID_LOADINGSCREEN_WEAPONREPAIR: Your weapon's durability degrades with use. Be sure to repair it before it breaks.

ST_Location_RivenTides.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_RIVENTIDES: A twice-abandoned coastal paradise, this magnificent harbor resort holds memories of both grand ambitions and reluctant retreat. Yet for all the upheaval this place has known, the ocean looks much the same.

ST_Lonewolf.ID_LONE_WOLF_TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION: Face off against squads as a solo Raider. Unlocked at level {0}.
ST_Lonewolf.ID_LONE_WOLF_ONBOARDING_DESCRIPTION: You are now able to take on squads as a solo Raider.
ST_Lonewolf.ID_LONE_WOLF_DISABLED_TOOLTIP_COMBO: You can only play Solo vs. Squads when you’re not in a party and Fill Squad is turned off.
ST_Lonewolf.ID_LONE_WOLF_DISABLED_TOOLTIP_FILL_SQUAD: You can't play Solo vs. Squads while Fill Squad is turned on.
ST_Lonewolf.ID_LONE_WOLF_DISABLED_TOOLTIP_PARTY: You can't play Solo vs. Squads while you are in a party.

ST_ManifestUpdate.ID_MANIFEST_UPDATE_MESSAGE: A game update is available. Get it now?
ST_ManifestUpdate.ID_MANIFEST_UPDATE_GAME_UPDATE_TOOLTIP: A new game update is available. Restart your game to proceed.
ST_ManifestUpdate.ID_MANIFEST_UPDATE_CLIENT_UPDATE_TOOLTIP: Someone in your party is on an older version of the game. They need to restart their game for you to proceed.
ST_ManifestUpdate.ID_MANIFEST_UPDATE_MESSAGE_ALT2: There is a new required update available for your game. Restart your game to download the required update.
ST_ManifestUpdate.ID_MANIFEST_UPDATE_CLIENT_UPDATE_MESSAGE: There is a new update available for your game. Restart your game to download the latest update.

ST_Map.ID_TOOLTIP_THREAT_HIGH_FLAVOR: A contested hotspot fought over by daring Raiders.
ST_Map.ID_TOOLTIP_THREAT_LOW_FLAVOR: A fallback option for more risk-averse Raiders.
ST_Map.ID_TOOLTIP_THREAT_MEDIUM_FLAVOR: A go-to destination for many Raiders.
ST_Map.ID_MARKER_EXTRACTION_LOCKED_RETURN_POINT: This return point is currently out of order, though a fallback system is expected to eventually restore access.
ST_Map.ID_MARKER_EXTRACTION_BROKEN_RETURN_POINT: This return point is experiencing a mechancal failure. A skillful Raider may be able to repair it with the right materials.
ST_Map.ID_TOOLTIP_THREAT_UNKNOWN_FLAVOR: We have no intel on what’s out here. Proceed with caution.

ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_SPEARMINT_DESC: A Matriarch has been sighted nearby. Her children seem hell-bent on keeping her from harm.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_LOCKED_GATE_DESC: A clandestine group has activated the Gate's emergency shutdown protocol. 4 key cards need to be obtained to override it, and uncover whatever they're hiding.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_FROSTBITE_DESC: A cold front has swept in with snowfall, and a considerable drop in temperature. The air might feel crisp and brisk at first, but beware of frostbite. Candleberry bushes are bearing valuable fruit - they are now ripe for the picking.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_PEPPERMINT_DESC: A mysterious harvesting machine has appeared, heavily guarded by the feared Queen. What kind of riches are to be found within?
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_HEAT_WAVE_DESC: A scorching sun has been beating down on everything and everyone, making it exhausting just to get around. Stay in the shadows if you can.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_REPAIREXTRACTIONS_DESCAL: A widespread mechanical failure has shut down every return point to Speranza. Raiders must repair them to find their way back home.
A widespread mechanical failure has shut down every return point to Speranza. Raiders must repair them to secure a way home, or hold out long enough for a fallback system to engage.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_PROBE_HEIST_DESC: ARC seem to have entered a period of extended probing, sending guarded probes down en masse.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_ACID_RAIN_DESC: An especially sour rain corrodes everything on the surface, harming any Raider caught outdoors.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_BULLETPOINT_DECREASEDOVE: Decreased amount of overall loot value
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_BIRD_CITY_DESC: Flocks of birds have been spotted around Buried City, gathering around chimneys for what many assume to be nefarious reasons.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_TOXIC_SWAMP_CLEANAIR_DES: Geothermal fissures beneath the swamp are releasing toxic gases, requiring Raiders to activate Air Purifier antennas around the Hydroponic Domes.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_TOXIC_SWAMP_THERMALROCKS: Geothermal fissures have erupted beneath the swamp, allowing Raiders to collect rare Thermal Rocks amidst the toxic gases.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_TOXIC_SWAMP_DESC: Geothermal fissures have erupted beneath the swamp, releasing both toxic gases and rare natural resources.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_EXTRACTOR_DESC: Groups of surveyors and vaporizers are scanning for valuable materials. Their discoveries could prove worthwhile, if you’re prepared for resistance.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_BULLETPOINT_INCREASEDCRA: Increased amount of crashed ARC Couriers
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_ELECTROMAGNETIC_STORM_DE: Lightning strikes batter the surface; frying electronics, disrupting ARC machines, and electrocuting unsuspecting Raiders.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_REPAIREXTRACTIONS_DESC: Most Return Points have broken down, and will need to be repaired before they can be used.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_THE_QUEENS_DESC: Multiple Queens have been spotted in the area, though no Harvester seems to be anywhere nearby.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_BULLETPOINT_ONERETURNPOI: One Return Point unlocks after some time
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_NIGHTRAID_DESC: Raiders have been finding especially good loot behind locked doors, and keys have been more plentiful. The heightened Raider activity has attracted more ARC than usual.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_BULLETPOINT_ALLRETURNPOI: Return Points unlock after some time
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_BURIED_TREASURE_DESC: Scouts have discovered a variety of trinkets and small finds buried in the sands around Riven Tides, along with a few less welcome things. Raiders are encouraged to use a Dockmaster’s Detector to uncover them.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_HIDDENBUNKER_DESC: Someone has hacked the Outskirts Bunker's security system. Find the 4 buttons to unlock the doors, and be the first to plunder the treasure within.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_TOWER_DEFENCE_DESC: Someone has locked off the Launch Tower, hiding all their hard-earned loot at the top. ARC seems to have ramped up their defenses in response to the heightened activity.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_HUSKUS_POCUS_DESC: Something has caused ARC machines to go down on their own in great amounts, leaving husks scattered around Topside. A better opportunity to gather information and parts has rarely presented itself.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_CACHE_THEM_ALL_DESC: Storms have unearthed a number of old Raider Caches, but they are rigged to explode should they be exposed for too long. Hurry up and find them all.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_WINDSTORM_DESCALT1: Strong winds are sweeping across the surface, affecting large parts of the area. The situation is less predictable than usual, so stay alert.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_WINDSTORM_DESC: Strong winds are sweeping across the surface, affecting large parts of the area. Visibility and hearing may be reduced, so stay alert.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_EXTRACTOR_DESC_ALT: Surveyors and heavy backup are scanning for valuable materials. Their discoveries could prove worthwhile, if you’re prepared for resistance.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_BURIED_TREASURE_DESCALT1: The sands of Riven Tides conceal lost trinkets, forgotten valuables, and a few unpleasant surprises. Raiders looking for either will need a Dockmaster’s Detector.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_TIMEOUT_MESSAGE: The selected destination is no longer available.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_TIMEOUT_MESSAGE_ALT: The selected destination is no longer available. Would you like to change your destination?
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_HARVEST_SEASON_DESC: The weather has been unusually agreeable lately, and vital plants and fruits have been thriving. Get out there and gather your food before it is all gone.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_BIRD_CITY_DESCALT2: Unusual bird activity has been reported around Buried City. Raiders are encouraged to investigate.
ST_MapCondition.ID_MAPCONDITION_BIRD_CITY_DESCALT1: Unusual bird activity has been reported around the chimneys on Buried City’s rooftops. Raiders who investigate may find valuable materials in their nests.

ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_WATERTREATMENT: A concrete monolith of pipes, tubes, and old water treatment equipment.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_HYDRODOMES: A field scattered with glass domes that were once used for plant cultivation.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_SPACEPORT_ROCKETASSEMBLY: A graveyard of rocket parts that never made it to space.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_ADORNEDWRECKAGE: A graveyard of wreckage that was already here before any Speranzans arrived.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_TESTINGANNEX: A half-drowned testing center overlooking the red lakes.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_AUDITORIUM: A large, hard to access viewing area where private meetings were likely hosted.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_HOTEL: A particularly lavish harbor resort, said to have hosted all of the Exodus' most distinguished supporters and financiers.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_ELECTRICALSUBSTATION: A rocky basin full of old power generators.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_POWERGENERATIONCOMPLEX: A rusting relic of hydrogen infrastructure.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_HOTELBEACH: A secluded stretch of once-pristine beachfront.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_LOWERVILLAGE: A village from long before the sprawling astro-infrastructure took over the land.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_WRECKAGES: Ages of violent undercurrents and biting rust have taken a visible toll.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_RESEARCHBUILDING: An abandoned research building in central Marano. The labs are empty, dusty equipment still lined up as if someone might return at any moment.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_COMMSTOWER: An antenna that has been seemingly transformed by traveling pilgrims.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_SEEDVAULTINTERIO: An icy vault that looks like it was once meant to ensure the future of food cultivation.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_OLDBATTLEGROUND: An old First Wave battleground where lopsided forts and wrecked ARC parts still remain.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_ROBOTICSANDBOXA: An old vehicle testing facility. It’s unclear what kind of terrain they were being created for.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_CULTURALARCHIVES: An underground storage unit of humanity’s premier works of art and literature.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_PARKINGGARAGE: Car husks, stashed loot, and plenty of dark corners litter the Marano Parking Garage.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_GALLERIA: Even after 200 years of disuse, the dilapidated Galleria still holds items of value.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_CAFETERIA: Few traces of humanity are left in this strangely empty cafeteria.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_MEDICALWINGNORTH: It seems that advanced medical research was being conducted here, far beyond what Raiders have encountered in other old medical bays.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_CONTROLLEDACCESSZONE: Ivy and rusting ARC husks are all that’s seemingly left of this underground power station
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_CONTAINERYARD: Just a glimpse of these sky-scraping containers makes one want to stack things very high.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_CONTROLTOWER: Located above the Admin building. An excellent vantage point for looking out over the battlegrounds.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_WAVEBREAKERCOMPOUN: Once the beating heart of all maritime operations, it allows for dilligent surveillance of the port in every direction.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_CHECKPOINT: Piles and piles of abandoned vehicles sit outside the gates, forever waiting to be let in.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_RAIDERREFUGE: Raiders are trying to make this outpost their own. The ARC are making that difficult.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_ANCIENTFORT: Ruins of a fort from before the Collapse.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_WAREHOUSECOMPLEX: Rumor has it that there's more than just rats running through this old Supracosta warehouse.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_SPACEPORT_CONTROLTOWERB6: Shorter than the Launch Towers, but still a decent view of the grounds.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_LOGISTICS: Signage indicates that some of the Exodus' valuable goods once passed right through this complex.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_STELLAMONTIS_ASSEMBLYWORKSHOP: Some experimental technology was being explored on these high-tech assembly lines.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_SPACEPORT_VEHICLEMAINTENANCE: The Spaceport’s many buses and cargo trucks used to come here for a tune-up.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_DAM_RESEARCHADMIN: The abandoned administrative building for the Enelica corporation.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_MARANOPARK: The densely overgrown city park of Marano.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_SPACEPORT_DEPARTUREBUILDING: The former Avantale security gate for passengers headed to the Launch Towers.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_GRANDIOSOAPARTMENT: The former residences of workers from the Alcantara Dam.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_SPACEPORT_ARRIVALBUILDING: The ransacked reception building for aspiring space travelers.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_SPACETRAVEL: The satellite dishes of the old space travel building are frozen mid-tilt, still aimed at skies they no longer listen to.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_TOWNHALL: The seat of government in Marano, before the Collapse.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BLUEGATE_ABANDONEDHOUSINGPROJ: This architectural project stands abandoned, unfinished and untouched.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_CHURCHRUINS: This home for devout parishioners has been abandoned for years.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_BURIEDCITY_HOSPITAL: This run-down hospital once served as the only source of medical aid in the greater Marano area.
ST_MapLocationsDesc.ID_TOOLTIP_RIVENTIDES_CHECKPOINT: With scales embedded into the road's surface, this must've been about as elegant as a checkpoint gets.

ST_MapSelection.ID_MAPSELECTION_SPACEPORT_DESCRIPTION: Acerra Spaceport is a majestic testament to humanity's past ambitions. This is where the Exodus shuttles, vessels of hope and desperation, once roared into the heavens, leaving a beleaguered Earth behind.
ST_MapSelection.ID_MAPSELECTION_DAM_DESCRIPTION: Alcantara Power Plant, or "The Dam", once served as a crucial Raider stronghold during the bitter closing battles of the First Wave. Even now, these toxic, waterlogged lands remain a hotspot for ARC skirmishes.
ST_MapSelection.ID_MAPSELECTION_BURIEDCITY_DESCRIPTION: Amidst the sand dunes in this arid wasteland you will find a remnant of the old world quite unlike the cold steel spires of the Exodus age. Walk these narrow streets and empty plazas, and know that people once lived here.
ST_MapSelection.ID_MAPSELECTION_PRACTICERANGE_DESCRIPTIO: Nestled in a secluded mountain hollow, the echoed gunshots from this practice range seem to confuse ARC's sense of direction, creating a rare pocket of open-air safety. Raiders use the Backyard to hone their skills, and catch up on some long-overdue stargazing.
ST_MapSelection.ID_MAPSELECTION_PRACTICERANGE_ERRORFILLS: Not available while Fill Squad is enabled
ST_MapSelection.ID_MAPSELECTION_PRACTICERANGE_ERRORSQUAD: Not available while in a squad
ST_MapSelection.ID_MAPSELECTION_PRACTICERANGE_SQUADWARNI: Practice range not available while in a Squad.
ST_MapSelection.ID_MAPSELECTION_ROTATION_DESCRIPTION: The Tubes to this destination are currently undergoing maintenance, and have been temporarily closed to Raiders.

ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_TRIALS_DESCRIPTION_1: Achieve personal bests in weekly Trials objectives to earn rewards such as weapons, rare materials, and blueprints.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_TRIALS_DESCRIPTION_2: Compete in weekly Trials and climb the leaderboards to earn exclusive rank-based rewards at the end of each season.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_RANKS_SUBTITLE_ALT_2: Compete in weekly Trials and climb the leaderboards to earn exclusive rank-based rewards at the end of each season.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_FEATUREDESCRIPTION_BODY_ALT: Complete objectives and return safely to gain ranks and claim your rewards.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_OBJECTIVES_DESCRIPTION_: Completing objectives under Major Map Conditions grants bonus score.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_LEADERBOARDS_DESCRIPTIO: Depending on your leaderboard placement, you may be promoted or demoted to a new rank.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_OBJECTIVES_DESCRIPTION_: Each week introduces five new objectives. Earn score by achieving personal bests and returning home safely.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_LEADERBOARDS_DESCRIPTIO: Each week, you are placed in a leaderboard group with other Raiders of the same rank, competing for the highest total Trials Objective score.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_OBJECTIVES_DESCRIPTION_: Every objective offers three possible rewards, granted the first time you surpass milestone thresholds.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_SEASONS_DESCRIPTION_1: If you have no Trials score at the end of the week, you will automatically be demoted.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_SEASONS_DESCRIPTION_2: If you participate in Trials during the Trials season, you will receive rewards at the end based on your final rank.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_OBJECTIVES_DESCRIPTION_: Objective scores have no point limit.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_SEASONS_DESCRIPTION_4: Once a new Trials season begins, you will start a few ranks lower than where you finished in the previous season, depending on your final rank.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_NO_PROGRESS: Progress any Trials objective in order to get a rank
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_CELEBRATIONS_SEASONAL_MESSAGE: The Trials season has ended. You achieved rank:
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_SEASONS_DESCRIPTION_3: The top players from the Hotshot and Cantina Legend ranks are placed in the Cantina Legend rank at the start of each new week.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_NONE_AVAILABLE: There are no Trials objectives available at this time
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_NONE_ACTIVE: There is no Trials League active at this time
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_CELEBRATIONS_RANK_DESCRIPTION: This is where you placed this rank period:
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_END_OF_SEASON_RANK_SUBTITLE: This is your final rank for this season.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_NEW_SEASON_SUBTITLE: This is your new, adjusted rank for the season.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_FEATUREDESCRIPTION_BODY: Trials are a collection of challenging scenarios; testing the skills of the most veteran Raiders. When competing in a Trial, you only earn a score if you manage to return safely to Speranza. Your highest score determines your position on the leaderboard, which may gain or lose you rank at the end of the rank period. A Trials season is made up of multiple rank periods; at the end of the season, you will receive rewards based on your final rank.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_ABOUT_LEADERBOARDS_DESCRIPTIO: Trials scores reset at the end of the week, and you are placed in a new group when scoring on the next set of objectives.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_BETWEEN_SEASON_DID_NOT_PARTIC: You did not participate in this season
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_REWARD_TOOLTIP_CLAIMED: You have already received your {0} item for this milestone for this week.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_CELEBRATIONS_RANK_DOWN_INACTI: You have lost rank due to inactivity
ST_Mastery.ID_EVENT_RANK_DESCRIPTION_DEMOTION: You were demoted to a lower rank.
ST_Mastery.ID_EVENT_RANK_DESCRIPTION_PLACEMENT: You were placed in a new rank.
ST_Mastery.ID_EVENT_RANK_DESCRIPTION_PROMOTION: You were promoted to a higher rank.
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_REWARD_TOOLTIP: You will be rewarded from a random pool of materials, gameplay items and blueprints with the following rarity distribution:
ST_Mastery.ID_MASTERY_REWARD_TOOLTIP_EXPLAINER: You will receive one {0} item from a random pool.

ST_Option.ID_OPTION_VIDEO_FSR_FRAME_GENERATION_TOO:
AMD FSR Frame Generation increases frame rate by creating additional frames computed from existing inputs.

It is highly recommended to be always running at a minimum of ~60 FPS before frame generation is applied for an optimal high-quality gaming experience and to mitigate any latency introduced by the technology.

This feature can negatively affect performance in ARC Raiders on CPUs with few cores. A minimum of 8 CPU cores is recommended for running AMD FSR Frame Generation.

Determines how the Interact/Reload button behaves.
Tap to Reload: tap to reload, hold to interact.
Tap to Interact: tap to interact, hold to reload.
Prioritize Interact: tap dynamically adjusts to the available action. If both actions are available simultaneously, tap to interact and hold to reload.
Prioritize Reload: tap dynamically adjusts to the available action. If both actions are available simultaneously, tap to reload and hold to interact.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_NOTIFICATION_RESET_TEXT: Do you want to restore the settings to their default values?
ST_Option.ID_OPTIONS_SOCIAL_STREAMING_MATCHMAKING_:
Enables additional protection against stream sniping by adding a randomized delay to your matchmaking, and changing your server information in the bottom-right corner to make it less predictable.

When playing in a party, make sure the party leader has this setting toggled on. This setting cannot be changed while matchmaking.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_FONTSIZE_DESCRIPTION: Font size changes the size of the body text. The larger size is recommended when playing on a television.  Restart needed to apply changes.
ST_Option.ID_OPTIONS_SOCIAL_STREAMING_CONCEAL_ALL_: Hides the Display Names of all the players in a round from your own view.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_GAMEPLAY_AUTOSPRINT_TRIGGERDEL: How long the movement input needs to be held in order to trigger Auto Sprint.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_LOOK_BOOST_RAMPUP_TIME_DESCRIP: How much time it takes to accelerate to the full boost amount.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_ACCESSIBILITY_SCOPED_ZOOM_SENS: How much your sensitivity slows down when aiming down scoped sights.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_ZOOM_SENSITIVITY_MULTIPLIER_DE: How much your sensitivity slows down when aiming.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_GAMEPAD_LOOK_SENSITIVITY_VERTI: How quickly you look up and down.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_DISCORD_LINK_DESCRIPTION:
Integrating your ARC Raiders account with Discord will enhance the social interaction with your friend list in both applications by:
* Invite Discord friends to the game
* Shows your Discord friends in the game
* Enhances rich presence for Discord activities

You can always enable or disable the integration as you please, this will not affect the core social options in game such as Party, Friend List or Chat.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_ACCESSIBILITY_INVERT_X_AXIS_DE: Inverts your horizontal looking, so that you turn right by moving the mouse left, and turn left by moving it right.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_INVERT_HORIZONTAL_LOOK_INPUT_D: Inverts your horizontal looking, so that you turn right by moving the stick left, and turn left by moving it right.
Inverts your horizontal looking, so that you turn right by moving the stick left, and turn left by moving it right.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_ACCESSIBILITY_INVERT_Y_AXIS_DE: Inverts your vertical looking, so that you look up by moving the mouse down, and look down by moving it up.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_INVERT_VERTICAL_LOOK_INPUT_DES: Inverts your vertical looking, so that you look up by moving the stick down, and look down by moving it up.
Inverts your vertical looking, so that you look up by moving the stick down, and look down by moving it up.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_DISCORD_NOTIFICATION_LINK_FAIL: Linking Discord account failed. Please try again later or visit id.embark.games/id/
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_ACCESSIBILITY_INVERT_FLASH_COL: Makes the blinded effect from flashes black instead of white.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_MOUSE_SMOOTHING_DESCRIPTION: Mouse Smoothing improves the feel of lower-resolution mice. If you have a high-resolution gaming mouse, you might want to turn it off.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_ACCESSIBILITY_CROSSHAIR_MOVECR: Move Crosshair When Line of Fire Is Blocked
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_RAIDER_VOICE_PITCH_DETECTION_D: Pitch is the measure of how high or low your voice can go. Analyzing your average voice tone while speaking in a neutral way will help us improve the output of your Raider Voice.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_RAIDER_VOICE_PROXIMITY_DESCRIP: Raider Voice changes how your voice sounds to others in party and proximity voice chat.

Raider Voice changes how your voice sounds to others in party and proximity voice chat.   Using Raider Voice with Open Mic can put extra strain on lower-end systems. On such systems, we recommend switching to Push(/Toggle)-to-Talk to maintain stable performance.
Raider Voice changes the sound of your voice to match your Raider's while in party and proximity voice chat.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_RAIDER_VOICE_EVERYONE_DESCRIPT: Raider Voice will be heard by everyone.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_RAIDER_VOICE_PARTY_DESCRIPTION: Raider Voice will be heard by players in your party
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_RAIDER_VOICE_NOONE_DESCRIPTION: Raider Voice will not be heard by anyone.
ST_Option.ID_OPTIONS_SOCIAL_STREAMING_CONCEAL_MY_N: Replaces your Display Name with the word “ME” in all places where it is shown in your own view.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_FOV_SENSITIVITY_SCALING_DESCRI: Scales the look sensitivity based on field of view, so that the crosshair moves the same amount of pixels across all zoom levels.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_RAIDER_VOICE_QUALITY_DESCRIPTI: Select the quality level for the Raider Voice model. The lower quality models are recommended for systems with limited CPU resources.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_ACCESSIBILITY_CONTROLLER_ADAPT: Sets the intensity of the controller’s adaptive trigger effects
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_ACCESSIBILITY_CONTROLLER_VIBRA: Sets the intensity of the controller’s vibration effects
Sets the intensity of the controller’s vibration effects
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_GAMEPAD_AIM_ASSIST_DESCRIPTION: Sets whether aim assist is enabled or not.
ST_Option.ID_OPTIONS_SOCIAL_PRIVACY_STATUS_DESCRIP:
Setting this to ON turns your in-game status to Offline for anyone outside your Party, even if you are Online. You and your Party members will see your presence as Hidden. This doesn't affect any action you can normally perform in game while Online.

Please note that this does not change your status on your platform.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_HUD_SHOW_INVENTORY_PICKUP_DESC: Shows a visual representation of the inventory in the HUD when it’s being filled.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_ACCESSIBILITY_CROSSHAIR_SMOOTH: Smooth Move When Line of Fire is Blocked
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_LOOK_ACCELERATION_DESCRIPTION: Smoothens how it feels to look around at the cost of responsiveness. Higher values result in faster acceleration, and if you want instant response, keep it disabled at 0.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_CROSSPLAY_CONFIRMATION_BODY: Some of your party members are on other platforms. By turning off crossplay, you'll automatically leave your current party.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_GAMEPAD_LOOK_RESPONSE_CURVE_DE:
This curve determines how much of your stick movement applies to looking based on your input.
Exponential: Starts low and gradually increases in steepness.
Linear: Directly maps to your input with a 1:1 ratio.
Sinusoidal: Smooth in, steep middle, smooth out.

ST_Option.ID_OPTIONS_RAIDERVOICE_BETA_DESCRIPTION: This feature is currently in beta, and functionality may change over time.
ST_Option.ID_OPTIONS_SOCIAL_PRIVACY_ANONYMOUSMODE_: This mode enables a set of settings to anonymize your account to other players while in a round.
ST_Option.ID_OPTIONS_SOCIAL_PRIVACY_STREAMERMODE_D: This mode enables a set of settings to improve the experience when streaming.
ST_Option.ID_OPTION_SETTING_REQUIRES_RESTART_BODY: This settings change will take effect the next time you start the game.
ST_Option.ID_OPTIONS_SOCIAL_PRIVACY_NOTIFICATION_S:
Toggle visibility of all social notifications such as party invites and friend requests.
On: Notifications for social features are shown.
Off: Notifications for social features are muted.
ST_Option.ID_OPTIONS_SOCIAL_PRIVACY_NOTIFICATION_F:
Toggle visibility of new friend requests.
On: New friend requests will be shown at the top of your screen.
Off: You’ll still be able to receive new friend requests, but the request will not be shown at the top of your screen.
ST_Option.ID_OPTIONS_SOCIAL_PRIVACY_NOTIFICATION_P:
Toggle visibility of party invites from friends.
On: Party invites sent from friends will be shown at the top of your screen and can be accepted.
Off: Party invites from friends are hidden and can’t be accepted.

On: Party invites sent from friends will be shown at the top of your screen and can be accepted.
Off: Party invites from friends will not be shown at the top of your screen, but you can accept them from your Social screen.

Unlinking Discord account failed. You can only unlink your Discord account once every 48 hours.

ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_ANDROIDS: A body cobbled together from spare circuits and scavenged steel, the Torpedo clanks forward in defiance of obsolescence. Function isn’t guaranteed, but style is.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_TRAVELER: A clutch large enough to store your entire portable kitchen.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEENGIN: A fixer, a builder, a breaker of limits. With a customized tool for every problem - even ones that don’t exist yet - the Engineer is at the ready to repair old and new world tech alike.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEMOONS: A gorgeously pale show bird, the Moonstone Rooster never dirties a single feather.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_BOGWALKE: A lurker of the toxic swamps, the Bog Walker swims through ooze in style. This hazmat suit was once designed to filter out deadly fumes and poisonous liquids alike, but it has eroded into a high-visibility fashion statement.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEFARME: A nutritional, farm-to-table diet is important for every growing Raider. While there aren’t really any farms in the Rust Belt anymore, this basket can sure make you feel like there are!
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_MIRAGESE: A pilgrim of the wasteland, the Mirage dutifully carries the memories of the perished through the blistering sands of time.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEJUNKY: A pragmatic scavenger of old aerospace yards, the Junkyard Astronaut sees treasure where others see trash.  Clad in a patchwork of astronaut armor and other relics of the old world, this suit is a testament to survival through ingenuity.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THEABYSSSET_D: A relic of the first ARC skirmishes, the heavily armored suit of the Abyss was built to absorb the punishment of the machines. The scrying techno-eye stapled to the front of its helm might not be operational—but it’s certainly intimidating.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_ROGUEHAW: A renegade of the sky, the Rogue Hawk keeps a bird’s eye view of the battlegrounds.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_RENEGADE: A suit found in the debris of a far-flung asteroid, the Renegade Moon is a patchwork of metals and fabrics that may or may not be approved for space exploration.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THETRAIL: A tech-savvy wanderer of wild terrain, the Trailbyte uses high-end gear and scavenged tech to chart paths long forgotten across the Rust Belt.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_FORESTRA: A watchful warden of the deep woods, the Forest Ranger moves like a sleek shadow between the trees. The same cannot be said for the rooster.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THEALPINERESC: As winter fast approaches, Raiders require a special toolset for handling the frost—a torch to illuminate the darkness, a rescue kit for fallen comrades, and a pickaxe for scaling hills.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_SPYGLASSSET_D: Built for explorers who value observation before movement, the Spyglass Set includes tools meant for careful scouting. From rooftops and ridgelines, little goes unnoticed by a Raider equipped with this set.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THECRAFT: Built for those who fix, tinker, and make things work again. With this toolbox backpack, a trusty tool bag, and a well-worn stapler, the Craftsman’s kit turns any mess into a work in progress.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_CARTOGRAPHER_: Carried by those who chart the Belt. The Cartographer’s Set holds weathered maps, a portable sundial, and a pack built for long routes.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_WELLSUMM: Dipped in ink, this rooster struts its glossy onyx feathers.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THEFIEROSET_D: Even though the towers have long gone dark, survivors remain with an eye for the sky. Mapping forgotten air corridors and abandoned settlements, the Fiero holds out hope that someday wings will leave the ground in the Rust Belt again.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_HIVEKEEP: Every bee in the hive is accounted for by this vigilant clucker.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_LUNASET_: Fighting ARC from zero-gravity, the Luna walks the Rust Belt as a relic of the future we were promised.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_STEALTH_DESCR: For Raiders who strike and vanish. The Volare is hard to catch, and impossible to pin down. Slender lines and layered leathers let the wearer move swiftly and unpredictably in the Rust Belt.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_RACHETTA_DESC: For Raiders who strike hard, dodge fast, and don’t care about blending in. The Rachetta's bold colors and athletic cut make no attempt at camouflage.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_SOLARE_DESCRI: For the Raiders who worship the sunrise. The Solare Set carries the appearance of seemingly ceremonial wear, layered with woven fabrics that evoke a time far before the arrival of ARC.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_VANGUARD_DESC: For the fighters who hold the front. Heavy padding and an imposing visor give the wearer the confidence to stand at the forefront of any skirmish.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEBONEC: Forged from animal bone and recycled cloth, the Bonecrown carries the wilderness as a mantle.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_BEEKEEPE: If you listen close, you might hear a faint buzzing echoing from behind the Beekeeper’s veil.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEMEMOR: In the fast-changing wilderness of the Rust Belt, the mystical Memorialist is determined to keep the old ways alive.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THECAVAL: Living for speed and spectacle, the Cavalier rides into battle with style.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_MACRAMES: Luxurious in its maximalism, the Macrame is a testament to the boldness of its wearer.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_WASPHUNTER_DE: Move like a tick, sting like a Wasp. Shroud your identity and spark fear into the hearts of Raiders with an outfit that will keep your enemies on their toes.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_GILDEDDR: Never in one place for too long, the Gilded Driftcoat moves like a shadow stitched in fabric.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THESLUGGERSET: Once a regular in Speranza’s pickup games, the Slugger learned precision and timing by throwing baseballs across cracked diamonds. Those same instincts now guide every strike against the ARC.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_LEVIATHA: Only darkness lurks behind the grated helm of the Leviathan. This deep sea diver is an amalgam of fishing rope, sea urchins, nets and metal pieces from the farthest, darkest depths of the ocean.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEPASSE: Perfectly designed to fit in the Tubes’ upper compartments.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_RAMPAGE_DESCR: Slam ARC to dust with this imposing sledgehammer.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEMISTH: Stapling together disparate parts to create works of wearable art, the Misthorn turns survival into ceremony. Crowned with twin horns, their hand-forged attire speaks to the enduring history of the Rust Belt and the traditions that remain in the rubble.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_ASTROLIT: The Astrolite is the most aerodynamic space traveler in the Rust Belt. White-water rapids are no problem for this cadet of both the sky and the seas.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_CORSARO_DESCR: The Corsaro is for Raiders who are comfortable steering the ship. With a robotic arm and a spring-operated leg, any Raider who dons the Corsaro's pirate hat can feel like a techno-captain of the high seas, always dressed for conquest.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_NASCOSTO_DESC: The Nascosto’s modus operandi is simple: shoot, then disappear. A phantom on the edge of every skirmish, the only evidence they leave behind are bullet holes.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_RIOTSET_: The Riot is a perpetual protester. Always first to the fight, always last to leave.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_SANDVEIL_DESC: The Sandveil's pale wraps and layered linens were made for long stretches of dust and heat, where survival depends on patience and knowing when to move, and when to stay hidden.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_VALENTES: The Valente is the Rust Belt’s very own wasteland cowboy. Legend says they can never back down from a duel, but you’d be foolish to test it.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_VELATISE: The Velati scout never misses an ARC signal.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_VOLTEDGE: The Voltedge is a human livewire. Before you shake hands, make sure to ground yourself.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_OMBRASET: The elusive Ombra moves like a coyote through the Rust Belt’s wilderness. A lone wolf with a hidden identity, if you ever see a glimpse of their face, you’ll know the end is near.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEGOALI: The last barrier, the immovable wall. On and off the field, this heavily padded protector will never go down without a fight.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_CASTAWAY_DESC: The loner of the sea, the Castaway has long since abandoned rank and allegiance. Unpredictable and always self-reliant, the Castaway is for the Raider who can survive being left behind.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_RADIOMOU: The perfect backpack for a Rust Belt peak bagger, outfitted with an old radio transmitter and pager.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THEHYDROLOGIS: The perfect backpack for a budding firefighter or a dedicated gardener.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_HUNTSMAN_DESC: The uniform of the huntsman. Worn by trackers who rely on stealth and cunning, the Vulpine Set blends into the forested ruins and overgrown fields of the Rust Belt. Its muted leathers, careful cuts, and fox pelt hat make the outfit a perfect choice for a surprise attack.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_RIPOSTA_: The unseeable eyes of the Riposta are always watching your next move. Careful going toe-to-toe with this wilderness fencer, you might get sliced in two.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THESANDWALKER: The weather-beaten garments of a hardened nomad traveling from distant lands beyond the Belt, the Sandwalker commands attention and invites the intrigue of the locals.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_DEEPSEAB: This abyssal explorer plumbs the darkest trenches, feathers flared against the crushing deep.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_SPECKLED_DESC: This beautifully bespeckled bird will be the diamond of the flock.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEBEACH: This boat hook isn’t just for docking, it’s for defending your lunch. Paired with a picnic basket and a few lemons for luck, the Beachside Set keeps you ready for anything the tide throws your way.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_TRAILROO: This feather-footed wanderer treks the highest ridges and deepest woods, crowing proudly at every summit.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_ENVOYSET: This oversized trunk is the perfect companion to a traveling wasteland musician. Pack your favorite dress shoes and your harmonica and play a lament by the roadside.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_ASTROLIT: This rooster’s helmet was built for space travel, but looks just as good dodging low ceilings and kitchen counters in the cantina.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THEDIVERSET_D: This scrapped-together oxygen tank might not get you to the bottom of the sea, but it’s good enough for a swim around the Red Lakes.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_WHALER_DESCRI: Two legends of the deep sea, one weapon.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_VALENTES: Upgrade to the Deluxe Edition Bundle
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_YARNFACE_DESC: Veiled in yarn, the Devotee’s presence unnerves even the boldest. The Devotee moves with singleminded purpose, their expressions hidden, their intent clear only to those who dare to watch.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_MARCOSET: With an adventure rooster in tow, the Explorer treads toward uncharted horizons.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_WILDERNE: With binoculars at the ready, the keen eyed Wilderness Scout is an indispensable part of the ARC resistance.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_GEARSHIF: Yearning for the roar of engines and the burn of asphalt, the Gearshifter is a stylish relic from the golden age of the racetrack.
ST_PurchasableOffers.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_BRIGADE_DESCR: You don’t want to find these shining blue irises waiting for you in the dark. Always caught in the crossfire, the Brigade depends on light-weight gear to stay ahead of last-second laser fire and rocket-fast rounds.
