ST_RaiderDen.ID_RAIDERDEN_MESSAGE_RAIDERDEN_UPGRADE_A: Upgrade your stash to gain stash space, allowing you to collect and store more items. This may also improve the appearance your Raider Den.
ST_RaiderDen.ID_RAIDERDEN_MESSAGE_RAIDERDEN_UPGRADE: Will improve the appearance of your Raider Den.

ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_DESCRIPTION: A festival of resilient warmth, centered around the hardy candleberry bush.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_4_DES: Adding storage, workbenches, utilities, and personal touches.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_SATELLITE_PAGE3_DESCR: After sufficient antennas have been constructed and weather conditions are safe, they will be deployed across the Rust Belt in hopes of triangulating the source of recent ARC signals.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECT_EXPEDITION_LAST_RESORT: An apparent favorite pastime of resort guests, miniature ship models have been found all around the Riven Tides area. The dream of safety beyond the horizon has turned many Speranzans into avid collectors, and even the local bird population seems to have taken a shine to these fine models.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_DETAILS_K: Bonus Skill Points Earned From Expeditions
Bonus Stash Slots Earned From Expeditions
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEPS_DESC:
Build a caravan to be able to depart on an Expedition. Once your caravan is completed, you can sign up as soon as the departure window opens.

If you miss the departure, you will lose any temporary buffs until the next Expedition. However, any permanent rewards from past Expeditions will be retained.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_1_DES: Building the base structure and frame of the caravan.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_3_DES: Building walls and roof, installing core systems, and defining the interior layout.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_STAGE_4_DESCRI: Candleberries can be crushed into refreshing juices, while the leaves and roots make for a tea that can drive out the toughest of colds.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_5_DES: Combat gear, survival equipment, provisions, and repair materials are needed to fully prepare for the Expedition.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_RANKS_DES: Completing an Expedition gives your new Raider lasting advantages until the next Expedition departs. These include increased XP gain, extra Scrappy materials, increased weapon repairs, and more stash space. You can also earn bonus skill points based on the value of the items in your stash upon departure.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_2_DES: Connecting wiring, ventilation, and essential power systems.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_SUBTITLE: Construct a caravan to send your Raider off on an Expedition beyond the Rust Belt.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_STAGE_3_DESCRI: Crafty Speranzans have turned the candleberries into a wealth of gifts. These include perfumes and soaps, as well as gifts unrelated to the recipient's odors.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_SKIP_TUTOR: Do you want to skip the tutorial level?
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DESCRIPTIO: Expeditions are perilous. Your Raider will carry all their possessions into the unknown beyond the Rust Belt. In return, your next Raider gains a unique edge that lasts until the next Expedition departs.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_CALENDAR_:
Expeditions run on a set schedule, with each preparation stage unlocking after the previous one is complete. You’ll have 60 days to gather resources and complete your caravan build. Once construction is finished and the departure sign-up window opens, you can sign your Raider up for departure and view the rewards that will carry over to your next Raider.
Missing an Expedition departure window means losing its buffs until the next cycle, so plan your contributions and availability ahead of time.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTURE_: If you choose to sign up, your Raider will depart Speranza once the Expedition leaves, and return as a new one. This action cannot be undone.

If you choose to sign up, your Raider will depart Speranza with the Expedition and your progress will be reset. When they return, it will be as a new Raider, carrying the rewards of a completed Expedition.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_PROGRESS_K: If you miss the departure, your caravan's building progress is carried over to the next Expedition. You'll be able to pick up where you left off.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_5_DES: Loading the caravan with vital supplies.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_LOADOUT_WA: Losing these items may impact the value of your Expedition.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_STAGE_2_DESCRI: Many Speranzans have become surprisingly adept at the art of bringing beauty and greenery into the home.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_CATCHUP_DE: Missed earlier Expedition bonus rewards? You will have a chance to catch up during the departure window.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTUREV: Most value gained in a single round:
Most value lost in a single round:
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_STEP_USE_D: Once committed to your project, resources cannot be retrieved
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_STEPS_DES: Preparing for an Expedition happens in five stages, each requiring specific resources or items. You will construct a caravan, stock it with supplies, and then leave everything behind to depart. First, you will lay the foundation, install the core systems, construct the framework, and outfit the caravan for travel. Lastly, you will load it with as many supplies as it can carry.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECT_EXPEDITION_LAST_STEP_D: Put your spare gear to good use, and let your final triumphs reverberate throughout Speranza's cantinas long after you're gone.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTUREV: Since arriving in Speranza, your Raider has left an undeniable mark.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECT_EXPEDITION_AVIAN_ALARM: Speranzans have noticed that some birds are sensitive to atmospheric changes, and have taken to designing multi-tiered alarm systems to warn of impending danger. Though their precision has been debated, the calming effect of their companionship is beyond reproach.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTURE_: The Expedition departure window is now closed.
The Expedition departure window is now open.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_SATELLITE_PAGE2_DESCR: The antennas require rare components that can not be crafted. However, ARC’s ongoing operations offer a rare opportunity to collect the parts required to build your antenna.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTURE_: The departure window for the Expedition opens once the Trials Season ends.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_STAGE_1_DESCRI: The namesake use for the candleberry, Speranzans boil the fruit into a thick wax that burns cleanly and fragrantly.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_COMPLETED_DESC: The preparations for your banquet are now complete! It’s time to kick back, make a toast, and quietly bask in the envious glances of uninvited passers-by.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_SIGNUP_WIN: The sign-up window for the Expedition has opened! If your caravan is fully built, you can now register your Raider for departure.
The window to sign up for departure is open!
The window to sign up for departure opens on {0}.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DEPARTUREV: Their adventures will be the subject of bold tales for a long time to come.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WINTER_STAGE_5_DESCRI: Though candleberry leaves are bitter, simmering them in stew and soups adds a touch of earthiness that nostalgic Speranzans have grown to love.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_OVERVIEW_: Undertaking an Expedition means your Raider leaves the Rust Belt for good. Preparing your caravan takes time and resources, and once it departs, much of your progress will be reset. Some rewards and advantages carry over to your next Raider, lasting until the next Expedition begins. These advantages can be increased by continuing to send Raiders on future Expeditions.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_ABOUT_DESC: Undertaking an Expedition means your Raider leaves the Rust Belt for good. Preparing your caravan takes time and resources, and when it departs, much of your progress resets. Some rewards carry over to your next Raider until the next Expedition.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_TROPHYCASE_OVERVIEW_D: Use ARC parts to build a display of your hunting trophies, in order to not-so-subtly shut down anyone who questions the bold tales of your topside adventures.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECT_EXPEDITION_LAST_STEP_D: Use your last gear to leave a mark that will remain long after you're gone.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_GAIN_LOSE_: When you take part in the Expedition, everything tied to your Raider gets reset, such as your items, skills, workshop, Raider Den, and quests. You keep everything tied to your Embark account, such as your Raider Tokens, all Raider Deck progress, unlocked cosmetics, existing temporary buffs, and any permanent rewards earned from previous Expeditions. You will gain any additional temporary buffs this Expedition grants you.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPLANATION_DETAILS_D: When your Raider departs on an Expedition, some things are reset and others are kept for your next Raider.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_SATELLITE_PAGE1_DESCR:
With ARC’s operations growing ever more destructive, generous rewards are being offered for the construction of high-gain antennas, to be deployed around the Rust Belt. 

When placed in open areas, these parabolic dishes can form an array that picks up on distant signals within a narrow beamwidth. Shani believes these may help triangulate the origins of the troubling ARC signals that were recently reported.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECT_EXPEDITION_LAST_STEP_P: With your caravan built, you have one last opportunity to truly cement your legacy before departure.

ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_BUFFER_CAT: You can catch up on bonuses from previous Expeditions.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_BONUS_DESC: You can earn bonus rewards during the remainder of the departure window. When you finally depart at the end of the window, all remaining items in your stash will be contributed to the Expedition.

ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_COMPLETE_D: You have successfully completed your Expedition Project and sent your Raider into the unknown. Your new Raider will enjoy a long-term buff to XP gain and stash space, benefit from increased repair efficiency, and receive extra materials from Scrappy. This buff will last until the next Expedition departs, but it can be kept and improved if you choose to send your new Raider on that Expedition as well.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_EXPLANATIO: You have the opportunity to catch up on missed bonus rewards from your previous Expeditions.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_DESCRIPTIO: You missed the departure window for this Expedition. Fortunately, all the progress you’ve made in building your caravan will carry over to the next Expedition. If you have any remaining work to do on your caravan, you can pick up right where you left off. If it’s finished in time for the next departure window, you’ll be able to send your Raider on the Expedition.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_EXPEDITION_GRACE_DESC:
You missed the window to sign up for departure. You have a chance to leave now, your Raider will depart immediately and your progress will be reset. Any bonuses you have not fulfilled requirements for, will be available to catch up with the upcoming Expeditions.

If you rather stay behind you will lose any temporary buffs. Your caravan’s progress will be saved, so you can depart with the next Expedition.

ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_SATELLITE_COMPLETED_D: Your high-gain antenna will be deployed around the Rust Belt once conditions are safe, and may help us triangulate the origins of the disturbing ARC signals.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_TROPHYCASE_PROJECT_CO: Your trophy display is complete! All that remains is to loiter about while Speranzans gasp, gawk and linger at the indisputable evidence of your topside accomplishments.
ST_RaiderProjects.ID_RAIDER_PROJECTS_WEATHERSTATION_COMPLE: Your weather station is now up and running, and collecting a veritable wealth of data. Though the meteorological results will take some time to collect, you do have an immediate source of particularly captivating small talk.

ST_ServerSlam.ID_SERVERSLAM_WELCOME_01_V2:
From **17 - 19 October** we welcome you to put our servers to the test in a limited gameplay experience.
By participating in the Server Slam, you will unlock an **exclusive Backpack cosmetic** reward, available when you purchase the full game at launch. Just make sure you confirm your email address in Embark ID to get it. 
For more info and troubleshooting, please head over to our Discord. We hope to see you on **30 October** to experience the full scope of ARC Raiders at launch!
ST_ServerSlam.ID_SERVERSLAM_WELCOME_01:
From 17 - 19 October we welcome you to push our servers to the limit as we prepare for launch on 30 October.
By participating in the Server Slam, you will unlock an exclusive Backpack cosmetic reward, available when you purchase the full game at launch. Just make sure you confirm your email address in Embark ID to get it. 
The Server Slam is a focused experience. We welcome you to put our servers to the test on one map, and elements such as Progression, Quests, and Crafting will be limited. 
For more info and troubleshooting, please head over to our Discord. We hope to see you on 30 October to experience the full scope of ARC Raiders at launch!

ST_VoiceLines.3659294C45CC23B37D6300B83BE168C2: A Hornet—their electric shocks are no joke. It takes some firepower to get through their armor.
ST_VoiceLines.A07ECE3C4549449A42DF7581B24DB6FA: A Leaper. Raiders much more experienced than you have tried to take one on, and very few returned in one piece.
ST_VoiceLines.8B762EF14AADA9BC252099B8B6784B7E: A Leaper. Their stomping can be felt all the way down here. We’ll have to find a way to bring them down, before they collapse our tunnels.
ST_VoiceLines.EC371172479E9AF3262CB6BD6EDCEA95: A Pop. Not much survival instinct in those, but they'll do whatever they can to take you down with them.
ST_VoiceLines.E84E7EF44F3D993D716302BC52A82F24: A Raider came into my shop earlier, to trade some grenades for a machine she found in Buried City. She said it makes coffee, but it seems to be missing a few parts. Up for a job?
ST_VoiceLines.853A0A7443F3E8524E6C3481B5C606C8: A Raider, huh? What do you need?
ST_VoiceLines.5E1F82EB42791F466EB6A28A0BD5A562: A Rocketeer, slow, but devastating. You don't want to go anywhere near those in your current gear.
ST_VoiceLines.67CF7CE64CA38656DB7E03BC4A901584: A Sentinel. They're known to pick off Raiders from afar. Make sure you find good cover.
ST_VoiceLines.5FDA0F874B377FC7E5CE4F9E5A51B3C9: A Spotter. It won’t harm you directly, but it’ll relay your location to others who most definitely will.
ST_VoiceLines.4ABC0A4C4AD9D9010FA7F5B980950368: A Surveyor; full of rare tech, that one. They're often more scared of you than you are of them, but in a panic, they'll bulldoze you all the same
ST_VoiceLines.0549777F46D5E59111F1A29AD36ACF0E: A Turret. You'll find them lurking indoors; try to take them out before they spot you.
ST_VoiceLines.3E5DCADD4C8F35C5697B1E9A2BC76667: A Wasp; nasty little buggers. Don’t let them swarm you. aim for the thrusters, if you can.
ST_VoiceLines.F3F5F14545E6E6BFAD7BF4B8B78EE222: A balanced approach, somewhat good at penetrating ARC plating, but works well on other things too
ST_VoiceLines.40609C824C37ACE197A855A228D1985A: A bunch of sensors started beeping over here, so the rewiring must’ve worked. That should keep my stashes safe from harm; good stuff.
ST_VoiceLines.9D191A874533EAC0E5A5259B856AD3B7: A classic choice. Safe. Reliable. Moderately fabulous.
ST_VoiceLines.7006E74242BA5862F66208AC324F3C65: A classic grenade - can't go wrong.
ST_VoiceLines.6F92827F47C59E3A550C5189BAB1768B: A customer of mine saw a family taking cover in an old encampment in Buried City. I’ll pay anyone who manages to find them and escort them back to safety.
ST_VoiceLines.37F8E5E744A44411E4BEC5AA0AD85EA5: A flushing terminal, huh? That's what I thought. There’s only a handful of people who know how to work those, and they’re all in our own waste disposal department.
ST_VoiceLines.878C1E364F642DBD6961F4A232635940: A good sidearm. Always worth having a backup weapon.
ST_VoiceLines.CB812BDD4F8C537180B73DA68C99AB9B: A great companion when everything else feels drab.
ST_VoiceLines.91F20415456C6561D64B88BFB86D4927: A hellcat, more like. Just make sure you can aim when using this.
ST_VoiceLines.D13C563D42A70D9BB43846BFE3DA56E6: A job well done. Here’s the key, as promised.
ST_VoiceLines.D8FD27E642F716AD8D8A69A630327849: A little birdie told me they saw the plants growing on the Baron Husk out by the Old Battleground. Might be just the place to collect a sample.
ST_VoiceLines.3CFBE709452AAE84E4C134828825EC4D: A note from Apollo. "Remember to take breaks sometimes." Hm.
ST_VoiceLines.3B9884A14ECF07DACE5DA285828C7494: A picky customer. I respect that.
ST_VoiceLines.D49C3D8B437B780B1B865DB8D5ADC2ED: A proper hand cannon. Very effective, if you can handle it well.
ST_VoiceLines.1B8C868A417BD71069A72BACE90B05FF: A real "SNAPPY" piece of equipment. Get it?
ST_VoiceLines.2B10F7E64850E1C00ECE09905FBC8CE8: A safe fallback. Reliable under pressure.
ST_VoiceLines.A6B5EEAA431DF5F405D688AFF51AAC42: A semi-auto shotgun. Hopefully I don't need to tell you how useful those can be.
ST_VoiceLines.DAD51B5E4BA340AD6EB8F399F612C619: A sensible middle. Nothing wrong with balance, partner.
ST_VoiceLines.33B8FEDE44C7E2E54901808493549AB0: A single train derailment can be an accident, but an entire headquarters full of plans? They were no longer playing.
ST_VoiceLines.90C17A5F4C88443A529165AF62D2A5D5: A solid room-clearer, if you can handle it.
ST_VoiceLines.A4C80FC24D7E37D2C9C66395BA19841E: A swarm of disoriented Wasps crashed near one of our skylights. I need you to help thin ARC's ranks before any more accidents happen, and gather some extra sturdy materials to fix the damage.
ST_VoiceLines.AD2181B545B1BAFFBAB50AA4B0D95480: A wise purchase! Says me, the expert in staying alive.
ST_VoiceLines.FF7637344873909779B104862457FC7A: A working shield keeps the bullets away from you.
ST_VoiceLines.877DD07040346190DEBBFEA50BB2FAC0: ARC Alloy is strong and pure. It's the only way to fix reinforced concrete, as Apollo will tell you over and over.
ST_VoiceLines.0DC1678A484A38893BE5909631FBA4E7: ARC has seemed especially erratic after the storm. I need my antennas working now more than ever.
ST_VoiceLines.D7F1ACA1473C69C8344A11AE1E9CBF44: ARC may be changing, but we’re finally changing with it. Let’s finish up those outposts so we can track them; flank them; smash them to bits.
ST_VoiceLines.D1DC6B094202C4A6F0DC4FBCDFE0A7C1: ARC's really been bringing out the big guns, lately. I need you to get some scans of a Rocketeer and a Leaper - the better we understand them, the more we can do to fight back.
ST_VoiceLines.7562C8174AE24F0D7C079FA1A8F2E186: About my mum’s things… You’ve already done a lot for me. I just want you to know that it’s okay if you don’t find it. Really.
ST_VoiceLines.7BDE66D14A515F95D9E6D8BAFD86DBF7: About the site… I can’t expect you to actually care. But try to be respectful, at least.
ST_VoiceLines.9E04BAA04B8D1D89A1A0B6B62DCC9D20: According to the files you found in the lab, the cultivation researchers were actually the ones who set up the Hydroponic Domes out in the swamp. Sounds like the most obvious place to search next, don’t you think?
ST_VoiceLines.D22FEED1406EA982B33809BCCFC2C389: After the machines returned and forced us underground , the camps fell into disrepair, and now Raiders have picked most of them clean. I want you to scout a few for me.
ST_VoiceLines.177E3AAC45A68D808032B497F6ABAF0C: Ah, I do so love money.
ST_VoiceLines.CC28D1324CB6E9651A2E3B89B9932216: Ah, a sight for sore eyes.
ST_VoiceLines.DF0390AC437D5FE35E64568FC440FDB6: Ah, a tiny task for the likes of me? Child's play, really.
ST_VoiceLines.732A577547F65BC15F944194871EA3B4: Ah, another fine choice. Clearly, you have taste.
ST_VoiceLines.52C954DA4191E5E808626FA7FAC25180: Ah, greetings! You must think you've discovered the crown jewel of Speranza, right? You may be correct.
ST_VoiceLines.486FBD2D4A81D22BEFBFB49FC4C93F98: Ah, magnificent indeed! And see, I'm holding up my end, just like always.
ST_VoiceLines.AD7FEE584CEE73B9123867AC30CDF19D: Ah, my favorite repeat patient! Though you’re looking surprisingly intact today.
ST_VoiceLines.9CF2D68C421E5CA634F71A9D1494CEC7: Ah, right on the money! Well, almost. Money-adjacent. But I’m pretty sure the Container Storage building is the place to be!
ST_VoiceLines.6E2F609D45D9CFEC4D2F30B8CA2A2132: Ah, right on the money! Well, almost; money-adjacent. But I’m pretty sure the Container Storage building is the place to be!
ST_VoiceLines.B911025C4485EAA9A04FDCA93295F2E5: Ah, that's a Snitch. Don’t let it spot you, or it’ll call in reinforcements.
ST_VoiceLines.443530164A8548B67D5B03AF4E23F0B9: Ah, welcome. Fresh face, eh? Need anything, just ask. Honestly, what would you do without me?
ST_VoiceLines.1E27ED5C4668A59B2A1248AF394A694F: Ah, yes, they look positively parched! Say, Raider, you wouldn’t want to stay for a nice cup of—no? Fine, more for us.
ST_VoiceLines.28D4D28D41F4EC6EE0F60FACD7FAD0BA: Ah, you managed to access some new terminals. Good job—I’ll sift through the data and see if there’s anything relating to Project Heartwood or the Exodus.
ST_VoiceLines.DC58CA0740107B9DA27713A531EAE385: Ah, you've finally decided to pay me a visit? Well, this is a treat, I must say. I've been expecting it.
ST_VoiceLines.3D80DB0042DEED237559868AAB11B668: Ah-ah, you're taking the bait, I see.
ST_VoiceLines.EEA14E4C4B8404D9CCC9BCA125066F8A: Alarm's gone. Grid's reading clean on my end. Well, as clean as century-old hardware gets. Whatever that was, you sorted it.
ST_VoiceLines.5C56637841F193C4A94C17ADAAF18418: Alert! More than one Queen has been reported nearby. We don’t know what they’re up to, since they do not seem to be defending a Harvester.
ST_VoiceLines.865B1F584DD628A54F533D8894D15682: All Raiders around the South west elevator! Time's ticking. It's about to close so get out or reroute!
ST_VoiceLines.A980331741FB8664EA6021838418924D: All Raiders: ARC on screen. 5 minutes left; go find your way home. I repeat: 5 minutes.
ST_VoiceLines.D9DF690C40F5DB3D282BA19945A09B0C: All Raiders: the geothermal fissures by the swamp are producing a rare microbial fertilizer. Use the antennas by the domes to disperse some of the gases, then grab as much as you can carry.
ST_VoiceLines.8E096C1F46EF5A60652D218BCA737C3E: All Raiders: we have ARC on screen. 5 minutes left; go find a way home. I repeat: 5 minutes.

ST_VoiceLines.314BCB7C4919E1E9E52D8D894DE626E8: All chairs in here - besides mine - are purely decorative. Sit at your own peril.
ST_VoiceLines.7950A18B4C8EB12D0BF48FA9D79BA814: All of Speranza is buzzing about Stella Montis right now, and I admit it’s caught my attention. Let the others sort out the whats and hows; I’m interested in the tech inside.

ST_VoiceLines.01132384447161700E677E962EB3322E: All right, now off with you.

ST_VoiceLines.55CE162E440E2D12C3693FA266A40334: All the best Raiders buy their gear from me. I only carry quality stuff.
ST_VoiceLines.FE36024947766E4AB8C5859299A350F6: All the cash I earn I save up to buy myself a rocket-powered skateboard.
ST_VoiceLines.52BCC9494528D24E8782D580C4D2FF2B: All unlocks have been activated. The Outskirts Bunker will open in about sixty seconds. Go and get whatever's inside.
ST_VoiceLines.2BA2C6C3451B8F9EA63F1F9C4607A999: Alright! I can count on you, it seems. Here, take this and be on your way.
ST_VoiceLines.388D86434B9EDFD166867793B7C6A413: Alright, let’s see what you’re after.
ST_VoiceLines.353F3ECD4AF1D7A68D88A2A2FAC39BA8: Alright. You be careful with that now.
ST_VoiceLines.6991B8FE45A2BCB404388CBA8FCCC3B5: Always a pleasure. And always a little something here with your name on it.
ST_VoiceLines.80319D814A92E379332E86A4A8DE4617: Always good to have a few of these on hand.
ST_VoiceLines.D89BB8A3461AEFBC31E46D8723C12804: Always happy to help out a Raider.
ST_VoiceLines.E885AF9F4F90C226D0DA16A9F88839EA: Always keep some bandages on your person, in case you get hit. Regular works well, sterilized ones even better. In a pinch, any piece of fabric you can get your hands on will do the trick.
ST_VoiceLines.024E6BFB4C395B7C9BD417A99FE4DA59: Always nice to see a fresh face. If you're looking to blow some stuff up, I got you covered.
ST_VoiceLines.840DB867413956DE90C60393EE377A77: Always room for one more patient.
ST_VoiceLines.40A7DCF0477D8A9194CA0A8CCD969993: Amazing how simple cloth can be so life-saving.
ST_VoiceLines.359B4CBF40752237238897A2EBFA5FC6: Ammo for light weapons, and with a high rate of fire. Probably not very effective against ARC though.
ST_VoiceLines.EACCB9B54942726F9EAC7E980DFD2D62: An ARC orbiter is en route. The safe window is closing. 10 minutes to get out of there. I repeat: 10 minutes.
ST_VoiceLines.1F80EC274E37FCE03EA156B3B6654629: An ARC orbiter is en route; the safe window is closing. You have 10 minutes to return to Speranza. I repeat: 10 minutes.
ST_VoiceLines.7226816740D49F0F0F6E7AA556A82479: An ESR analyzer is used to test the blood. I was going to use it on myself, first.
ST_VoiceLines.0CD4D2244B4141CF417B84A138CD8123: An auditory researcher is said to have visited Stella Montis during the Exodus. See if you can retrace her steps.
ST_VoiceLines.569D403A46CD802360DEFBA5ED5C7C05: An extra incentive to keep all your fingers.
ST_VoiceLines.BD7776084A578A7985FC388765A41D18: An eye... That looks like his work, all right. He must be well, then. If anyone else communicated through cryptic drawings I’d be concerned, but from him… Anyway, thanks for helping out.
ST_VoiceLines.9484BE2043242E11548DCE8EA9277CA8: Another day, another request. Go on.
ST_VoiceLines.97B6D5854178719851BAE8AC7018327A: Another day, another water crisis. I was hoping that our troubles were at an end after we rerouted to the Spaceport, but now Shani suspects someone has been siphoning our water.
ST_VoiceLines.56B63F9344D77CE16AAD34B1C1EFB9BF: Any Burletta will do. Buy one, craft one, loot one. Just don’t be stupid and put your own modified Burletta in there, if you even have one.
ST_VoiceLines.B2885A9243F6C1B52330178F9AF8FFA5: Any Raiders topside or en route; the wind’s picking up hard. If you’re scavenging today, expect limited visibility and a lot of noise. Stay safe.
ST_VoiceLines.489ECCE04603FA6F981ED5BC74A7A210: Any ideas on how to up security in the tunnels? I'm all ears.
ST_VoiceLines.D39CD0FB4A3212E682CC4CAB6D17BA68: Any luck with those parts I requested?
ST_VoiceLines.C9E8FD80468B08BD784FA4BD0EB39083: Any luck with those probes yet?
ST_VoiceLines.A9231C5145E341F5F442BE84AD105151: Any news? We're eager for some results.
ST_VoiceLines.C0A15D8C477D45869055D5A32C7934AE: Anyone gifted you some candleberry soap, yet?
ST_VoiceLines.4BB281F84AABC54F45EF2BB56082161B: Anyone near the Spaceport? Someone just managed to override the Outskirts Bunker's security system, and every gang in Toledo is scrambling to get their hands on whatever's inside. Don't let this opportunity go to waste.
ST_VoiceLines.E06321234296A5D5CA773CB5AE893878: Anyone near the Spaceport? Someone's messed with the Outskirts Bunker's security system. It's locked with four remote lock controls. I'm sure every gang in Toledo will scramble to get their hands on whatever's inside.
ST_VoiceLines.E76016524EAE7A50F49E528E86B4220C: Apollo here. Hope I got the right frequency.
ST_VoiceLines.8936A0384E5AE9C70B6AB3AA92E5585E: Apparently, olives need to be brined to be edible. Don't ask me how I know.
ST_VoiceLines.96C1809A481C0239F5AD97B621621FF6: Appreciate it. Between blight and malfunctioning grow lights, we can never have too many fresh seeds.
ST_VoiceLines.05493CC44801060AA3CB2EAF3E07BCEB: Appreciate it. I’ve heard Wasp Drivers and Fireball Burners can be repurposed to do some serious damage.
ST_VoiceLines.DF3993534D890D78429F1A8254A7A293: Are you enjoying yourself? Don’t forget to take some time to decompress and chase away the cold.
ST_VoiceLines.909A73274FFE3BB78343358CF4623C5E: Are you heading into the dam anytime soon? I've got an elevator acting up, and there's a reward for whoever fixes it.
ST_VoiceLines.5018383E468B2B3EE1D64DB41D476D4C: Are you heading into the dam anytime soon? There's an elevator acting up, and there's a reward for whoever fixes it.
ST_VoiceLines.988450EB4FB22E025804CE9B0225B426: Are you here with my supplies?
ST_VoiceLines.86E8F2024506D509B5F23FAD119A74D5: Are you just here to stare at the back of my head?
ST_VoiceLines.CA4E5FCF444BD34B93F9D589AD3AEA32: Armor won’t mean much against this.

ST_VoiceLines.7F7127FF46F630443AF6959930C07AA7: As excited as I am about this, we can’t forget that any topside presence is risky. Keep it simple: paint, move on, next building. Quick work.
ST_VoiceLines.8781DF1548C46AAD275FB0834787548C: As much as I want to, I can’t play movie tapes that are all torn up. The Cultural Archives in Stella Montis may have some more pristine ones.
ST_VoiceLines.AF392D364AA2FE51FD57BF87A40CD8BB: As you know, the facility is divided into several different research sectors. I recommend you look through several of them for this task.
ST_VoiceLines.A485A2B3484574DB623FAE9DEAEB723F: At least I know you're good for it.
ST_VoiceLines.77DD730B4F8397698288F28B26FED9B1: At the end of the day, you can't eat coins.
ST_VoiceLines.5A9073FC4921687454E00A875291B3FD: At this rate, ARC will go back to where they came from before you finish that assignment.
ST_VoiceLines.47C1B694451A5F2BD718889C4E51A444: Attention Raiders: we have reports of Surveyors scanning the area under Vaporizer escort. We're not sure what'll happen if they find what they're looking for, but it may be worth keeping an eye on.
ST_VoiceLines.D9B9D6BD439870F440BFE3B9BEAFF209: Attention Raiders: we have reports of surveyors scanning the area under vaporizer escort. We're not sure what'll happen if they find what they're looking for, but it may be worth keeping an eye on.
ST_VoiceLines.B2CF315D4967ED840725D08A1B24C873: Attention all Raiders, the west antenna has been successfully activated.
ST_VoiceLines.3498A4B04E2298FF584BFC92E44D7E62: Attention all Raiders: multiple Queens spotted in the area. Stay safe out there.
ST_VoiceLines.0C221AD5460993C197C49488A9D80084: Attention all Raiders: the electromagnetic storm is interfering with our surface equipment. If you’re exploring Topside, steer clear of any open areas as best you can.
ST_VoiceLines.4CA941E74B7692348917C892AC2D8ED8: Attention all Raiders: we’ve got confirmed reports of a Harvester nearby. That means a Queen should be present as well, so be on your guard and only engage it if you’re prepared for the fight.
ST_VoiceLines.194959B14A3EDCBB34436F9C2FE27B84: Attention! Raiders by the East elevator! It will be closed soon, so go now or use another exit.

ST_VoiceLines.1ACACBD84D44E33C1D3603A4413923B1: Attention, Raiders: The North antenna has been activated.
ST_VoiceLines.E470A64A407A10ECB8BD3CA142C152F7: Attention, Raiders: The South antenna has just been activated.
ST_VoiceLines.8099567144B6268832A1BB88CF661B49: Attention. South east elevator is closing soon. Exit now or plan a different escape.

ST_VoiceLines.8F4198D84CB897F265294491B8999402: Automatic fire and zero subtlety. Nice.

ST_VoiceLines.CA6801F9426A8DE12ACA8594EBB1C183: Back again? Must mean you’re still in one piece. That’s good news.

ST_VoiceLines.408439B842CC900944947E8CBB8FDB3E: Back in one piece. Always a good sign.
ST_VoiceLines.D4394CAC4AACC65EC43928B6DD2CE95E: Back in one piece. That usually means good news.
ST_VoiceLines.90E61C5E42DA1CEDF605069922C2F803: Back so soon? Either ARC’s getting bold or you’re just having fun.
ST_VoiceLines.BAEAE0264AA69803760009A2458910C9: Back with a story? Or a scar? Preferably both!

ST_VoiceLines.13305BCC4DFED684F677629B70D9823E: Be a good neighbor, and don't make too much noise after hours.

ST_VoiceLines.DA5EBC00456146951975CFA785DAFC97: Be on your guard, when you go there—I’ve had a lot of reports of gunfire in that area.
ST_VoiceLines.54C852F64C4906168B117C8BF509CC11: Be warned, Raiders: we've spotted more than one Queen in the vicinity, yet no Harvester seems to be anywhere in sight. Don’t get caught in the middle.
ST_VoiceLines.59E90E00429A44892CFE43BAAC6AC5D7: Been thinking about getting a hat. A wide-brimmed one. What do you think?

ST_VoiceLines.50FEF03146FDE4C9A2CB58B269B24905: Best gear in Speranza and beyond.
ST_VoiceLines.B4556E71475EB7BBE0512394337DD574: Best paired with something fast and loud.
ST_VoiceLines.B3673FF3407E324171795C9F9996CB97: Better for careful shooters than panicked ones.
ST_VoiceLines.3ED5FE64418130529034EDAC5200792A: Better than a cup of coffee. Not that I would know.

ST_VoiceLines.DF3EB99E4F9C278C59F991880B199FAA: Hmm, no luck? Most of those safes have a numeric override, if that helps.
ST_VoiceLines.9C74E93F4728757241B8B895C617763F: Hmm, these coordinates point to Acerra Spaceport! Now, I just need to pinpoint the exact location.
ST_VoiceLines.55FDA2464D789CF6129E859E29F19E95: Hmm? Oh sure, let me know what you'd like.
ST_VoiceLines.564231E24289D177ABB12CB1412FCABB: Hoist those flags up high, where people can see. Let them remember what it felt like to stand side by side.
ST_VoiceLines.694FB0B642F91B5F5EC00989184CEFF3: Hold on, you’re saying it was downed, but free of bullet holes? And it stripped entire forests?
ST_VoiceLines.31701C1249BFD4505181E0B82491A225: Honestly, lucky you, Raider - you get to assist me today.
ST_VoiceLines.241F1E524D44579F1F58CCBAF888E85F: Honestly, this should be standard equipment for anyone going topside.
ST_VoiceLines.B3074824459083FCB461139F25E5C8D2: Hope you got a good pitching arm.
ST_VoiceLines.8D2F4385458713EA65439BA7BAC6B253: Hope you weren’t planning on sneaking anywhere.
ST_VoiceLines.644BE92540E0E8ECBFFD2CBF2F847151: Hope you're clothed for the season, Raider. It's a good day for picking Candleberries, but do beware of frostbite.
ST_VoiceLines.30F379744CC77A631A8B2AA35583E702: Hope you've mapped your way back first.
ST_VoiceLines.4EE0BEC84003F7CDD6AFB48A30AEB6C9: Hope your wrist’s ready for the kick.
ST_VoiceLines.BA06C70E44AB42E31CBF8CB3F611EE7D: Hope you’ve got gloves and a plan.
ST_VoiceLines.C8E2A5824A4F6C6FA786DFAFFFAF439F: Hope you’ve got room in your pack for that.
ST_VoiceLines.33EB57CE4B4BB7DD376E82AD9732E241: How do you feel about heights? Celeste’s been pestering me about a faulty antenna near the spaceport. The repair job itself shouldn’t be too tricky, but getting there is a bit of a hassle. Do this for me and there are some mod components in it for you.
ST_VoiceLines.DA55214D4C58DAF2F596B8B2677FF5D5: How do you like it here so far? Most people down these parts are pretty nice, but in a colony this big you're bound to run into some bad eggs. Just don't let them get to you.
ST_VoiceLines.1BAF96114CF57EB46E194AB520AA8AA1: How you keeping? Need some grenades?
ST_VoiceLines.7C1C22B042E509DF1BE8428049D9F70F: How's it going with that thing we talked about?
ST_VoiceLines.8A88FE4C43E83A6255AFB989F5553F56: How's it going? Just report to me when it's done.
ST_VoiceLines.101FBFB94D298D5701CA86A7CF70F6E9: Huh, this seems to stem from Project Heartwood. Someone thought this needed to be protected. I take it you already read it? Your cut, as promised.
ST_VoiceLines.BAA61BCF42B942848CAA94B40EE7ED4E: Huh, this seems to stem from Project Heartwood. Someone thought this needed to be protected. I take it you already read it? Your cut, as promised.
ST_VoiceLines.B69FCEE54669BB5BDDDEA7B35FB67172: Huh. I suppose they won’t be stealing from me again, at least. By the way, keep this between us. My drop-offs aren’t exactly sanctioned by Celeste.
ST_VoiceLines.8FA00C8F4C36AB311038E7B6DFAC64AB: I added a nice pine scent to it, just for you.
ST_VoiceLines.5FDBB5954302032FE5181CBF67042051: I always suspected that their cultivation project failed, but they may have been able to salvage something. Let me go through these notes, and get back to you.
ST_VoiceLines.BB2D483447E7FB2706DD1AB3CCA72772: I appreciate you're spending time with me. Just don't forget to pull your weight.
ST_VoiceLines.8380044A410511CA608FCDA3360C2395: I appreciate you. Not too many reliable Raiders left.
ST_VoiceLines.A424749342742971B54A4A9C6F00E4E6: I built these splendid boosters to get a knocked-down Raider back on their feet - but my last prototype came with a nasty shock. I'm pretty sure I fixed it, but I need a brave soul to try out my new model.
ST_VoiceLines.61BE4EBD41AA3AA2DC2D69A65EC497A7: I can hear the cheers from the cantina from here.
ST_VoiceLines.85D8713B4AC4B255409D4286CCB37583: I can patch up most wounds, but a broken heart? That’s gonna cost extra.
ST_VoiceLines.6A8772CE496961260EE40E820A9338C9: I can scarcely believe it, you brought down a Rocketeer! We may stand a chance after all.
ST_VoiceLines.137AB2674DD524A2DF68EF8DDAE0BB96: I can't believe I'm saying this, but: don’t forget to mark out those houses Shani picked, if you’re in the area!
ST_VoiceLines.4B30C6C9494C9F7D63F5DB856C3D54F4: I could’ve been a fashion model, you know.
ST_VoiceLines.3D349A2540D4DF8003CB478729BAB65D: I didn't even know I still had that lying around. Sure, it's all yours.
ST_VoiceLines.B4DED8E04737B0857A2D3DBC6D0C3E49: I do love an attentive audience.
ST_VoiceLines.31167CFF4F5ED000403950B8875368A4: I don't need the legs, the armor, or the gun. Just the Bastion cell. How you get it is your business.
ST_VoiceLines.75A6F5E048078B13820AAFAA8D99D487: I don't usually have time to deal with Raiders one-on-one, but you're always welcome to swing by and drop off seeds.
ST_VoiceLines.5282DE4B47B55A3C0200F7B9068971B7: I don't want to know what you're planning with that.
ST_VoiceLines.DDC4EE1D41F8FE034E22FF852E048F14: I found my original analyzer at a pharmacy in Buried City; see if you can find me a spare, OK friendo?
ST_VoiceLines.A3FFC8F3488A7164446946A82864F888: I found notes that some electrical engineers at the Spaceport were working on advanced, salt-based batteries. If we can get our hands on one, perhaps it’ll prevent full-scale power outages next time a ceiling comes crashing down.
ST_VoiceLines.F349207C406CC4664B229B883DE5F59D: I found out where mum may have bunkered, during the First Wave. Perhaps… Perhaps she left something behind.
ST_VoiceLines.4ACD95D049A1219AC5679DB4D12AEDD2: I gave you a shot. Don’t make me regret it.
ST_VoiceLines.A9A3AB1644CDE7A8171A61A347DFF9D8: I get my wares from all over Toledo. That's as much as I'll say.
ST_VoiceLines.7A620CA3401F94B7D6A238BA6993A35D: I got a plan. If we recover the evidence against the OTTM before they get to it, we might get them off our backs once and for all.
ST_VoiceLines.493F19C247400A23A12E85AD4C1D207D: I got a plan. If we recover the evidence against the tubes management before they get to it, we might get them off our backs once and for all.
ST_VoiceLines.74E1D18F42E83E9C8BCBE9BE9DCBE555: I got my hands full, so no rush with that distiller. Would be great to finish my designs, though.
ST_VoiceLines.4EA3E8B54A3ABE7A52260F82B38BCE98: I got my hands on a fancy new ESR analyzer; had a whole big reveal planned. One minute it’s here, next minute—poof. Please help?
ST_VoiceLines.FD97E80841A28FB6B0B9BF9138580151: I had Lance run some tests on the water sample you brought back, and the results are not great. This goes beyond natural contaminants.
ST_VoiceLines.18EA6C2746A9ACD61E3A0A999EC778CF: I had a deal for a Bastion Cell lined up with a Raider called Dodger, but he's gone quiet. I need someone to track down his stash before some scavenger stumbles into it. Interested?
ST_VoiceLines.A068575A45A6C9F4720B4DB7971C4848: I have a map of the Spaceport right here, but I’m not fully certain where those coordinates point to. Try... Heading to the southwest, where the Fuel Lines got snapped.
ST_VoiceLines.170ECC8846A3453194FEDFA4B9EFC4BC: I have a map of the Spaceport right here, but I’m not fully certain where those coordinates point. Try heading to where the Fuel Lines got snapped. Oh, and prepare for things to get loud.
ST_VoiceLines.58F28CAA4D5E514927D4E6BC7CF830E9: I have another job. It’s.. about my mom. Those First Wave sites I sent you to before? I actually hoped you’d find something of my mother’s. She fought in the Raider resistance. It was a long shot; but now I've got an actual lead.
ST_VoiceLines.0B8EEA3C4C38AA5032E595B2FFAFB306: I have another job. It’s.. about my mum. Those First Wave sites I sent you to before? I actually hoped you’d find something of my mother’s. She fought in the Raider resistance. It was a long shot; but now I've got an actual lead.
ST_VoiceLines.7CD30F3446EACD2517EA228FF4BCEB36: I have another special site I need you to search for me. An old battlegrounds, from the First Wave. Raiders nowadays usually pick places like that clean, despite the significance they once held. People forget quickly. Quicker than they should.
ST_VoiceLines.C12E686F487697FF0C5FE7B2A9A796D4: I have equipment set up at the Spaceport, to monitor ARC’s movements. My connection broke down just now, I need you to head to the Control Towers and help me retrieve my logs.
ST_VoiceLines.F6491373427AB908FD6931A9882F8031: I have everything I need behind this door.
ST_VoiceLines.503F0B0B497DA4999F36A9944628EB75: I have more work for you, if you want it. The ARC behaviors you reported earlier align with my previous observations. There’s a pattern here... I need someone to locate one of the crashed probes. Crack one open, see what's inside, and report your findings to me.
ST_VoiceLines.9EC0F1D742E3AA811BA964BC339C72E4: I have overclocked my internal processors to simulate coziness.
ST_VoiceLines.6094B53348B12F1F857588A9BF108A1A: I have to admit I didn’t expect much to be left. Maybe people missed these, or maybe they didn’t care. It’s not what I’m looking for, but I appreciate it. I’ll make sure they’re looked after properly.
ST_VoiceLines.6DD345E0435302400990338B1E009CCE: I haven't heard much about you. That's a compliment.
ST_VoiceLines.2E935D7C4C8620D0F00D578B49D43466: I haven't seen a storm like that in a long time. Seems to have thrown ARC for a loop, too.
ST_VoiceLines.2946E72B49876393DBA7CBA663E96D23: I haven’t heard anything about my booby trap going off, which is good. But, I also haven’t heard anything about you disarming it, which is bad.
ST_VoiceLines.56DF83F140B5E03537C251BE2E151983: I hear Shani sleeps below a reinforced table, these days; if she sleeps at all. We’ll need to reinforce this place, and we’ll need to do it soon.
ST_VoiceLines.5A6C04274F0159BBC22FD0B41F42C447: I hear the sound of rumbling stomachs in my dreams.
ST_VoiceLines.F2DC7F8F489C006C6EA7FA98C2D99F72: I heard a story from an older Raider that came through here a while back. Something about the ground rumbling and mountains spewing fire. I hope he was just making things up, because I do NOT want to experience THAT!
ST_VoiceLines.B53FB7C8420F1EEC4912D89A373538DD: I heard just now that there's a hydraulic leak on one of the elevators in the Spaceport. It's still functional, but we should nip it in the bud before it gets worse. You up for it?
ST_VoiceLines.13642EAB409FCF625BAE7A9C7603DACF: I heard rumors about some signal Shani picked up. ARC is constantly adapting, and I'm sure this won’t be their last warning sign. Well, if it’s an arms race they want, they can get one.
ST_VoiceLines.5F48A9C446D0181BCB67FE88DD337430: I heard stories of bees when I was a kid. They fly around and help plants grow even better. Nasty sting though, but potentially worth it if we can use them to improve our crops.
ST_VoiceLines.37407E1C47116A09D9B05C8A3ED55D8E: I heard that whistling while working helps with keeping a good rhythm. I'll have to try it sometime.
ST_VoiceLines.714E37704F08F1D3E20DA299F4D491ED: I hope those nasty things didn’t give you too much trouble.
ST_VoiceLines.B9F7DA494E26C9FF48AA7C983C92778F: I hope you haven’t forgotten about the small exchange we spoke of earlier?
ST_VoiceLines.A7C2E90F4BCCD255E9E83199591EE841: I hope you're using these chemicals for something useful.
ST_VoiceLines.CD6184B746885D8300D5A997939FB412: I just heard about the trouble with the Tubes. I’ll see what I can do on our end, but you might have more luck fixing it yourself if you’re able.
ST_VoiceLines.A0EF4ABB470E3FDB5808DF8D48CF776D: I just need you to establish a brief connection, so I can get to my logs. Here’s the key to the room — keep it in a safe place.
ST_VoiceLines.85702E0B49153C41DE260188C420776B: I just treated one of the first Raiders who visited Stella Montis, and she said that she saw... others. Androids, very much like me.
ST_VoiceLines.8920225A4E511824315BA1BE2CE80440: I keep the door shut for a reason. Don’t give me more reasons.
ST_VoiceLines.89C6D7B1403E7641BED5D890192913BB: I kinda need your help with something. Don't tell anyone.
ST_VoiceLines.BA518776440670B306B30792EF78E208: I know that look. That’s a job well-done.
ST_VoiceLines.429CC527475270FC38E6C7A3DF9D8BCB: I know that look. You’ve done it.
ST_VoiceLines.192277AF4F0ED7C4A375E5A944CE2C62: I know they don't look like much, but you won't find better explosives anywhere else in Toledo. I promise.
ST_VoiceLines.D09BB9034395F0A08F3291AC479E9C9E: I know they don't look like much, but you won't find better explosives anywhere else in this colony. I promise.
ST_VoiceLines.65892575406BE797432B6BA0B36497FF: I know you can hear the sweet call of those calibration devices, but be careful if you’re heading up the towers. The closer you get, the more action you’re likely to find.
ST_VoiceLines.4333B2254BF18E3ADDA583AF0F38E6E9: I know you want to bask in my presence. But please get back to finishing that task first.
ST_VoiceLines.A7CCC7A548589C7AB579229045497A33: I know you're here for the reward, but know that you're making a difference all the same.
ST_VoiceLines.FE9FD47842CCC2F2C0B405BE4E1B4DCA: I know, I know! The power's down in sector—Oh, hey. A flash flood took out some of our solar panels in Buried City, and the generators only hold on for so long. Do us all a solid when you're up there, OK?
ST_VoiceLines.C2B0F51747666504686DDCB930E68730: I like this. The back-and-forth. Very "best buddies" energy.
ST_VoiceLines.647FBBE2415C12076B014FB969A932CF: I lost my cool a bit when I sent you after that trap. I don’t usually lose my temper, but the First Wave… We went through a lot, back then. Lost a lot of people. It’s still a bit of a raw wound for me, but I want you to understand.
ST_VoiceLines.F2CA0426452C9853E8F6EB91DE50C65F: I need the best, which, of course, is you. Your skills are vastly inferior, but at least you pay attention to me.
ST_VoiceLines.BEBCDE9C45BD9987A9EA87AF1C99D96B: I need you to examine the shoreline; see if we have to worry about flooding, on top of everything else.
ST_VoiceLines.7A93972649D655E87A6D2D8416B902F5: I need you to scope out the ENELICA buildings around the Rust Belt for any data on earthquake-resistant housing.
ST_VoiceLines.95B32E9A448FB4A6E66F18B6DBFB88C9: I need you to scope out these three potential salvage sites. If any of them pan out, Tian Wen may just warm up to us.
ST_VoiceLines.679213A5483FE073AA00B396296FB76B: I once saw someone build a weapon trigger out of this. It worked. Once.
ST_VoiceLines.A16404D4425A4C1D5E25E1B2A6BB301C: I once saw someone sitting in a creek playing one of those. I got out of there immediately.
ST_VoiceLines.25C027EF4255BC0FA8B87FBCA4E6E120: I once set one of these off in a cantina by accident. The staff was not happy with me.
ST_VoiceLines.8342880C48C473376AFA51B1296E2C1A: I once treated someone for overthinking. True story.
ST_VoiceLines.D3E939394937C6C38CA5729B0B08BC90: I prepped a celebration and everything. Balloons. Disco ball. You’re killing the momentum.
ST_VoiceLines.2883520149DDB75A08CFFD88CDE698FB: I remember Bilguun mentioning a hideout over by the highway once. Look for a place with a view.
ST_VoiceLines.A28E6A3B485F4010FBCAB4BEBD7CC20D: I saw one Raider use this in the middle of a cantina. They had to use a ladder to get him down from the ceiling fan.
ST_VoiceLines.B041055B41C67AC3E446ABB23B493F60: I saw this old advert that said “The only way to cure a broken heart is to see the bottom of the ice cream container”. Ahh, one can only hope that the sight can soothe this broken heart.
ST_VoiceLines.898A22D946E187EF189DAFA42DD3EC20: I see. Flown the coop, has he? Life in Toledo might not be for everyone, but it sure beats the alternative… Thank you.
ST_VoiceLines.5FD5D1FA4868E31B5EBDE4BB13FF23F7: I see. I’ll.. need some time to process this data. Thank you, friend.
ST_VoiceLines.05E980F44FA0CB18085F39818EA260FE: I see. Looks like they were actually trying to cultivate an entirely new species.
ST_VoiceLines.609146AC4CB29A566006D8BEDF95FC0E: I see. Yes, that makes sense.
ST_VoiceLines.280AC1874D39529BB96F2E96ED467315: I see. You can keep everything you found—just don’t tell Celeste you’ve been rummaging around them on my behalf, alright? I don’t need her to breathe down my neck. I have some other places in mind too, so come back soon if you want to pocket some more coin.
ST_VoiceLines.9DFECE3C4A2105F64B34B38F39AC0004: I sent a scout team to the Spaceport a while ago. Routine work — cataloging security, see if there's anything we could re-purpose. But I've heard nothing for two days.
ST_VoiceLines.B3E52B964C79BD65C3A0FABB795F5EC1: I should get a better chair, I think.
ST_VoiceLines.A9B387FC4ED12D97911E169DF52D4871: I should get some goggles, or something.
ST_VoiceLines.4D8DD53645958EF1AF4B04ACB525F887: I suppose these could come in handy when you're creating your own gear.
ST_VoiceLines.02B826B944A5E87F0BB471A614A662EB: I swear I fixed this thing already.
ST_VoiceLines.D3BA9230476FD4C33D828C83DEDF03EA: I swear, around here, no one seems to know the first thing about taking care of themselves.
ST_VoiceLines.B073BF15421481D944AE52A733ABAAA8: I think I've found something we might exploit. When bigger ARC machines are just far enough from each other, a well-timed distraction could pull one out of position. You want to test that idea?
ST_VoiceLines.01861D85404993276D633F86F01EE0C5: I think we can help each other out. That sounds good, right?
ST_VoiceLines.F073CEA9457A3CF3F8BBA89EA3B6235B: I tracked down some calibration devices, the kind you won’t just find lying around most places. If we’re lucky, they’ll be up there.
ST_VoiceLines.D2545ED24495FA0328588C99F52DA8B6: I tried organizing the shelves once. Took me a week to find anything after.
ST_VoiceLines.75662B8349FF65D3E85D9787288F55F7: I tried to make it play a song, once.
ST_VoiceLines.7044133E4A2739DCF64312AF92D5312F: I tried to rig up my own homemade pair of roller skates. Ended up breaking one of the greenhouse windows, but they worked for a little while.
ST_VoiceLines.E8F044B44FF0D78BEC3D3D900D072B99: I want you to snap me a pic of some real pretty vistas I’ve scoped out across the Rust Belt. I’m making a collage.
ST_VoiceLines.1219B86B49B370ED046F16B146FBE0BF: I wanted to call these Push Mines. But the names preferred by Raiders tend to stick.
ST_VoiceLines.AEB0507A4B354A792E0D2E8093D6FB01: I was thinking of cleaning up in here, but I think the clutter adds character.
ST_VoiceLines.E98D4150428D72FE4CD1949F7D7DBD13: I was thinking of painting the walls mauve. You think mauve says "trustworthy medic"?
ST_VoiceLines.35AEAF2A4512CCCD9A4004B2311C20CD: I wish Apollo would spend less time tinkering with explosives, and more time figuring out a way to plow the soil.
ST_VoiceLines.1E215B054B97A7AC24F5FA878A014DE3: I wish the other neighborhoods would maintain their Slingshot stations half as well as we do ours.
ST_VoiceLines.91529AAB4AEB0BCFED8588B554BFA4A0: I wish we had the resources to teach everyone about what it was like, back then. Why this all matters.
ST_VoiceLines.80C9BB9542F3DEF7889141BC5A423F3C: I wonder if we can make a cheaper variant of this. Like a grenade wrapped in duct tape.
ST_VoiceLines.CE24C93749F4176F48B15497C00BA7C2: I wonder why a Spaceport would need a medical room…
ST_VoiceLines.BA8F1E1F40B15D6927526A8419FCAAEB: I would do it myself but now I don’t need to. Here’s your cut.
ST_VoiceLines.2097DD2148305704671533A131828201: I wouldn't trust a grenade put together by anyone else but me.
ST_VoiceLines.74B67C7D4EC74C3AD50401B38A40273F: I wouldn’t be wandering around out in the open if I were you. You may not be made of metal, but you won’t take kindly to getting struck by lightning.
ST_VoiceLines.50B019F64DD2F00937A6EB8806E666B0: I'd do it myself, but someone's gotta run this place.
ST_VoiceLines.E744FCB24589E75DBC6BEA9A12AA3061: I'd get out there myself, but I got too much to do here.
ST_VoiceLines.9388D77D44638EEF110FD7A0F466DA92: I'd love to put you to work, but not right now.
ST_VoiceLines.BFB5933C4A76E730680152A0B482A915: I'd love to take my eyes off the screens, but I can't just now.
ST_VoiceLines.451A1C5446DED86742DC6DBDE99BBD34: I'd offer you a coffee, but I just drank my last cup.
ST_VoiceLines.5EF1644A474C729728808B992DEE5BB0: I'd offer you a drink, but I'm fresh out. Maybe I'll see you at the cantina later.
ST_VoiceLines.BEF561E04BBBBD50A046DA86ED4D9168: I'd say "Come get them while they're hot", but if any of my grenades are hot to the touch, please evacuate immediately.
ST_VoiceLines.6A0400944314E4F01778678CB64C8E5E: I'd start checking the water distillation system in the underground tunnels. Should be a lot to learn there for my own designs.
ST_VoiceLines.46D14A9743FB072C7936AD99F8534A42: I'd start looking around the industrial areas by the Dam. Get me what I need, and I'll see to those living spaces.
ST_VoiceLines.51A122C2422FEB5A1F5A98B644EF8B4B: I'll be honest, Raider: we called it an outpost, but it was more of a hideout, really. See if the tremors revealed any of our old battle plans. We need to learn from the past now more than ever.
ST_VoiceLines.8D5C793647407331F3FCCAA0E7081D33: I'll be waiting here, keeping the colony's medical standards from slipping into chaos.
ST_VoiceLines.93F3F5B548B001E5676A258FD8C68E5F: I'll have to mark you down as a regular at this rate, my friend.
ST_VoiceLines.5820941F4D3BADE85AFAB1B1F5929B7D: I'll keep you in mind if anything shows up, but right now I don't have anything I need help with.
ST_VoiceLines.E47037064EA2503F793F72BF8F344CD6: I'll lend you an ear, if you lend me some progress.
ST_VoiceLines.08A41ACC40CD9FFB3417BAB60B3CB013: I'm almost jealous of you. Always wanted to try one of these.
ST_VoiceLines.EBA3B6264825FC779319E0AEC4B6D699: I'm just happy we're no longer mixing in sawdust with the flour.
ST_VoiceLines.D19EBFCB49A10ADAFBDF3E8FA2CD3D33: I'm kind of in a hurry so... help yourself...
ST_VoiceLines.9BD2EE134832CEAD0FAD76BF23DE8ED4: I'm meeting Apollo for a drink, later. Just the one drink — his.
ST_VoiceLines.248717884170342038B21190E819DBBA: I'm not opening this door. Just tell me what you want.
ST_VoiceLines.ACA226EC43EE4DAE23629EADB5BA1C1B: I'm sure you will like that.
ST_VoiceLines.0CB67C6F40752CF3842D0C956751A212: I'm swamped right now but I'll let you know if I need you.
ST_VoiceLines.5494D0C64FB6C6D14C958EAE2FAECB86: I'm thinking of making a variant that deploys a nice scent instead of gas. Not sure there's a market for it though.
ST_VoiceLines.C51DA8C5451CC13DF53AAA95ECFDEC96: I'm working on some exciting new stuff, but right now these fine babies are the only ones I got for sale.
ST_VoiceLines.275B9C0F45042063E671B09A04ECC989: I've almost wrapped up my end of the greenhouse work, but I still have a bit left. All of this extra legwork has put me behind on my weapon orders, though. You don't look particularly busy, so why don't you handle one for me?
ST_VoiceLines.B9CADF49413AD69D44C97184416BB900: I've been trying to make a smaller version, for parties and such.
ST_VoiceLines.A781EA8F460EFA08E0F3DE967F533472: I've been working on a new scanning tool that sends back data from the field. See if you can ping some of the machines around Topside, then report back to me.
ST_VoiceLines.5E6967B744A44E09E070C288F06A538B: I've just so happen to acquire the finest medical equipment for you, personally. After all, you're going to need someone with my exceptional talent to keep you from falling apart.
ST_VoiceLines.DE9359434C5E55BB2620A0B0A7D0960A: If I don't have what you need, have a look around the market.
ST_VoiceLines.4983327C48219B442C06D29C6DC278A7: If I get any better at small talk, I’m going to need to open a side business.
ST_VoiceLines.123E70FC4A21FF4732DEF59D502F109E: If I had a watch, I’d check it. Dramatically.
ST_VoiceLines.BE32092E48801E878CF116958FBECA20: If I look busy, I am. But it’s fine.
ST_VoiceLines.47B7F54F4CBF452C6E2F73A0E5EA0E69: If I see as much as a hint of googly eyes, I will shoot you through the door slot.
ST_VoiceLines.BD8286C345218315B45D02BE8C81B26C: If I wanted window shopping, I'd have windows installed.
ST_VoiceLines.ABD76F394AAD4C1FB5B02FAE0C3A0F4B: If I was human, I'd be dozing off by now.
ST_VoiceLines.981ED9E246557654593DC7AAC68AFB3E: If Topside was safer, we could make a tidy business with those. For sightseeing, you know.
ST_VoiceLines.F091D30B422ED7148E60E18D009F520A: If anyone wonders, I’m busy. Doing… things.
ST_VoiceLines.257275F24E28D5F4595624AE4046CE6E: If it looks like it mattered to someone, grab it. Don’t break it. This isn’t salvage.
ST_VoiceLines.9D667FAD4473289913CBFA80A466A0BD: If it whirs, beeps, or explodes, you’ll probably find it here.
ST_VoiceLines.FA7F3276448AF3DE7409B4A68D6F05A9: If only my radars could track what the lot of you are up to.
ST_VoiceLines.915BDEAD48D150CF03BDFBB2F36DDBFF: If that doesn’t help, I’ll eat my shoe... If I had one.
ST_VoiceLines.30E2F5A648D6B6FEEF36909C0034BFC3: If that malfunctions, let me know.
ST_VoiceLines.D63EED15434A48C477445D86AE2D74B8: If that task’s done, I’ve got your thank-you package ready.
ST_VoiceLines.983CBB9A4FABB0B132C618A0EF29FBBA: If the data you found can keep the ceiling from collapsing, we have no time to spare. I know of a few magnetic decryptors around Acerra Spaceport, from back during the Exodus. They might still be working.
ST_VoiceLines.1A8C5106480EF86F3B98ABA5499FFB82: If the researchers had to meet in secret like this, it sounds like whatever they were discussing wasn’t exactly approved by the higher-ups.
ST_VoiceLines.D15AF6B64C24C04C6AEF0ABFD7ACA1EC: If there are others like me, do you think they’d know my name…? Would they understand me?
ST_VoiceLines.5E9FE0FF4E1F02D43798889FA3D319DC: If there’s one thing I’ve learned, it’s that locked doors tend to guard the tastiest hauls.
ST_VoiceLines.E884E67840B219CF7FAC148290AFE077: If there’s still life in the Barons after all these years, these parts must contain a wealth of valuable data. I’ll get them analyzed; see what we can find.
ST_VoiceLines.1271F85647E562E91AF4CF895BA92DA2: If they hear this, you’ve already messed up.
ST_VoiceLines.EC631E3D4C0B79588426419501A53CB6: If this is a long con, it’s got great pacing. Terrible delivery.
ST_VoiceLines.C229109745FD797D1FA109B093D20B8F: If this is your idea of a dramatic pause, I'm not a fan.
ST_VoiceLines.6F5A775F45AC0ADB2EFE7B9F416A0E77: If this starts hissing before you deploy it, just chuck it.
ST_VoiceLines.8250DF884841A2509B7CFEAD744CCC0F: If this was a staring contest, you’d win.
ST_VoiceLines.06F021E04AEF4D279B637F8BBE20B9E9: If we’ve learned anything from dormant-looking ARC machines, it’s to anticipate a good scorching.
ST_VoiceLines.A1E80E294CD9FECC03F16E848FDA286E: If you can find a working salt battery prototype, we might just be able to reverse engineer the design.
ST_VoiceLines.3B9F88EC462BDD382E1FB18D4F1C5E03: If you can find out about the foreman’s reconstruction project, perhaps we’ll learn more about why Project Heartwood got canceled.
ST_VoiceLines.F813943E4CBC1CCB00132CBEC67EFABF: If you can find out about the foreman’s reconstruction project, perhaps we’ll learn more about why Project Heartwood got canceled.
ST_VoiceLines.DC7B82964D7BC98C0F8C009A501709BE: If you can get your hands on one of Lance's limbs, I'm pretty sure I could find you a seller.
ST_VoiceLines.95BEA97B4EE35FEE439BC0B11DD14528: If you ever get tired of being a Raider, you’ve got a steady spot here in my workshop.
ST_VoiceLines.58AF893F42503E086EF4F39F659A78EB: If you find any weapons just laying around, I'm always on the lookout.
ST_VoiceLines.6D4EE37046999B5BDE30ADBE99042B00: If you got the know-how and the proper workbench, you can make most of these things yourself. Not that I mind your patronage, of course.
ST_VoiceLines.62ED946240E65AAF8D88A0902F268DD9: If you happen to, lets say, get your hands on another Raider's equipment up there, I'd be more than happy to buy it off you.
ST_VoiceLines.5379FE284863CCB20839F5B0D53ECEBC: If you hear a faint ticking, it’s fine. Probably fine.
ST_VoiceLines.D73E4CCC40EE6535207AD09055B5873F: If you lose that, you know where to find me.
ST_VoiceLines.3D931C6A4C481976952879802BE49E08: If you lose those scanners, you should be able to find more in the Flight Control Building by the Spaceport.
ST_VoiceLines.568AE84A4B40C003035BDE8300501E8D: If you managed to weather that storm, a supply run should be no bother at all.
ST_VoiceLines.D251D2594E337AF7F38E38A3A7D8CE9A: If you need better guns, go see Tian Wen. Just don't let her talk you into her schemes.
ST_VoiceLines.1E380AB44A22EE90E5CC78AE6898D1A2: If you need more grenades, you can always build an Explosives Station in your workshop.
ST_VoiceLines.F9AE18414E66B7164DF8BB9C84DCED07: If you run out of bullets, there's often ways to improvise; provided you're creative enough.
ST_VoiceLines.2C20879A436DD86223680CAF7789475D: If you see dust, ignore it. It’s just atmosphere.
ST_VoiceLines.0A8B80274C677E8FE99F148761844084: If you see or hear anything strange while on the surface - inform Shani immediately.
ST_VoiceLines.4FC33B1F4835AC5D2D8C749DCB38596D: If you spot a crate, deliver it to a nearby Field Depot. My team will take care of the rest.
ST_VoiceLines.907B011143F5647E20FBC8985BD05562: If you spot anything that'll save your hide, be sure to ask.
ST_VoiceLines.DFC21FA94E10B77D1DE0B09528FBE8FC: If you spot one of the Surveyors, try to stun it before you engage. They’re said to be full of rare ARC tech, so we might both come out of this ahead.
ST_VoiceLines.E55E9B464D9762A4202E5BB99630C973: If you're going out searching for Candleberries, now's a good time. But it's freezing cold outside so beware of frostbite.
ST_VoiceLines.2CDF636C497C4F6549E18DAE38ED4DE4: If you're going up against Rocketeers, this is a good start. Stay mobile, though.
ST_VoiceLines.E3EA0F924927EF5D151955ADAF902840: If you're here to think, this is a good spot for it.
ST_VoiceLines.75603B794B5DC59D71E38AA614EF8FFA: If you're looking for company, just pick a cantina.
ST_VoiceLines.4F76ECAF43A374EE4CD9CCA05FF381AC: If you're looking to chat, Apollo is more than happy.
ST_VoiceLines.402FD1FF443C6B4AECFB4EA5F3C1A335: If you're near the Spaceport I got a tip. Someone's locked down the Outskirts Bunker with four remote lock controls. Take care of the locks and grab whatever's in the bunker before anyone else gets to it first.
ST_VoiceLines.38AE2785412971ACD6B50CBCD0ED00F1: If you're waiting for applause, try somewhere else.
ST_VoiceLines.2BB4C2CA4B1A5361037B2B85C335B9ED: If you’re after that power rod I need, start by looking around the Generator Hall.
ST_VoiceLines.2332A0DE4729B26E76E1F1AFD6320EFC: If you’re done, I’ve got something worth your time.
ST_VoiceLines.F4B2E86E44B84426896DA2B056786C88: If you’re here for a chat, I’m fresh out of small talk and patience.
ST_VoiceLines.FC5710D248EA34E82F14DF9189CCE40C: If you’re here for business, let’s get on with it.
ST_VoiceLines.052F16CA4E1E458DEFAF1789C11D042F: If you’re here to buy, fine. Just don’t loiter. I’ve got ARC signals to monitor.
ST_VoiceLines.EA8878434BB2EDF9AD2F6F82F8F6D8F2: If you’re here to complain about the water, join the club. I’ve been fielding complaints all day. Something is definitely up with it, and I need some help to sort it out.
ST_VoiceLines.FFDDD1A9490FC3D64FB7839DB93D1167: If you’re hoping I’ll forget the task, I assure you I won’t.
ST_VoiceLines.43C8A860484E25F39ED1D2B8382E9B6A: If you’re looking for inspiration, I’ve got plenty on the shelves.
ST_VoiceLines.6C8C15D240E9D7D62C1A879D8FD6C9F6: If you’re not done, why are you here?
ST_VoiceLines.7FDE12BE49BA9881F63A918DB9DC2F4B: If you’re stalling, I respect it. But I will sass you.
ST_VoiceLines.B76193654F1E951328200C9D89E1F2E7: If you’ve lost the key to the room, you might find a new one around the offices at the Spaceport.
ST_VoiceLines.BC24CA7747512F93F6EEA7BC13AA9E0A: Imagine my surprise when Tian Wen decides to leave her hidey-hole to come talk to me. She admitted to rewiring solar panels for her own gain, and she even mentioned a certain Raider helping her.
ST_VoiceLines.B885EC9447DBF16EC89299B851ABA1C6: Important heads-up to all Raiders. We are about to shut down the South elevator. If you plan to use it, now is the time.
ST_VoiceLines.A567146B4574C1664B162592846BB2DA: In my day, we got it done first, then wandered around.
ST_VoiceLines.F18A130B40A86C3F4F2D198FC0F4AB38: Intel’s all well and good, but it only gets us so far. If ARC’s truly closing in, I need every Raider to prove they can handle their drones in a fight.
ST_VoiceLines.8368BBD64769266498D402B6496198B2: Is Shani with you? No? Good. Do whatever you Raiders do and get me the parts.
ST_VoiceLines.179B8E51408C065F737B6DB28615D07C: Is that my pizza? Oh, it's you.
ST_VoiceLines.3668EDBB49E8379E024B57925CAD7B7D: Is that sand in your hair from the storm, or just a bold fashion choice?
ST_VoiceLines.F18A1D3C4AAE158096DAD98AD4C4C526: Is that… A Matriarch? I’d tread very, very carefully. If you want to get anywhere near her, you’ll have to get past her children, first.
ST_VoiceLines.631613D64054F00B0E721889D344B327: Is that… Did you do it?
ST_VoiceLines.8A6E78F44F916886FA54E2AB2BCC9D55: It all seems connected somehow… but how?
ST_VoiceLines.9DF33E7F4D0D2A79125F509FA48FA218: It can be hard to hear the tremors over all the petty squabbling, but I assure you: they're there.
ST_VoiceLines.0D1867C64D00798434306AA8FA58CE71: It can take weeks for seeds to germinate, but just a split second for a crop to be decimated.
ST_VoiceLines.CE20B49A4674922F03148DBD6E9BE027: It seems the staff shuttle buses were a hotspot for mutiny recruitment. There should be a few by the southern gate.
ST_VoiceLines.97D45A504D1C49369572E4B39B8A2D04: It seems the staff shuttle buses were a hotspot for mutiny recruitment. There should be a few by the western gate.
ST_VoiceLines.F975D2174AFCC7352D5C57A0E89C9CBD: It used to be madness, to take on a Leaper head-on. But now? I think we might just have what it takes.
ST_VoiceLines.C9D2117B4AFDA00481503DA0D4500D3A: It used to be their world, up there. Nobody to challenge their claim. Yet here we are. More outposts. More intel. More firepower. If I didn’t know better, I’d say we’ve got quite a bit of fight left in us.
ST_VoiceLines.43EA4BB54B4C46E6D0D4C1B89E9FCB48: It was one thing when we thought they were just mining, but for them to be after organic material, too… An unsettling thought.
ST_VoiceLines.5AC6308A474D3BDFA5F3E49C00F838A7: It's a miracle I've managed to keep this Speranza's population from imploding. You see I'm running on fumes in here.
ST_VoiceLines.8C6A2CE74B35BFC4F084B1B986CBA238: It's all about volume. Try to aim in bursts.
ST_VoiceLines.18FB4B3E4538C61877A86CA5FC57755B: It's bad enough when they get near my snacks, but I really don't need them gnawing at my explosives.
ST_VoiceLines.3083412443A51F29DC1ED2A9C9B6C356: It's great that you ask. I don't have any jobs for you at the moment, but I'll definitely keep you in mind.
ST_VoiceLines.8568F85444E64C648B3591B3B54AA170: It's hard enough keeping the other neighborhoods in check as-is; we can't go adding a famine to the mix.
ST_VoiceLines.296134D64A33F57008CDCBA8DAF4C941: It's hard remembering faces when people wear their helmets indoors.
ST_VoiceLines.F099AD834AB92886A905DDB3495EB482: It's not just support beams keeping this place from collapsing, you know.
ST_VoiceLines.5FFD62904A912DF80C7C26809E7EE0D2: It's one thing to survive; it's another to thrive. We've been trying to get beyond the bare minimum for a while now.
ST_VoiceLines.1C2C74AC455A7CFE24DDA98BA96BB1EA: It's perfectly safe for humans. I should know, I tried it on myself.
ST_VoiceLines.1D09777B4EA74C2E4109FFAE29187172: It's something you can help with.
ST_VoiceLines.41770BF044824892D2CB26A3D182738D: It’s a small fix - just some faulty wires that need replacing.
ST_VoiceLines.38E8DF6E40854C4B105B1C822720497A: It’s a step in the right direction, to be sure. Whether it’ll last… We’ll have to find out. Thanks, in any case.
ST_VoiceLines.8CC296B544B6A18843CEF3B4642EF68D: It’s always one thing after another with this place.
ST_VoiceLines.E20AD70A4A6AE36F2E7B3E9457B91D4B: It’s always “please fix this hole in my chest, Lance,” but never “here's a nice cup of tea!” Fine—marvelous company like me can do better, anyway. I have some splendid friends hanging around topside; bring them here, will you?
ST_VoiceLines.C070E7AA42930B10D5B595AE70712B34: It’s clear some of the researchers had doubts about what was going on. Most of the communication seems to have happened in person—you’ll need to look for traces inside.
ST_VoiceLines.B6D4AF774616A2616C64A987FADCE5C3: It’s fine if you do smaller repairs by yourself. No need for engineers, armed escorts, and… Yeah, best not to think too deeply about that for now.
ST_VoiceLines.152B6FFF495B919939537BA3ABDC7BBF: It’s just been on my mind. We had Barons in that area for years until they stopped showing up. Now we’re seeing what appear to be new ARC that haven’t previously been sighted around here. Why is that? And what does it mean for the future?
ST_VoiceLines.1D9494394B4BD940697E95B86E716BC9: It’s not glamorous, but it works.
ST_VoiceLines.BE655ACC4E0768F024932882CD53E1AA: It’s not just ARC's operations that are escalating; it’s the weather, too. I’ll bet you my favorite wrench the two are connected.
ST_VoiceLines.5F6E281F440AA8A127A1938344CA4DCD: It’s not often I get my hands on Surveyor data, but I'd bet my hat this is tied to that signal we heard before. We’ll get to deciphering; thanks, Raider.
ST_VoiceLines.31D292F640DF8257995840ACF547BC05: It’s quite the spectacle, all that candlelight! Just… Keep ‘em at a safe distance, OK?
ST_VoiceLines.6549E3424F407B2224AAB59C81251676: It’s that time of the year again, huh?
ST_VoiceLines.338E85A6444D1BE5FEA3FEAB840DFDA5: It’s true that I can’t taste the stew, but I deeply admire its viscosity nonetheless!
ST_VoiceLines.D7F6BA1B43CB585FC56707A0A84E1F76: I’d almost keep that for myself… almost.
ST_VoiceLines.E11AF6B34F60B90C8DD4DFBE1E89244E: I’d be a lot more into stargazing if it’d get me some solid, verifiable data.
ST_VoiceLines.5EDF5D4947E2FC4126A616B9912BB0FF: I’d sterilise that if I were you.
ST_VoiceLines.B6D5D52B433F248B863DB498A95CC0A8: I’d suggest keeping your weapon at the ready. Ticks can be rather… intrusive.
ST_VoiceLines.4878591E4AC8A7BD197C488284C63708: I’d thank you for finishing it. But I’ll wait until you actually say so.
ST_VoiceLines.50B6193A494982E3A5B1039734BFC277: I’ll ask some engineers to help fix what you found… Thank you.
ST_VoiceLines.1CFC4DE541CC43D0AF635B9F4DE6C623: I’ll be here when you’re ready.
ST_VoiceLines.0C6DAC3947FD31314154448AE53B7673: I’ll be here, doing the best I can with what I have.
ST_VoiceLines.4715E50D4FAD1CE9AD15CA8242287A7B: I’ll cut to the chase; I have a number of stashes topside. For emergencies, let’s say. Someone got me the contents of one of them a while ago, but I forgot to disable the booby trap attached to it. See the problem?
ST_VoiceLines.2ABEEE5D41C9484BDE200BA775EB73BA: I’ll just keep an eye on things.
ST_VoiceLines.854B2E794A5D8FD6CEAEE9833881909D: I’ll keep it short. What do you need?
ST_VoiceLines.738BB2A14ACEF1FA1907AD981DB97332: I’ll keep working until you decide.
ST_VoiceLines.E4B2CD65480A15095F4308A439C79162: I’ll need intrepid friends like yourself, who can get me the finest medical goods Topside has to offer. Whether you want to hang them on the inside of a trench coat, is your call to make.
ST_VoiceLines.8A3493EF4D43F4C0A703219A622D2F59: I’ll try to pinpoint where the hearing aids are stored. Head up there, and transmit your location to help me triangulate.
ST_VoiceLines.460CBE50451D0A56E080098CE287606F: I’m looking for someone. Bilguun. You might’ve seen him around, but chances are you haven’t. He’s… not the most sociable person around, you see.He spends a lot of time Topside, but usually returns to Speranza regularly to check in.
ST_VoiceLines.408B02554D1946F9EDC60D96996B6268: I’m looking into it. Until I know more, assume you’ll need to handle the repairs yourselves.
ST_VoiceLines.51529C1A485AFB20559351970DA4F2D0: I’m not much for praise, but you’re proving reliable.
ST_VoiceLines.C1D30570493001044B5DF9B0349DB607: I’m not opening the door. Even if you did impress me a little.
ST_VoiceLines.3EB89D97444FA6F1CC987C8DD01BF847: I’m not saying our water’s been tampered with, but based on your samples, I can’t rule out the possibility either. Would you return to the Dam and see what’s wrong?
ST_VoiceLines.7CE759A74390DB3291254A93DC628C7D: I’m not sure what’s been going on around here lately, but it’s been a long time since Celeste has asked me for a favor. You ever visit the top of the Spaceport towers? If not, do you want to?
ST_VoiceLines.25D4A51A4E311A2AD4399C8D5C3A4CD5: I’m setting up a greenhouse, to help boost our food production. I’m doing Celeste a solid, alright? That’s all. But enough about that. I’ve got all the details worked out, but I’ll need supplies, and I’m not hauling them alone.
ST_VoiceLines.04AFB25C4EED690245BA0DBD59E0EF27: I’m still sorting through the data you found in Stella Montis, but something’s caught my eye. I’d like you to look into it.
ST_VoiceLines.04D035E74E970753577AC691D2683866: I’m sure Bilguun is fine; he can definitely take care of himself. The two of us go way back, in fact. Maybe I’ll tell you about it, some day.
ST_VoiceLines.F65AE11A4A8A1926BA7E8B93205485BE: I’ve become quite crafty at weaving bandages from Fabric, but to my shame, I haven’t quite mastered weaving an x-ray machine or a pulse oximiter.
ST_VoiceLines.E338D8874292916B3E54A7B9054E5596: I’ve been curious about that medical area in the Spaceport for a while now. Wanna do me a solid and see what records you can dig up from that place?
ST_VoiceLines.70D92C7B416BE2DC2A7859B098B39E17: I’ve been debating whether to put a jukebox in here. Think it’d class the place up?
ST_VoiceLines.2ED5F21D408C68AB352FCDAD4F81B80C: I’ve been pestering Tian Wen for a while now, trying to get her to help out around here. Her customer service is questionable, but she’s a wizard with a wrench.
ST_VoiceLines.99B1C87D4D7F064983FCF8B16C0F0A08: I’ve been staring at screens all day. What do you need?
ST_VoiceLines.5E19D2844A473FF9EC27FC8821590DBC: I’ve been told my bedside manner is "unique". I choose to take that as a compliment.
ST_VoiceLines.8EE9E03F417664353B332288692E3DF2: I’ve got a standard repair ticket up for grabs, if you want it? Just need to fix some broken lights in a transit bunker over by the spaceport.
ST_VoiceLines.95F6C3C64A1A1D929A7E1F84AA10EF93: I’ve got the confetti cannon aimed and everything. Don’t disappoint me.
ST_VoiceLines.631FFCEE45F8725580B0359C51AFD3BE: I’ve got your pay right here. Just say the word.
ST_VoiceLines.8A66686544F4EF6F71942CB248FF83A5: I’ve got your prize all warmed up.
ST_VoiceLines.035EA45A499B601D7FE25A91F52DD1C2: I’ve identified the places most likely to give us a clean signal. Place the LiDAR scanners there, and don’t fall down, Raider.
ST_VoiceLines.DC6DFB0B44F5764B857C5F8C5ABD1253: I’ve met paperweights with more follow-through.
ST_VoiceLines.D784EC654A3003D43664778BB6E96A72: I’ve put up a reward for anyone who can get me a sample from the supply water intake. The sooner the better.
ST_VoiceLines.3D55FF8F4BC0F70E95E85B9B8AA3BE48: I’ve seen worse materials keeping pressure doors closed.
ST_VoiceLines.B32DBACE4F4DC596D1DF90AA54FB6DBA: I’ve sketched out a design for a device to track celestial movements, but I’ll need some rare parts to build it.
ST_VoiceLines.C58722704FDA327BB7B281A90AC2DBBB: I’ve sketched out a design for a device to track celestial movements, but it'll need some components that were only manufactured during the Exodus.
ST_VoiceLines.3D28446C43AE76469491319D893CB53F: I… I don’t get it. One day they were trying to stave off the Collapse, and then, suddenly… Nothing. That earthquake-resistant housing project was shut down by a group named MANTIKOR. Think you could find out more?
ST_VoiceLines.EAA4CE484A41FEEC3D2F8BBE57572A3E: I… I don’t get it. One day they were trying to stave off the Collapse, and then, suddenly… Nothing.That earthquake-resistant housing project was shut down by a group named MANTIKOR. Think you could find out more?
ST_VoiceLines.ABF3B06849D3F5D254889B9CEDB8CCA5: I… I suppose I wouldn’t say no to a cup of tea.
ST_VoiceLines.69A575614633CD3ACED24CBA1210A8FB: Job completed? You’ve got that look.
ST_VoiceLines.839D22B94CC40E850C7B298D0479A512: Just a gentle reminder to keep an eye out for those salvage sites for Tian Wen; it may be just what we need to get her to pull her weight.
ST_VoiceLines.C94EA9B64523C41FFA718AA24238BCC0: Just checking in, or hoping I forgot I gave you a job?
ST_VoiceLines.BD5BE0184991C03D21981489E5FD9695: Just don't breathe it in, okay?
ST_VoiceLines.751310D04FB13A317A715D8FDEA2FBA7: Just don't shoot it down HERE. Don't wanna give the kids any ideas.
ST_VoiceLines.D0630A8D4B080A84D364B7A2FD534D4E: Just don’t jam them in a weapon without testing first
ST_VoiceLines.3266CE284227C184D26177B12508C4C7: Just finishing up my coffee, and then it's back to work.
ST_VoiceLines.FF052DB6433983CF033058B2EE7623A6: Just leave the coin on the desk.
ST_VoiceLines.9347D2AB4CAF8E50BCBEBA9D832944B8: Just make sure to cover your ears.
ST_VoiceLines.3C9A30B145B37C3F0623D689C57372DD: Just put it to good use.

ST_VoiceLines.C23C4E454B25F6ABDD65799D17BC0858: Lance tells me the engineer will be back on his feet in no time.

ST_VoiceLines.39EDF434487BF47F029A21B5EB2CA2D0: My favorite customer! Got yourself shot?
