ST_VoiceLines.8A207A194497C3EAA8AF4680B36806B6: On an unrelated note: I'm always looking for more egg timers.
ST_VoiceLines.F1966B0641249FEA88931381D7F960B2: Once an elevator's closed, we're not opening it back up for anyone.
ST_VoiceLines.5979273B47AAA01D975CA3A8FC4D690E: Once upon a time there was a handsome, yet lonely android. He met a cute engineer, who would come by his clinic to patch up a scratch or two. Now he wants to get a gift for said engineer.
ST_VoiceLines.444F8B674CE4A68AE14BC197C629AC67: One dirty cloth, just for you.
ST_VoiceLines.9093B46C4F16969DC82E108FB4EFEDB4: One electric mine, coming right up!
ST_VoiceLines.4559D64C454E8ADAAD37C9AC4511768B: One foot in, one foot out? Take the leap when you're ready.
ST_VoiceLines.1115A640433FB34A534842ABD58BBDDC: One hit with this can change the fight.
ST_VoiceLines.91A2302F4CF6328EADC80D8C80AF7561: One more thing. According to these notes, the salt battery prototype will need to be charged, if it’s going to be any use to us. See if you can find the right appliance.
ST_VoiceLines.412E55464CBAD565862519AAD252518B: One more thing: if you encounter any functioning androids, don't destroy them on reflex. They might be more useful intact. Old machines sometimes know old secrets.
ST_VoiceLines.98715C6C48E4BAAE155BAC8198EEAE3D: One of our scouts reported some shady characters near the pipes last time they were up there, but they couldn’t get close enough to do anything about it. That must’ve been when the siphoning started.
ST_VoiceLines.D616BFE6467EEAE22CDAE9827C816176: One of the returning Raiders mentioned breaking open an odd looking container and finding books inside. That sounds like a good place to start.
ST_VoiceLines.D69A56144679BD5AED62FD964D2B2254: One of these days, I may even have time to shower.
ST_VoiceLines.B872FDDE4AF9AF7CB55F5D8DC62EB623: One of these went off when I was tinkering with it. Knocked me out for a whole afternoon.
ST_VoiceLines.212AC71243E150B6F016B6812A59C518: One sec… okay, what do you need?
ST_VoiceLines.06C5E5594D06C22BC1DED495E6425285: Only fresh produce here. And by produce, I mean medical supplies.
ST_VoiceLines.E646C3154C6685626E6E7A8478EA56D3: Only the best explosives for my favorite Raider!
ST_VoiceLines.EF2D6EC1446AC44CE5B7138437083466: Only the best guns for sale here.
ST_VoiceLines.10E4188E4569E2384F433B8E3710834D: Oof, gas grenade, huh? Just be careful with it.
ST_VoiceLines.DF9312144EBB6BE1FCC9C2957E058C7D: Oops, had the map upside down! Could you try… The antenna by the Fuel Control building, in the northeast?
ST_VoiceLines.09B824414CAC38CBB939218105A013C7: Our Flood Spill Intake faces the swamp; it’s easy to find if you locate the Water Treatment Building first. See if you can find anything that points to the source of the contamination.
ST_VoiceLines.85482D0B4041652D5D61E59E400FB1E9: Our crews picked up the salt battery you stowed away, and are trying to connect it to the grid. Thanks a lot - I just wished it had ever made it to full production…
ST_VoiceLines.F2A527F348F7C8B333542382E8C4995F: Our food production is finally enough to meet our basic needs, but what we really need now is variety. I have a lead on some agricultural research from before the First Wave. Are you in?
ST_VoiceLines.9019A8D4428520604A2C7C839DCAADFA: Our lead points to the Research & Administration building, east of the Dam. See if you can find any traces of an agricultural research project.
ST_VoiceLines.BE37DFFD482FD36BC6F157B05F268782: Our library selection has grown pretty stale. Could you head out to Buried City, and find something more for us to read? Make sure you bring something for everyone.
ST_VoiceLines.62180F434A76704D8E68CA8AB9D18D75: Our only lead is that a company called ENELICA may have been researching earthquake-resistant housing. They have a few buildings around the Rust Belt; see what you can find.
ST_VoiceLines.4376FCF343EEF18B2597C5A2652BEA2F: Our operators confirmed that the radio equipment is working again. Thanks.
ST_VoiceLines.0267034445A82EABEA6399BF1A43BF51: Our private greenhouse is almost functional — we just need some electricity to power the grow lights. You catch my drift?
ST_VoiceLines.1C3C639B47E45A817085E78BF81CDA48: Our scouts have reported several Raider Hatches with leaking hydraulic pipes. They still work, but not for long. Mind patching one up, next time you’re out there?
ST_VoiceLines.A2953F66419269BDC8415F9D51B4C84A: Our scouts spotted beehives on some old sheds to the south-east. There should be an olive grove around there. Perk up your ears. If you hear a buzzing noise, they can't be far away.
ST_VoiceLines.73E23E2D46647E5B6B1E91A5685F59AA: Our solar panels are useless without the substations. The reserve generators have kicked in, but they won’t sustain us for long.
ST_VoiceLines.564EC62247254A6E38E15985FFCEC1B1: Our systems just lit back up, and the engineer's mumbling is getting more coherent by the minute. Thanks, Raider; get home safe.
ST_VoiceLines.6DE9EE404DFAB4301A655A939A89543F: People seem to be particularly hard of hearing when I invite them to one of my famous tea parties. A curious medical mystery, don’t you think?
ST_VoiceLines.E3CA95064060149933BF90A1FDDAF46C: People sheltered in those camps, back then. Used the outposts to send messages and keep an eye on the ARC movements. Nothing like now.
ST_VoiceLines.714DFA674AD8F8493FC7D59BD2C1588A: People think I just blow stuff up, but there's some pretty nifty contraptions here.
ST_VoiceLines.BE65A8A045529CCCD0E7ADB235ED72CE: Perfect for when you want to make your own guns.
ST_VoiceLines.1DFCB2504A21535F982FB2937A13C76F: Perfect. Here's something for your trouble.
ST_VoiceLines.DC7F8D214C74D27175E47891B3C6746D: Perfect. Let me know when it's done.
ST_VoiceLines.0A4219FF4CB273A4BC7256BE5D714091: Perfect. My scout couldn’t get too close without risking discovery, so all we know is it’s somewhere inside the Santa Maria Houses in the Buried City. Go there and see what you can dig up.
ST_VoiceLines.9E1D58554673169E68E072B7CBC9940E: Personally I use duct tape, but this will work great on humans.
ST_VoiceLines.1217EAB54EAE3388064841B156027600: Petitioning for a rescue team would take time, but with ARC out there we ain't got any. Especially if there are children involved.
ST_VoiceLines.2D6BDE99426ED72DD51C63AAC3AB09ED: Pick a hatch, and patch it up. We need them now more than ever.
ST_VoiceLines.1A77EA8B459858C003B153968117FE9E: Pilgrim’s Peak seems to have been a major hub for Exodus research. It's by the Blue Gate; take this key and go check it out.
ST_VoiceLines.CF2AAF314DFE7C2C9C6C1DB2B2364EF7: Planning your next escape route, are we?
ST_VoiceLines.FA3B111C4670ECCC435237A7D2CE7C36: Please be aware, electromagnetic activity is surging by Control Tower A6.
ST_VoiceLines.50D007EF440C5D333636D6928354FBF2: Please be aware: there has been a structural collapse in Sector H. Please steer clear.
ST_VoiceLines.3187B8C240E632CA79FCE7A3211FFCDB: Please go to the Departure Building in Spaceport as soon as you can.
ST_VoiceLines.A3403B93427AB8A8E335AC9FD32BCB8B: Please note that cantinas in Sector H are being used as temporary housing.
ST_VoiceLines.AC1803AC4C9171104E0FC2A4FF5DADE8: Please note: there’s a lot electromagnetic energy building up around the Control Tower.
ST_VoiceLines.A6D2EB5B4342E70692A548B35C43C9E6: Please pass the tea. I will not consume it, but I enjoy the gesture loop.
ST_VoiceLines.CE5A9D744785F197B299849AD941D89E: Please put any offers of temporary lodging on the notice boards.
ST_VoiceLines.AB384A844063267B42AB80A4945CDBAF: Please, it's child's play. Any Raider can do this.
ST_VoiceLines.9B12025A4F1D7383DD17489B61813B80: Please, keep pet roosters away from the rubble in Sector H!
ST_VoiceLines.22116BEC4D86F10CD83340BB291D16C1: Please, no loitering around sector H. You are hindering the damage assessments.
ST_VoiceLines.DD7358904ADEA0D1BD67C8A91C71C9BE: Plenty of stopping power in every round.
ST_VoiceLines.B5C9624B40EF00CA4566A4B275DFE80B: Power grid looks good again. Thanks. And fair warning, don’t try something like that again.
ST_VoiceLines.482B0F0A41FB1EE28FE9AA97AE43B27F: Primary power is back; so we're at least at half-grid. And one of our operators spotted the injured engineer crawling into one of our hatches.
ST_VoiceLines.220B3A4D4C814B9163FF618F62146037: Promise me you'll wait until you're topside before you test it out.
ST_VoiceLines.7F2881504B4D06A7F5D59BA3BB5AA397: Punches holes. In ARC, and anything else in the way.
ST_VoiceLines.0A981CC9416FBC55C8CC5CBEC7276C0D: Puts out lead fast. Just keep it steady.
ST_VoiceLines.90B116B048D24273A86D10B397F95899: Quick and sharp. Not much room for hesitation.
ST_VoiceLines.C469C74343DB85B4ED20208DBF1B04F2: Quick version? Backyard, wires, pipes, back here in time for dinner.
ST_VoiceLines.57D5AD914B55587D3E7E8EB8C86B4BFB: Quiet and clean. If you’re into that.
ST_VoiceLines.C2EA9FE34623E56B5E23E1926F933709: Quit hovering. If it’s finished, hand it in.
ST_VoiceLines.41E9C7F84C3FB375E7CB92A4BF35AD90: Radio equipment seems to be working again; that should help us track ARC this side of the Rust Belt. Now get yourself to safety.
ST_VoiceLines.EC5B91FC4A16A7E7325927BCD70DD53C: Raider camps come in all shapes and sizes. If you spot a shack made of mostly corrugated sheets, that’s probably one of ours.
ST_VoiceLines.DA07806741B505CD42207CA88890F263: Raider hatches can get you out of trouble quickly and discreetly; we can’t have them breaking down.
ST_VoiceLines.4124A2BD451C7E18A5936B967BB7DB0A: Raider! Here to chat, or to buy?
ST_VoiceLines.E9228023481BD7B0E0D3B6A6960D92E5: Raider! I just finished tuning up some new toys. I think you’re gonna like them.
ST_VoiceLines.242ED2014C1D84AB202AA8ACFA57B35E: Raider, I can't thank you enough. This info will allow me to secure free access to the Tubes moving forward. Now, I just need to subtly drop the hint that I've got something they’d rather keep under wraps…
ST_VoiceLines.0D64A3B34691BC7EEE0544AD0F650E2E: Raider, it's freezing cold outside. If you're going out to pick Candleberries, be careful and beware of frostbite.
ST_VoiceLines.FCE9128B47B240AA57B4E89458E0F8F9: Raider. I need you for something. If you're up to it.
ST_VoiceLines.003B85E04C889FB046EBCBA179D6A183: Raider. We could use your help.
ST_VoiceLines.F8E9751E4B499C05ACC6598024A9C4EF: Raider: the leaking hatches should be marked on your map. We need them now more than ever, so patch one up before it breaks down all the way.
ST_VoiceLines.FE87A4E44761CC961DE24BADA8B7F29B: Raiders have long reported peculiar-looking crates dropping down from malfunctioning ARC Probes. If we can figure out a way to crack them open, we might get a better understanding of what it is they’re after.
ST_VoiceLines.3377DFB347F89BBA97AB859336D8BAB9: Raiders near the North east elevator. It's shutting down shortly. Make your move or find an alternate exit.
ST_VoiceLines.7551CF4843B30F8E511A6095D3DC11D9: Rail power. Not much survives the first shot.
ST_VoiceLines.803065184F12B82412AB538D21A6B4D4: Recently, I’ve been trying and failing to get Tian Wen to join our community projects. I may have to sweeten the deal. She’s been complaining about the quality of salvage found on the market; think we could do her a solid?
ST_VoiceLines.FA9FA24D48E531D42D110B9E8557A18A: Recoil like a freight train. Knock yourself out.
ST_VoiceLines.637A4D794BE39278DC21B88269B480D4: Recycling is the name of the game when it comes to gathering materials. Show me you have what it takes.
ST_VoiceLines.12F5292E46F272E7E728DAB9D508A5DE: Red alert, Raiders: we’ve spotted a Harvester in your area. A Queen is guarding it with her life; only engage if you've brought your best gear, lots of backup, and a very good plan.
ST_VoiceLines.0199416F4BA4A85BFA2A88A23DBFDE3C: Red, like the Red Lakes near the Dam.
ST_VoiceLines.4C23395749FAC1D0DF689B85B50FD422: Remember the delay on this one.
ST_VoiceLines.7A5843EB47494EE0F1AAD280D26B0573: Remember the fertilizer I asked you to get? I’d tell you to look out for planters, but you can probably just follow your nose.
ST_VoiceLines.8D30947245E07D997D661C96D3DA87A6: Remember to get evidence of the siphoning before you fix it. But make sure you definitely fix it.
ST_VoiceLines.32F6D5ED47F37EFC9BAC42862EC11A68: Remember to grab as many goodies as you can from those medical facilities. Just resist the urge to sit on a hoard of syringes, OK?
ST_VoiceLines.5044447442E3F5202872F4B357499E9B: Remember, Raider: if you stumble upon a crate, deliver it to a Field Depot so we can try to crack it open.
ST_VoiceLines.5C03976E4095BF12AD6940AC3D9C3640: Remember, Raider: the evidence against the Tubes Management should be in the North Trench Tower. Don’t lose the key.
ST_VoiceLines.905A98DC4B8650AF1868EA86967EA72C: Remember, Raider: you can wander around until you stumble upon what you need, or you can learn how to recycle and take matters into your own hands.
ST_VoiceLines.E59B827049397D2152B6A4BFD1C1DC43: Remember, you’re looking for a First Wave battleground. There might be junk around, but look for anything that stands out.
ST_VoiceLines.F3C2E2674E8E2D423F2A1092995DC406: Remember, you’re not there to take in the sights. I’ll need the details from you later.
ST_VoiceLines.DE71985B4FC6FABBAB899482CA1986AD: Remember: if those Deforesters can strip away entire forests, they may not think twice about harming you, either.
ST_VoiceLines.ECDD01D648562C15BB8078A7740523FF: Remember: mortars fly very differently from bullets. You'll need to scope out cover that's a bit more claustrophobic than usual, and learn to take out the Spotters relaying your location.
ST_VoiceLines.F547A88A4B43EE73B7E2138ABEA8DC5E: Remember: you can only get at the Comet’s igniter if you destroy it before it detonates. Not much I can do with soot and ash.
ST_VoiceLines.521BB48846EFA87D27F2BBAC50B89218: Reports about Stella Montis keep coming in, and it’s unlike anything we’ve seen before. There may be records or relics from the past in there, and if so, I want them.
ST_VoiceLines.65E8C192461DB573B8A58E8FB816E280: Reward’s ready, music queued… just need your word, kid.
ST_VoiceLines.8B4A0BC34EA58D2DB86249A31EF06AE7: Rocketeers are no joke. Be quick on your feet, and make sure you keep something in between their rockets and your… Well, face.
ST_VoiceLines.5849F98A4637E3C5B5B9D591980CC57D: Running fast is for losers, eh? At least you'll be able to take plenty of bullets.
ST_VoiceLines.31E34D804A4ED840957333934DEFFE41: Save the dramatics, friend - you'll be begging for my services before the week's out, trust me on that one.
ST_VoiceLines.80932D9C47B80DF9880525951B2BAD24: Say hi to Lance if you see him!
ST_VoiceLines.79E469994C7B52BB2BBAFBA6D3052B13: Say, newbie: if you want me to treat you, you better prove that those precious limbs of yours are worth bandaging.
ST_VoiceLines.866CF1C843A6AFDF6CAC1FB7665C688E: Says here he kitchen staff at the Riven Tides hotel overheard more than they let on… And acted accordingly.
ST_VoiceLines.9DBA6D814D2A291B58A212A8986436DB: Says here that some crucial thruster valves headed for Marano Station never arrived. One of the first incidents ever logged.
ST_VoiceLines.3137F72C43E9A08EA4C8E29B09D0A976: Says here there was a foreman at The Dam, who got recruited right after they canceled Project Heartwood. Got put in charge of some big reconstruction project.
ST_VoiceLines.ECDF62534D8F980299F066A85DF4A80A: Says here there was a foreman at The Dam, who got recruited right after they canceled Project Heartwood. Got put in charge of some big reconstruction project.
ST_VoiceLines.8F08DE024708AD9241F0D382E7FF6FD0: Scatter rounds. Brutal in close quarters.
ST_VoiceLines.ECA623BD436697DE6844F29F5D7AF2D0: Scattergun ammo. Great for when aiming is more of a suggestion than a requirement.
ST_VoiceLines.5FCF69474AE100B4DBDA3CAC35759EBD: Scrap metal is just one of Speranza's currency.
ST_VoiceLines.93AC382941AC5BC9956912B6ADD44E97: Security grid's waiting on you. Start with a guard tower on the Spaceport perimeter.
ST_VoiceLines.43D46F0D45C6A258E016AE9154444092: Security protocol kicks in in 2 minutes; be gone before that. I repeat: 2 minutes.
ST_VoiceLines.7C3B6A81450AAB3F38FE01AE90E8C192: See anything you need, just tell me.
ST_VoiceLines.B9CFD28A48E23102E2A178889FBC9499: See if you can breach MANTIKOR’s facilities, and find out about why they abandoned that housing project.
ST_VoiceLines.D77D9B894CB65DD0F8C00B8BDC0B6C0A: See if you can find a way to open up that Deforester. By now, I trust you know to approach very carefully.
ST_VoiceLines.E3E80F1E4CF8390E0E9B10989893035D: See if you can find any traces of that family, and please hurry. They were last seen in a camp on the abandoned highway.
ST_VoiceLines.121F7159433CC0B33E664A80A039D6F9: See if you can get me what I need to set up a proper football league down here. I can't wait to learn how to perform a proper "Red Card".
ST_VoiceLines.5CE3ED7E4D3062F7C149CAB96627C087: See if you can't find a spare ESR analyzer in any of the pharmacies, OK? I have a pre-painted reveal banner that depends on it.
ST_VoiceLines.E6D9C4FF4E020AE7C0EBA7AF1381652F: See what you can dig up; we can’t afford this sickness spreading through our drinking water.
ST_VoiceLines.ACE41E7346EF81E3758F2489E6736FC5: See what you can find out about whomever brought down that deforesting machine. We need to know whether they’re friend or foe.
ST_VoiceLines.A84ABA5F4638DA4461B8B8A5F9D53A8F: See, I have a friend on the surface. Guy keeps pigeons for communication, but it’s been a while since I received any. Could you check it out?
ST_VoiceLines.A96406D3408DA89015CF77B1A80809E4: See, this is why I like you. Smart choices.
ST_VoiceLines.28FC3BA14F3E79565D961C9592D15F3F: See? I knew you’d come around to my way of thinking.
ST_VoiceLines.A073F6FA4433C6EB44E00F9CEA704199: Seeds are one part of the equation; fertilizer is the other.
ST_VoiceLines.614AAA3F46B8C246AD64239A61DE4A15: Seems like every other Raider here has some serious hearing damage. I heard rumors they developed some extra advanced hearing aids at Stella Montis. If you can track them down, we might all be able to use our indoor voices, for once.
ST_VoiceLines.57D7BDBC46014C697F6C32A50D9BD67D: Seems like every other Raider here has some serious hearing damage. I heard rumors they developed some next-generation hearing aids at Stella Montis. If you can track them down, we might all be able to use our indoor voices, for once.
ST_VoiceLines.AA28A98A48D53C213F49808D3C884CFE: Seems like news of the train derailment spread fast… And drove many workers to stash some very tasty technology away from prying eyes.
ST_VoiceLines.F992BEB744A2E6DAAB6C83BE625BE7FA: Seems like the kitchen staff at the hotel restaurant were in on the plot to hide parts needed for the spaceships. See what you can find.
ST_VoiceLines.3ACE119A4CF25B194C97C7BE2565891D: Semi-auto chaos. Figured you'd like it.
ST_VoiceLines.C2AD64B04499C204C8DF58BD3CACAE7E: Setting some stun traps, huh? Clever.
ST_VoiceLines.185C1CC5406FBF0B53CCE6B33EA00097: Shani called up to let me know the elevator is back to normal. Thanks for helping out.
ST_VoiceLines.2D4A1B9C4A0CEB394CC130A231F0A23E: Shani reported in a hydraulic leak on one of the elevators in the Spaceport just now. It's still functional, but we should nip it in the bud before it gets worse. You up for it?
ST_VoiceLines.3B9859344BEAEDEE8B00E0BCEB95ED29: Shani says she's been hearing tremors, but I think it's just the rumbling stomachs.
ST_VoiceLines.AC93FE234A9E7A89ED9811B025DFD0DD: Shani was pretty insistent that I don’t light any candles in the shop. Suppose I can see why.
ST_VoiceLines.9CB12305437B4DA7F4AAF7B0F82017AD: Shani’s team is already tracking down the saboteurs; you focus on rerouting that water.
ST_VoiceLines.A8AC73044AA3844FEE44889DDD90D792: Sharp shot if you’ve got the patience.
ST_VoiceLines.F15F376A4489CE5EF14697B12235CADB: Shift’s not over, but neither’s the tea.
ST_VoiceLines.E090AFA8480D9DF1FEF598AB4043F998: Should I get a hat? Something with a wide brim, maybe. I could tip it at people.
ST_VoiceLines.66F7A56A4E3AFA9C37F68AA251C8E4F2: Should keep you alive, if you use it well.
ST_VoiceLines.5B51D7D14E755FF70A4FF89DB5ECFC10: Show me you can grab some medical supplies next time you're topside, and I'll think about whether you're worthy of my talents.
ST_VoiceLines.8FE88BBD46AE4977B990E9B30CE9C9D4: Silent and effective. Keeps you off the radar.
ST_VoiceLines.9D0C83CB45BA369D918B5B80EDF6CB44: Since we intercepted that dead drop, it will probably take a while for the Official Toledo Tubes Management to go search for the evidence against them. If we pull this off, I’m going to hang this over their heads every single time they demand payment for using ‘their’ tubes.
ST_VoiceLines.FC6CA36444368010E2FD17B3375ECC1C: Slow to load, but fast to end a fight.
ST_VoiceLines.D59DC98A4D81D1EBFCC3F2A499A439B3: Smart choice. Just don't block off your only escape route.
ST_VoiceLines.31DEB1B4422286E5CC7D4B998C5A4D96: Smart choice. Just remember, they're for one-time use only.
ST_VoiceLines.8F40EDA94BC280E6F6A75583D819F47B: Smart pick. I’d say you’re learning from the best.
ST_VoiceLines.23B898194AB4A187434706860A01981D: Snap Blasts and Trigger ‘Nades will stick to surfaces, including those pesky Hornets.
ST_VoiceLines.8A21C13747D96BC4AE5766936341867B: So here’s the deal, you go get me a big tub of ice cream that I can drown my sorrows in.
ST_VoiceLines.8D1C682D4C37E5A2A179679E9E315AC0: So it all circles back to the domes again, huh.
ST_VoiceLines.8936ECF04C43C65BE51FCDA1B4B6D9FE: So much of this place’s history has simply decayed away. The things we could’ve learned.
ST_VoiceLines.62294E014DF88DF0CF5A60A2E479C6F7: So yeah, good talk we're having. Mainly on my part, you're mostly standing there staring.
ST_VoiceLines.F4CB5AFD44BCD4B7880E4EBEEFCECF14: So you saw it, then. Still standing? Good. Maybe it doesn’t look like much, but the First Wave resistance deserves to be remembered.
ST_VoiceLines.847F0DA242CDC249A1295BA1AC9FD025: So, any of my gadgets save your hide lately?
ST_VoiceLines.50B5E9C149A4178BFF66B583136441C0: So, did the patrols actually break formation? If this works, 'make noise, flank, repeat' might become standard Raider doctrine.
ST_VoiceLines.CBA36A5E4E189D7740541A84FCCFFFE3: So, how's it going out there? Raiders can be pretty mean to each other, but try not to take it too hard. Bruises heal, but growing hate in your heart is very bad, my friend.
ST_VoiceLines.CC211D434D9DBF80C0A941B14C4ABF60: So, the OTTM had a mole problem, and they’re a lot smaller and a lot weaker than they present themselves.
ST_VoiceLines.282A25C54BFA048C2A762D8AF55D09E7: So, you’ve returned without results. Again.
ST_VoiceLines.71D382EE49F0847E0CFE6189B1E8C6A6: So. Someone wired a device into a sensor node, and they knew enough to keep the grid offline so it wouldn't trip. That's not scavenger work. That's someone who understands these systems. I'll look into it.
ST_VoiceLines.92AFFD754C7E7C79C61AFCB7A7E8AD75: So: one pic from the southern tower near the Dam, one from the hospital roof in Buried City, and one from the Launch Towers by the Spaceport. Got it? Over and out.
ST_VoiceLines.0701E2384A703D6E09C783B0F86FBFA4: Solar panel's still south of the Southern Station. I'm sure you remember from last time, right?
ST_VoiceLines.2CE30815403F3F9A694166BCC4CAF5A0: Sold something he didn't have, to me and at least one more buyer. Dodger's not dead. He's just smart enough to be far away. I'd be impressed if I wasn't out a Bastion Cell.
ST_VoiceLines.BFF9EB614D1042835E7126946A55C73F: Solid choice if you want versatility
ST_VoiceLines.EF9A53D0462DFA725EF8698B70514052: Solid choice, friend. Should serve you well out there.
ST_VoiceLines.A496054946B8CD5A0EC647881A5B92E0: Solid gun when it comes to accuracy. Reloading could take some time though.
ST_VoiceLines.1517C213441641A427912984FAEFE7B9: Solid pick. Should treat you well.
ST_VoiceLines.3CBB07C349F2BBD88EC7B7AF1CE0C977: Solid work. They’re even in better condition than I expected. I’m sure Celeste has... Plans for these.
ST_VoiceLines.D8A72A814743B2386ABE49AEFD674C77: Some Raiders hurt their eardrums when the last Barons came crashing down. Others were on the receiving end of some close-quarters yodeling.
ST_VoiceLines.2384E414409FA3B2439C1EA6B13EA52F: Some advice, Raider: ARC Probes emit signals that you can hear from afar. And if you see a smoke plume in the distance, chances are you can trace it back to a crashed Courier.
ST_VoiceLines.5D969DBE49E8B49741F98AA4621687FA: Some cantina worker tried to throw me out last night. Said I need to wear pants to adhere to their clothing policy. Apollo had to lend me a pair of overalls for the rest of the evening.
ST_VoiceLines.CC01A6994A2FD29BB6CEC29F882CD5C0: Some combat recon is never a bad idea. When a barrage of mortars is lobbed your way, you don’t want to find yourself unprepared.
ST_VoiceLines.2C2675454A9681A76528FAB227AA73CE: Some folks shop quick. Some just stare. I’m fine with either.
ST_VoiceLines.D06980404FB28AEAC706ED80724AD1EC: Some kiosks in Buried City stock football magazines, and there’s supposed to be some makeshift goals near The Dam.
ST_VoiceLines.D75903374C1CDA4EF5BFDFA9FEF7F942: Some machines are pretty lethal, but you can easily grab a scan from far away.
ST_VoiceLines.6192D48E464C890C5B962F9FE6639AE4: Some of the rubble has been cleared in Sector H. Inhabitants may be granted temporary leave to collect personal belongings from their homes.
ST_VoiceLines.496F24FC4C86E7959221DEBDA3A416E2: Some people think I just stand here all day.
ST_VoiceLines.2EC8E02B474EA7CA45674792D372870A: Some scouts have been bringing back reports of these weird plants spreading into the area. Now, this makes your old pal Lance think it may have some interesting uses.
ST_VoiceLines.48A6BCEC4882143EBE85DFB5759CF6DB: Someone has activated the southern remote bunker unlock.
ST_VoiceLines.D0C431DA482E048DE08AA69342D66B8C: Someone has been lifting supplies from my drop-off point in Buried City. I’ve set up a trap, but I need someone to check it for me.
ST_VoiceLines.01130B8349C4216977D0A0B0AE817669: Someone just activated the north remote bunker unlock.
ST_VoiceLines.B778A68940207D71CDBD0E82F9815AB8: Someone just managed to override the Outskirts Bunker's security system. They've locked it with four remote lock controls. Take care of the locks and you can get whatever's inside.
ST_VoiceLines.A31F643D461D0826EB7DFE8F6EB1A4DB: Someone told me today I was “one of a kind.” I’m assuming they meant that as a compliment.
ST_VoiceLines.FCA2F14142E86EA268D63E838AA4EBBC: Someone triggered a lockdown on the Gate, and we don’t know what’s behind it. Could be dangerous, but you could unlock it if you can find the security codes. Might be some loot in it for you.
ST_VoiceLines.96EEC27C440D98E6FC65C4ABED9899AE: Someone triggered the emergency shutdown on the Gate. No idea why, but the only way to find out is to locate the security codes and try to override it.
ST_VoiceLines.AAAC8B6D4E14FCFEE88A7EA9343A8822: Something on the radar. Wait, that's just a glitch.
ST_VoiceLines.26CBB4A245A5B9B5F014949A4F177968: Something tells me you're the perfect candidate for some work.
ST_VoiceLines.73A51F134CB9EB27C8E27BA7A9516208: Something tells me you’ve got good news.
ST_VoiceLines.4A8DDE50438CBAFFFBAED587E43470B1: Something’s definitely wrong with the Tubes. I’ll dig into it, but no guarantees.
ST_VoiceLines.DE02E7AF4AB20C96990A63B9F7C7AAD5: Sometimes I invent stuff just to see if I can. Selling it’s a bonus.
ST_VoiceLines.0C5B9A9E440A631BF5F4E8B5D0A79EF4: Sometimes I wonder if I should wear a cape. You know, for the drama of it all.
ST_VoiceLines.1AD5722743EB0FBBC4B2F1BC35A07B39: Sometimes, the hardest part is getting started.
ST_VoiceLines.702133D5416BB650CC8EA9B9E14C5A4C: Sorry, mate. Only got goods for you right now. But check back later.
ST_VoiceLines.4768B1D842DCAA2BCE789694642C5A7E: Sorry, this is not a good time.
ST_VoiceLines.36B668D44674E80E06D83D99B3074237: Sounds like someone’s got that Gate locked up tighter than my medicine cabinet. If you’re so inclined, you could try your hand at finding the key cards to it and have a peek at what might be hiding inside.
ST_VoiceLines.E66584344DA31564DCF9A080A6A2E4A5: Splendid work; these are hard to come by. Now... Where did I leave my duct tape?
ST_VoiceLines.7447703141F06E6BCA2540B2C7164F02: Splendid! My fine friends are currently out and about. Bring them here for a cup of tea and some biscuits, all right?
ST_VoiceLines.C9017CCB4507BEEF6F6CAB88647748E3: Standing there like you want a medal. You’re not getting one.
ST_VoiceLines.8B77722247E55BA3869B9BBFC5BE82FC: Stay as long as you'd like in my presence, my new friend!
ST_VoiceLines.AD73F42945C0A84151F9F886AE62435A: Stay back, will you? I'll show you the goods.
ST_VoiceLines.935B808845C3CF6A67D1849364926089: Stealthy. Not how most of my customers prefer it, but it's a valid style up there.
ST_VoiceLines.7D836A2E4935EF4010B07DB3167B2690: Step inside and let the magic hands of medicine do their work… metaphorically speaking.
ST_VoiceLines.3D854314499C0001B2F4FBA3AD32F3B9: Step into my office. Which is also my clinic, shop, and break room.
ST_VoiceLines.F6F1B6134DAD8BC92DB05AB5D95A1917: Step right in! No appointments, no forms, no judgment.
ST_VoiceLines.45A9DFAB46D9A549EBD4CE86755140FD: Sterilized means less chance of bacteria and infection.
ST_VoiceLines.38EF183C43F0E23E58071FAD951C7021: Sterilized this one with my own homemade disinfectant.
ST_VoiceLines.3CF5CD4643B213C199A4E0BD91AFBCB5: Stew's getting better with each passing year.
ST_VoiceLines.1A63F34F4FD93CBCE6EE659462FFEA2A: Sticky. Flexible. Useful. Shame about the smell.
ST_VoiceLines.E57D122E42D018BC2C1A899ECC2D2FE9: Still alive. Guess that’s a start.
ST_VoiceLines.8E1B449F4534EE9B603210BC492AEEB8: Still breathing. Guess you didn’t screw it up after all.
ST_VoiceLines.BD776D2D41879F9266F33A8C0D0F5296: Still breathing. Shame you’re not useful yet.
ST_VoiceLines.573E5BA3421690B4B7EB07BF2EE3C3F0: Still can’t believe I’m not running a spa.
ST_VoiceLines.73A758234B85E85F9CD116810506B624: Still catching your breath, huh? Take your time; excellent work bringing down that Bombardier.
ST_VoiceLines.21E57D914900D5CBE0154694BE7AA527: Still circling the mission? Happens to the best.
ST_VoiceLines.616EA43D4AB550BED3BE018B1F7ECBFE: Still deciding? I can hum you some tunes while you think.
ST_VoiceLines.0F8616264D0CD7CF45EBBD9D92340429: Still here, still working. What’s up?
ST_VoiceLines.B5AFEEB64F353D4093BCFA90A67510A3: Still here? Go decipher that data before some sinkhole invites a Bastion inside.
ST_VoiceLines.3BB4E80C4D4FBE417C7F13B8415DFA1E: Still in one piece, friend? What do you need today?
ST_VoiceLines.64223F3E46D7FACF7A36848A46C818D7: Still keeping busy, huh? What is it?
ST_VoiceLines.E288525948CE90AD85F97D9D78AD684C: Still no choice? I admire your commitment.
ST_VoiceLines.C93D25C74C2826D66C7F5AB695E948C9: Still no word from Bilguun. Anything on your end?
ST_VoiceLines.C9301E0D4436991EA20F5A88943BF845: Still noodling on it, huh? Clock’s ticking, Raider.
ST_VoiceLines.4DB72E8C47CA3119FC8488AC6F7ABA5A: Still nothing? I don’t blame you. Think carefully about what you’re bringing up with you.
ST_VoiceLines.F20D6ECB4A50710F6003A792866FEBD4: Still on that job? You moving in slow motion or just savoring the moment?
ST_VoiceLines.B2C922D942561B8DB8C4049FEB2397E1: Still thinking it over? Or just avoiding going topside.
ST_VoiceLines.5599D8DC4B3B37649A496398FFD9015C: Still thinking it through? I get it.
ST_VoiceLines.36EEC19C441DA2F48A5F1C910F2A42AC: Still workshopping names for the clinic. Got any ideas?
ST_VoiceLines.A4BAF9CD45394F7190E0978DAB55B19A: Straight from Lance’s Clinic. Patent pending!
ST_VoiceLines.3B3939B14869D40037EA679C9292099C: Success unreported is just a rumour. Make it official.
ST_VoiceLines.831056B544F56521D74F71A7063BD6D4: Sure! Should be just the thing for you.
ST_VoiceLines.309744B644D57780DBA34E9CE41136A5: Surveyors are full of rare ARC tech, so we might both come out of this ahead.
ST_VoiceLines.EAB709064B7E6AEC715B4F872EC7F7EC: Surveyors are out sweeping the area right now. If you see one light up and signal, you might want to stick around—something valuable’s bound to drop in. They won't make it easy for you, though.
ST_VoiceLines.E7860B3846D30471DA28E08B46183BD9: Swell! If you happen upon any downed Raiders crawling around, give them a boost and report back to me.
ST_VoiceLines.1B5901D8438386770B34A78410A08C29: Take a look around the old town, if you can. Should be plenty of charming trattorias with espresso machines you can... Let's say: borrow from.
ST_VoiceLines.5D311C8B46A5A09AA1D662BCC1106F3B: Take care of your guns and they'll take care of you.
ST_VoiceLines.192FCEEE4BE927677935F7A1070A94F7: Take down a few of the machines, and grab some ARC Alloy from their wrecks. I’d go for the small ones; no offense.
ST_VoiceLines.D1FD61974DE69A815CC4BB91A55BD791: Take it, use it, and try not to bleed on it.
ST_VoiceLines.ED8029D14446175DA88E39ACCA6D6955: Take note: we’re seeing a real build-up of electromagnetic activity by the Testing Annex.
ST_VoiceLines.F41DB8AB412CDA88D41184867C11FF68: Take out a Comet before it can detonate. Scorched parts are of no use to me.
ST_VoiceLines.721479A748C15DEBDE2B3C873D2522C6: Take your time, but don't let your eyes deceive you: these are the cream of the crop.
ST_VoiceLines.73654C3F46C939D3743EE180DCE438F9: Take your time, fella. I'm not going anywhere.
ST_VoiceLines.F0A196B64E2CA379C446369CB1D98C31: Take your time. I’ll be here.
ST_VoiceLines.EBFD93844EB5F80A0ADF9A90A5512FF3: Takes longer to fire, but it’s worth it.
ST_VoiceLines.75B350094D9FF4BC01F3699B65F33528: Task done and no one exploded? Color me impressed and confused.
ST_VoiceLines.EDDB2AA74D8BB2019210968D260E70CC: Tell me that explosion wasn't the stash. Alright, change of plans. There's another spot. The antenna up the mountain. That's where he ran his deals. If he left anything behind, it's there.
ST_VoiceLines.549BF5FF4AB67BCC7AE417A42CCD1A15: Tell your fellow Raiders where you got that.
ST_VoiceLines.67393D1B47FB9796FCFFE98FDE0CC9C7: Tensions are running high, these days.
ST_VoiceLines.5B640706461CB871FDCC88975CAFFB84: Testing, testing; comms seems to be working! And hey, while you're there: Shani picked up a major rumble near your location. Do you see any sign of a collapse nearby?
ST_VoiceLines.B47B5EB54E172E28E5BA8995EDD2285D: Thank you! I knew I could count on you.
ST_VoiceLines.72F4F8394EDB43291EC0E2AF0C667594: Thank you! If I hurry to the cantina, I might still make it in time.
ST_VoiceLines.732CF7384D8C2B74C10858AA1334C1D5: Thank you! Once I figure out how to brew a cup of espresso, you’ll be the first to know.
ST_VoiceLines.3E79072A4078B8846E32F883DD0744F5: Thank you, good work. Here's your reward.
ST_VoiceLines.03A7CB59454FD1B9ED5B6E9E1AD414C4: Thank you, that is a huge load off my mind. The engineer managed to limp back here, injured but alive. They’re currently being patched up down in the clinic.
ST_VoiceLines.1B42F0CB4600EFE9BD26168FBBC424BC: Thank you. Hope this comes to good use.
ST_VoiceLines.394F918944F9FF44758264A3B3DC2AA9: Thank you. I'll be here when you're done.
ST_VoiceLines.1501542140FC5234774CADAAC75E2BF5: Thank you. I’ll clear everything with Celeste later, just do your best to find them.
ST_VoiceLines.E7F3F2624B36603F163A09A3115CE723: Thank you. I’ve already reversed the sewage flow, but the blockage remain. Head on out to the pipe works in the Spaceport tunnels and see if you can’t unclog this particular pipe. Just hold your nose and take a shower before you come back.
ST_VoiceLines.0B6EA5214937D3BF47B2DE93124AC293: Thank you. No details, please. Just take the reward and leave quickly.
ST_VoiceLines.90AB8A044F3D616D3BA97BA0A9597A29: Thank you. That should keep the ceiling from coming down, for now.
ST_VoiceLines.ED228DCA4156E9B7E1C31694D5ABDE91: Thank you. This may help us find a way to contact them, assuming we can confirm that they're friendly.
ST_VoiceLines.28F74F91488C17E4F413E9A9E127F6E8: Thanks a bunch. I doubt she’ll give it to you for free, but hopefully she won’t be too unreasonable about it.
ST_VoiceLines.9FE09D9549BC583C7AC47C99EC1D649A: Thanks for doing this. I have a feeling this is far from over, so I’ll let you know if I need your help again.
ST_VoiceLines.EB31A85C454F72E046FC5D8CB41EA0D0: Thanks for fixing the water. We only had enough reserve water for one more cup of coffee.
ST_VoiceLines.FC9744C4430EF4C32BCC01986B74D8D3: Thanks for fixing those solar panels; I was worried we’d lost all of them to the floods.
ST_VoiceLines.478CA71E404FC34EE5641BBC0E12289F: Thanks for gathering these up for me. I’ll see if I can figure out how these ARC parts relate, even if the tech is way above my pay grade.
ST_VoiceLines.0F14FD2E463C7F04D1D95EBB4A7427FD: Thanks for handling that. That thing wasn’t built to last, and it sure as hell wasn’t supposed to be used for something like this. Damn fools should’ve known better.
ST_VoiceLines.A3E8467D4063AE3399950CA969E39B6E: Thanks, Raider; soon enough we’ll feel right at home around the Blue Gate.
ST_VoiceLines.C8B5E31D474C6E503641E787F834BA36: Thanks, that's a good first step. I'm sure there'll be plenty more to uncover, so feel free to drop by again.
ST_VoiceLines.59C9565744D392380A54948F6BD8D53D: Thanks. Check around the generators for the Dam, and see if you can’t scrounge up a Power Rod. We’ll try to pass it off as one of ours.
ST_VoiceLines.8D80070F48CF983D2F63D3984CAA2E7B: Thanks. If a Raider exploded because of me it would look pretty bad. Perhaps Celeste would’ve kicked me out.
ST_VoiceLines.A49E7BB846C183BFB4D215AC0B137909: Thanks. It’s a small fix — just some faulty wires that need replacing.
ST_VoiceLines.6226D3DB4F707EBCC0D4F79069B4D398: Thanks. I’ll have Lance take a look at this immediately.
ST_VoiceLines.49D7E7F342A2D325D3257CA1522860B4: Thanks. Surveyors are particularly skittish, so I'd suggest you find a way to stun them before engaging.
ST_VoiceLines.939079C343EBDFC439A909BC0FA3E0ED: Thanks. We can always use more crates, by the way. Our attempts to open them have so far been… A touch too destructive.
ST_VoiceLines.52861D404711385A6EFB4D93075E775C: Thanks; I'll get those sent to the greenhouses. I'm always looking for more seeds, if you find any.
ST_VoiceLines.796A5D83429737F2D716EE8653DE961B: Thanks; that should last a while. Here's some hatch keys for your efforts.
ST_VoiceLines.7D42A6254390353D991DE9A7120ED3B0: That Deforester by the Blue Gate may have caused some real devastation, but a pristine husk like that is also an invaluable sample for our research.
ST_VoiceLines.6B1E66D041BA14120A01CFBE6E73B0B6: That Stella Montis hard drive contained more than just the shutdown documentation - it also had the transport schedules of some pretty critical Exodus components.
ST_VoiceLines.EBCC81294BCF75AF8EDEA3AC4FAC1021: That collapsed highway worries me; it looks to be recent. Much of Topside may be in ruins, but most of it is from ages ago.
ST_VoiceLines.C0F0695E48A8ABB340A8D69D9891BC41: That downed machine… We weren’t the ones who did that. We know that there are stray survivors out there, but this? This goes far beyond a single person.
ST_VoiceLines.0EF8C2B240350029486834A98F013F4B: That housing project, the salt batteries… Seems like every initiative worth a damn was eventually discontinued.
ST_VoiceLines.C3907F9E47831F7473804CBB3912D1BC: That job better be finished, because I already pre-celebrated.
ST_VoiceLines.3AD06D6F4272E2A1A1822DB681DC5925: That key you found in the barrel truck… I won’t jump to accusations just yet, but this certainly reeks of an inside job. Could you investigate a hunch I have?
ST_VoiceLines.BDDBD26D483DBA6D4E837B96ED292613: That one is perfect for a quick getaway.
ST_VoiceLines.EEE1E388445BC39AAD934C85EBFA091F: That one's STICKY. Good for nailing ARC that just won't stay still.
ST_VoiceLines.68C6B33C47E2A0FFC656D8AF48623395: That one? Oh yeah, that’s going to treat you right.
ST_VoiceLines.AA3D71334234C11A99C0BDB0C4A81295: That quiet confidence suits you. Let’s wrap this up.
ST_VoiceLines.6160DDA64F3977FF87DE3D89642633C3: That should get him talking, at least. Oh, and do bring back the bandages afterwards!
ST_VoiceLines.612800F946B6CCDB9ED992B9F50FC97B: That should heal you right up! Or perk you right up! Honestly, I didn't pay attention to what you bought.
ST_VoiceLines.4F80917349C15912A783AE9797D275B8: That theft before? Doesn’t look like a coincidence anymore. Some of the competition from Toledo is setting up shop where they don’t belong. I want their cache sabotaged, preferably before they get too comfortable.
ST_VoiceLines.1819572540CB2E17E5FF92A0617CD7AF: That walk says you finished something important.
ST_VoiceLines.2851F5D540313F3A138B679A41F1252B: That wallpaper, with those curtains? What a horrendously daft— Actually, no, it’s growing on me. Thanks, sport.
ST_VoiceLines.A8A27C454C6D6760F0C521B1CA712A41: That worked; thanks, Raider! My last engineer left some Hatch Keys nearby; feel free to grab them while you’re there.
ST_VoiceLines.00B0DA354BCA9852017CA09E3F8AAED1: That works. I’ll spare you a thought when I’m snacking on my own homegrown food.
ST_VoiceLines.EE948887472E28A430F97FA5E5A0139D: That's a Fireball. They'll give you a good scorching, if you let them get close enough.
ST_VoiceLines.FA0F62514FC14C728E5A2D9B6988D457: That's a pretty nice bit of gear, if you ask me.
ST_VoiceLines.61B581C54C4FEE3D5BC2388D86509065: That's how it's done! I'll let you know if I need you yet again.
ST_VoiceLines.D2B49C0746C3722AF9AE7EA515681482: That's my biggest seller. Make sure you use it well.
ST_VoiceLines.5008DD3F45DA7D3CA1C16991F932E6B9: That's what I'm talking about. You're on the path to greatness.
ST_VoiceLines.74F74D894114095B3B5D7882F626BFE5: That... That signal... Whatever it was, it sent chills down my spine. Go seek out Celeste; she'll want to hear all about this.
ST_VoiceLines.3E6776544968E9AC53CF4DAAA57444FC: That’ll get the job done with style.
ST_VoiceLines.9269024041AA183A52B8A7B887CADC51: That’s a victory pose if I’ve ever seen one. And I’ve studied them.
ST_VoiceLines.45A37CE347A9EAC4A8A40DAA1F047C62: That’s everything I asked for. I’ll handle the rest.
ST_VoiceLines.6C20CC4744B29A803C4EE0A7181FF846: That’s going to treat you well.
ST_VoiceLines.FF1BD1C14C60BA83081F49BA8494D9D6: That’s great news, kid! I’ll make sure all our old boosters get replaced with my new ones. Thanks for helping!
ST_VoiceLines.1EBCE0744BB8B9D33DA447B74956C26A: That’s hers. I can tell. I thought it’d be gone forever. You don’t know what it means to have it back. Thank you.
ST_VoiceLines.513E864B47398B4E324D0C91612E3BE1: That’s it! Now, you’re looking for a container by the brand Erma Cora… Notes say to cover it in tarp. Mark it with something artful, would you?
ST_VoiceLines.FBA8C21346840803F829F295B49E8B0F: That’s one monster of a lightning storm. If you must venture out beneath the open sky, then be careful!
ST_VoiceLines.565C5F734EFD8DBA306F6390015A15A8: That’s the ammo most people settle on. Not a bad choice.
ST_VoiceLines.2B39148C48812BBB98B15292D5FBA21B: That’s the face of someone who got it done.
ST_VoiceLines.2C2073AA485672AD1EA002B789BB9D72: That’s the sort of purchase that makes me proud.
ST_VoiceLines.C4CA6E754175821DD05307BDB491D82C: The Bombardier’s not quite as heavily armored as the Bastion, but its mortars are a particular flavor of menace.
ST_VoiceLines.962FC3F14EC071D6AEFA219E2869DF22: The Cultural Archives in Stella Montis are pretty well-guarded, so don’t forget to hum a suspenseful tune while you search for those movies.
ST_VoiceLines.ECA5D5B64298AE5A2FB1EB8CC987855C: The Dam’s foreman lived in Buried City. His apartment may hold clues to what he worked on.
ST_VoiceLines.5584775C4EECB7EE1801D591A7F60054: The Electrical Substation is south of the Spaceport. Look for the missing engineer, and see if you can fix the power.
ST_VoiceLines.DFCE4CB64A58D0BD731618800FF3B444: The Official Toledo Tubes Management is demanding one of our Power Rods for usage of “their” Slingshot tubes. Don’t let the name fool you, they’re in no way official; just thugs with lots of power. Could you help me with this?
ST_VoiceLines.B3B95C05434F7735C3594290FC87542D: The Outskirts Bunker is about to open. Get over there and grab whatever's inside.
ST_VoiceLines.6D60B9AF41D65513A70D67B4CD4E4A3D: The Pattern House is north of the Dam. You’ll recognize it by its… Well, you can guess.
ST_VoiceLines.5916F4654778E8B4FE99E2BCF0B6F963: The Raider who mentioned the androids said the ones she saw were all broken down, but… what if there are intact ones?
ST_VoiceLines.F391590F400ECF1402D298BD96DBC1A0: The Red Tower Hideout is in the Old Town, I'll let you guess the color. See if you can figure out what's wrong with the radio equipment.
ST_VoiceLines.0F22C229442A7EE63176928279AB8FF4: The Topside's no joke. I get it.
ST_VoiceLines.83ACBF4A4C4FBD90D60FCCB2A2601C7A: The Tubes were originally built during the Exodus; we just made them our own.
ST_VoiceLines.338AB3DD474BA9FEB01AE590D4B9C297: The alley behind the houses should be the quickest way to get inside. There’s a sort of indoor courtyard there that would be the likeliest place to hide something in plain sight.
ST_VoiceLines.0AC6E5F84AAD6142FC8A4D9FB13441E9: The armor equivalent of a strong handshake.
ST_VoiceLines.E05B1E054D1627410F9D9CA905A9F4C3: The armored transports are in the car pileup by the gate, but they seem to be locked with a key card of sorts. You’ll find a way in, I’m sure.
ST_VoiceLines.FA16CCE64DBE6A10A9F640AD27AC8AF7: The auditory researcher was invited to the Stella Montis Business Lounge. See if you can find any logs in the reception computers.
ST_VoiceLines.14CA6A1A4BB91E1DD1AF1C8D288C0270: The damage down here was pretty bad, but our Topside infrastructure was hit even harder. I still have several antennas that stopped working after the storm.
ST_VoiceLines.0E0E3D2846D76A6AD268EA9A67726719: The data mentions some kind of… secret meeting place? Somewhere near medical. Don’t expect it to advertise itself.
ST_VoiceLines.00A608F5490E8E235CDAE58C183C8EA3: The door’s not going to open.
ST_VoiceLines.47592F9B481F90C1FBAB8BAA4DDD847D: The east bunker control has been unlocked.
