ST_VoiceLines.330EFCA24E523669E41E6BA57733310C: Urgent call to bring any spare shovels and pickaxes to sector H.
ST_VoiceLines.662E7FC448068B045EDF128993EDFC3B: Used for guns with some proper zip to them. Should work great on ARC armor.
ST_VoiceLines.CED5D0AD4E18DA04851DA0BE35CFD044: Useful for when you need to leave the Topside quickly.
ST_VoiceLines.65EBFF2E4780315009F43D801FCCEAC7: Visibility’s dropping fast out there. If you’re heading out, stay low and use landmarks to navigate. If you can’t see the next piece of cover, you’re already pushing it.
ST_VoiceLines.450A276C43108243B4F2439BF777B722: Vital piece of equipment for any Raider, I say.
ST_VoiceLines.FD73F73C408B961EADEBC9AEDF55887B: Volunteers urgently requested to search through the rubble in Sector H.
ST_VoiceLines.643CCBFD481A0F05E328F0B87F3F62D7: Wait, was that one ticking already? No, we're probably good.
ST_VoiceLines.D8E5999D4D6D7F774F271AAA2464444F: Wait, what's that blip on my—? Oh, just a breadcrumb.
ST_VoiceLines.23AC3BD446C90633317367B8C8770FBC: Want a receipt? Just kidding, I got none.
ST_VoiceLines.EB7386DA4824D6768790B9AEDC9685E2: Watch out for this one, it's got a slight delay before it pops.
ST_VoiceLines.ECDD05544B0F3765D461C0813547A896: Watch your back when you're in the Power Generation Complex. I don't want my backup engineer bedridden as well.
ST_VoiceLines.FAE34E454239612305D45284EB44D565: Watch your backs out there, Raiders. Multiple Queens have been reported in the area. No sign of a Harvester, though.
ST_VoiceLines.7648A9BC4689B8E9E402C6811A70AEBF: Watch your backs, Raiders: a Matriarch has been spotted near your location. Keep your wits about you if you decide to go anywhere near, and always keep a close eye on her children.
ST_VoiceLines.447C5BCC4AC4145212E2B48CF22748E4: We all need a second to think sometimes.
ST_VoiceLines.E5F7C3174CF83BE3B385CCBE7C1BB471: We always need more green fingers around here.
ST_VoiceLines.8189EA1E48F8A3412D12E88811C077A5: We built that trap right when we thought we were done for. It was crude, but it saved our lives. I can’t stand knowing it’s out there, being used like this.
ST_VoiceLines.771C505A41F3D6BEE6E456B6DBAE4C17: We call those Ticks. They'll go straight for your face, if you let them, and they rarely come alone.
ST_VoiceLines.65C518E040A99F3C643073B404CC1A43: We can't build ARC tech from scratch, but there's plenty I can tinker from the pieces you salvage. I'm currently trying to repurpose different ARC parts. Would you mind running some experiments for me?
ST_VoiceLines.10AEEDE341D858E5E442C9A675675E24: We caught a break. One of our scouts saw a member of the Tubes Management make a dead drop inside the Santa Maria Houses in Buried City. This might be our chance to dig up some dirt on them for a change. You in?
ST_VoiceLines.E0FF3F24432DE9912BD22C8E73B72749: We found the detailed rules of football written in that magazine that was stuck between the library books. So here’s my plan: you get me a ball to fix, and I’ll set up an actual team for the young ones.
ST_VoiceLines.60C994C24F77EF5C070A36B41EB58B39: We get new arrivals every now and then, but they’re usually parched and underfed. None of them could have brought down that Deforester.
ST_VoiceLines.4777DDED4D140E310C3DBBBE44A82FBA: We here at Lance's Healing House bid you farewell!
ST_VoiceLines.341A895B49A4D3A55E7A12AA38A830B0: We know that the whole place is filled with logs and data, but there’s no telling what’s still salvageable, much less relevant. Find a few terminals and see if you can access them, to start with.
ST_VoiceLines.16390EFB4C5B583DE821BA9E2B95375F: We know the coordinates for those hearing aids, but I’ll have to cross-reference them with a paper map of the Spaceport. Those legs of yours aren’t too tired, are they?
ST_VoiceLines.1062D3EE4B993E1AF14AD888F776192D: We need to hold on to hope, no matter what.
ST_VoiceLines.A3DB2E0745A689EBDCC0959A5CF4DC26: We owe so much to this researcher, Andrea, for smuggling that hard drive out of Stella Montis. It contained internal memos, patents, and plenty more we’re still finding out about.
ST_VoiceLines.0ED703DD47F6E25B0AF27DADFC15E3AC: We rely on grow lights, for the most part, so any power outage can wreak havoc on our food supply.
ST_VoiceLines.35EADAE34F9AA484B10597A07A650F98: We trading stories now, or are you just stalling?
ST_VoiceLines.62DB212941C5C0CF203098AD7F0A3806: We used to label these. Then we ran out of labels.
ST_VoiceLines.937C412B414B0E0B2F72C3BEEF1A2320: We were more united, back during the First Wave. We had to be, when the machines came down. Seeking shelter down here saved us, but it also made a lot of people forget what’s up there, and why it should matter to us.
ST_VoiceLines.C1FFC8344567EEFE30F2488715036A8D: We'll need help decrypting this data, if it's going to be any use to us. Shani might know how.
ST_VoiceLines.F4F655954DDAF2872DEE0FA962D1C6A2: We'll need help decrypting this data, if it's going to be of any use to us. Shani might know how.
ST_VoiceLines.159A4A4E4206D08419044F8279D874E4: We'll need plenty of materials for repairs. I'll mark some good loot spots on your map; head up there, and see what you can find.
ST_VoiceLines.8FCCF50A48B3663D0F8FA4AD3D11A654: We'll put those to good use. Here's your reward.
ST_VoiceLines.4E6381744C3D00223619EB9EE68A8B26: We're in luck. The notes you found in the domes were written by the lead researcher. When the project went under, it seems she took some of the seed samples and sealed them away in a secure location.
ST_VoiceLines.7DEDAF4042FF00FBD9903EBE67FDB7D0: We're short on everything but mouths to feed, yet Celeste's launching precious supplies into the air for Raiders to claw over. I’m done letting the good stuff go to waste.
ST_VoiceLines.123C92D5477B02B04A332C8A6833E0D8: We've been losing signals in some areas of Buried City. My guess is that our equipment is acting up. You’re quite skilled with repairs, aren’t you? Could you check it out?
ST_VoiceLines.375D602641D42F390CD8E79EE060C539: We've got clean water again, but we can't risk people falling ill if the saboteurs return. We need to root them out once and for all.
ST_VoiceLines.88AC35974DADA5A39A7D7D9FB2FE51EE: We've had to build our Topside infrastructure in stages. Our engineers keep being chased off by one danger or another.
ST_VoiceLines.5EF24FCB47E106E305443E9BDE4B8ED4: We've had way too many security issues lately... If you want to help out you're more than welcome.
ST_VoiceLines.2024DCF34C7ED981853E94A51C8F28C5: Welcome back. What can I do for you?
ST_VoiceLines.352E55AC445F8CD190DB9783ED2C17CC: Welcome in. Try not to trip over the good stuff.
ST_VoiceLines.D155B9C745EC4EEA738BA297FBFC2C0B: Welcome to my humble workshop, friend!
ST_VoiceLines.A28EF3CE415DC28A89032986DFE057A0: Welcome to: "Lance's Emporium of Healing"! I'm workshopping some new names.
ST_VoiceLines.3FC3F638495915D0FFCB3AA49520877A: Welcome, welcome! Mind the cables. Those are… probably safe.
ST_VoiceLines.577FC8FF4D3D66966835FBB46E7D5060: Welcome, welcome! You look like you could use a little tune-up.
ST_VoiceLines.07A47FA446C8208E52AC0AB64C55A2DB: Well done, the skies are a bit clearer. The parts found in these drones can be quite useful. Have you upgraded your workstations yet?
ST_VoiceLines.8216179A4C5B44E052B8AC99AE6F78F8: Well done. It's the mark of a great Raider to see treasure where others see junk. Keep at it.
ST_VoiceLines.7F20B80D4EA5F832C5B8ADB4E4BF9BE3: Well done. Now take a deep breath, and see about facing one head-on.
ST_VoiceLines.55CF3AB242B9E95558A6E2A5B54394F5: Well done. Take this... Don't mention it.
ST_VoiceLines.71FFB322435C34EC1E1004B1D5983B32: Well now, you’re strutting like someone who did the thing.
ST_VoiceLines.DFA88D294DB35E4747E6829E4F2AD218: Well, chief, that there is an empty ice cream container. How am I supposed to eat ice cream if there is none? You know what, just seeing the bottom counts. My broken heart is healed. Thanks, pal!
ST_VoiceLines.14B1D09541CEDB0D6AD4AEB1BD6677F8: Well, hey there, man. What's got you needing my help today?
ST_VoiceLines.72342C28485A6C090BEEC7955B4432BE: Well, if it ain't my favorite Raider!
ST_VoiceLines.3010CBC0438DF1914FC4A6830A5D3B0D: Well, if it isn’t my regular.
ST_VoiceLines.9CFEF52946F03EF0AC106281D96799CE: Well, if you’re back for the reward, I hope you like glittery envelopes. Figuratively.
ST_VoiceLines.6C96342241046BACF8F2018D79008562: Well, look who’s back! Not done, but looking good trying.
ST_VoiceLines.9B89867B4A4E30FA7766889668EBE61C: Well, well! My favorite repeat customer... Don’t tell the others!
ST_VoiceLines.DF51E71C4FADE5695F9EAABE6EFC8643: We’d hoped the seawalls at Riven Tides might offer us some protection from the elements, but it seems the hurricanes were not kind to this place, either.
ST_VoiceLines.43055C6E48317065D73A098F84D2F477: We’re closing the Tubes down in 10 minutes before the security protocol gets triggered. I repeat: 10 minutes
ST_VoiceLines.1D681BE540B70EB8B772CCBA325A6E56: We’re getting ever closer! Looks like they were getting ready to ship a limited batch of hearing aid prototypes, but she only printed out the coordinates of the shipment.
ST_VoiceLines.C877D69C420254A8373226A989BCBD18: We’re getting ever closer! Looks like they were getting ready to ship a limited batch of hearing aid prototypes.
ST_VoiceLines.B7244A494C3BA98E961ACC9F99F9806F: We’re lucky that they seldom seem to come in pairs, if nothing else.
ST_VoiceLines.CF143DF04A33A00424669FAB1BE3DBB4: We’ve been trying to crack open those crates for ages, but so far, all of our attempts have destroyed the contents as well.
ST_VoiceLines.2F8EF5A44041701DB9A3028FA6629927: We’ve got word of a patrolling Queen nearby. That means a Harvester is there. Be careful, and make sure you’re well equipped and brought backup if you do try to take it on.
ST_VoiceLines.099C7E6348CDFC6AD9296A83C9FAEAC9: We’ve had to board up our skylights, so ARC can’t spot the glow of all these candles.
ST_VoiceLines.1915A773401944944BAB6F91B5AFB5B4: We’ve had to divert power to the most critical sections for now, so some people are going without. We can’t keep this up for long.
ST_VoiceLines.84F095794B8B8D1394033AA849F5DDD7: We’ve only just finished expanding the Tube network towards the Blue Gate, and we’re still laboring away at the rest. My crew’s been building new infrastructure around the valley to safeguard our Raiders, but the constant ARC threat has made it difficult to get anything done.
ST_VoiceLines.8D8D32BB404403B5D374B79ED7A8B70A: We’ve received your crate, Raider; we’ll see if this time’s finally the charm. Sent up some rewards for your efforts.
ST_VoiceLines.E43F217941DD9AE0051397889EA5FB80: What a waste — the amount of fabric we’re squandering on parachutes alone.
ST_VoiceLines.4D274CFA4C4D27931D5B6CB9F9105730: What can I do for you, pal? Need a patch job?
ST_VoiceLines.AECABBAE48AC3869FBDC10B4722C15E6: What can I help you with? Need a quick repair job? A check-up? Maybe a few miracle cures? Just name it.
ST_VoiceLines.FDDA9E33475A98BF1431278BC3E81F80: What do you got for me?
ST_VoiceLines.8AAEA3704CED99B349C544BE4B60CED8: What do you need guidance on? The safe answer is surgery – believe me, my expertise is unmatched.
ST_VoiceLines.CD06950F47496B110903CAB3E138D4E1: What do you think of just calling this place "The Med Shop" or something?
ST_VoiceLines.C97A503C488A7D181C87648A99E65DA1: What do you think of my medical setup? Pretty fancy, ain't it?
ST_VoiceLines.CA50310C4FC8709917BB32BFD1D287C0: What do you want this time?
ST_VoiceLines.421667114D289E0318B07881D042DB49: What fine reading you’ve brought me! You’re my favorite Raider in Speranza — or, well, top ten at least.
ST_VoiceLines.BB7310E24F3D1874089944AAD77782E7: What is it with Raiders and arm-wrestling, these days?
ST_VoiceLines.4B64FBCB404999155E0A7CB99F79C618: What is that smell? Oh! Raider, you’re back. Decided against taking that shower I mentioned, did you?
ST_VoiceLines.FCFFCE2F47784287A0E841B07685E65A: What!? I hope you're here to stash up.
ST_VoiceLines.029933E84223C68E02F5D6B54376C7A5: What, hoping I forgot? I don't forget.
ST_VoiceLines.6CB3BE754EA8BE8FEB7A6CAE731317F4: Whatever happened up there, it clearly didn’t stop you.
ST_VoiceLines.80C9EEED44D4D5EEC65093A4A92A43E5: Whatever you're doing out there, it's not what I asked for.
ST_VoiceLines.86371CF74C04B16D9387AF90AD3A79AF: Wheat, barley, oats: turns out, they all grow differently.
ST_VoiceLines.50E3EED94AD67B0AC999698D0B748667: When things go wrong, this goes boom.
ST_VoiceLines.2E3AF4374F119D2AFEE5949FF85DA6BB: Whenever you’re ready, the job’s waiting. And so am I.
ST_VoiceLines.41A2DF8641F3EFEB3228AF834861AEDA: While we still haven’t managed to find the stolen files mentioned in the recordings, there’s a promising lead tied to the seed vaults. I’d take a look around there.
ST_VoiceLines.FA6E40584C43E72E8AAFB1B62BCB0AD2: While you’re up there, try to scan as many types of ARC machine as you can, so I can analyze their movement patterns. Some are pretty lethal, but you can easily grab a scan from far away.
ST_VoiceLines.9D48D8D44658FF2C98642CBDBD28D219: Whomever brought down that Deforester, may have brought down other machines as well. See what you can find.
ST_VoiceLines.8C15BFE24B89CB04AFD1BBA702CB7672: Wish this door was soundproof, too.
ST_VoiceLines.71CB7F6D4B8F39918DBCE7BAEA095469: With my own stashes secured, I think it might be time to keep a closer eye on the competition so this doesn’t happen again.
ST_VoiceLines.3050E42A4EDB6B0F25E3FA800F03F3B1: With those Bombardiers roaming around, ARC has found an entirely new way to flush Raiders out of cover. If you’re hoping to take one down, you’ll need to sharpen your skills and your strategy.
ST_VoiceLines.2F783A3549A257E2A64A77B271C8FB56: Wonder what Apollo is up to right now.
ST_VoiceLines.C7DB4B6F4C30E7279AE4FFA0FC2DBB03: Word is that Surveyors are out there sniffing around for the good stuff. Problem is, they brought Vaporizers with them, at the very least.
ST_VoiceLines.9661408248B5220C6A770BAEE75073CF: Word is that surveyors are out there sniffing around for the good stuff. Problem is, they brought vaporizers with them, at the very least.
ST_VoiceLines.F46569ED4D2502B37DE628944FF37A52: Works best when things get real close, real fast.
ST_VoiceLines.003F51B243E495FF4B2F7686BB4EB5E0: Worst thing imaginable happened. Turns out that engineer does not feel the same way about your dear pal Lance. I am genuinely heartbroken, except I don’t technically have a heart.
ST_VoiceLines.1C873F694CBF6C4FBDB5BCAE61036842: Wow, you found outright water distiller blueprints? This is better than I imagined, thanks a lot!
ST_VoiceLines.51793C554FB6F7955D8C38BA73FAA924: Yeah, this will patch it right up.
ST_VoiceLines.46EC5EBF40ADF836E9DBB0AA71DA157D: Yellow light stick for you, my friend.
ST_VoiceLines.2E2E55114550A746F33FFEB0C70ED740: Yep-yep, go on and take it.
ST_VoiceLines.045BCF524E395881E7DB54BD98BD55BC: Yes, this will do! Now, I'd cover my ears, if I were you.
ST_VoiceLines.CD6A2DAF42FB4CE815546582BA691295: Yes, you could technically just buy the key from me, I suppose. But favors are worth more than money in here. You’d do well to remember that.
ST_VoiceLines.658308B4460A0A2A15EF2FB8929D6E19: You a careful shopper, or just scared of commitment?
ST_VoiceLines.1C819D5B4814963895D9D39D7B8B1A55: You actually found it? That’s… Head back here, and tell me all about it.
ST_VoiceLines.23CE662849A50E4AA23793AF306305EA: You are quickly becoming my favorite Raider around here.
ST_VoiceLines.7CD2417846027D2FEF66F8A5FA638907: You came to me, so you know I’m the best.
ST_VoiceLines.C10E2FF142FD37686F0723B4930B6970: You came to the right place.
ST_VoiceLines.F19C192F4DCBC5A3B8C0FBA03A8EDD39: You can call in a drop from a Supply Call Station. Just keep your gun at the ready, when one comes down; they tend to be like honey to flies.
ST_VoiceLines.62956DF24B0219D3967687BCD2D69BCB: You can find Rocketeers mostly anywhere, but Leapers seem to stick to the areas around the Dam and the Spaceport.
ST_VoiceLines.097B190F41C5A67C4049E49F3FAA6C27: You can notice a Bombardier by the Spotters hovering overhead. Remember to take them out, stay on the move, and use overhead cover to patch up between barrages. Good luck.
ST_VoiceLines.C3797D554A4A6348ABA146A628185FE7: You can notice a Bombardier by the Spotters hovering overhead. Remember what you learned, and good luck.
ST_VoiceLines.3AA1EA744469C0C320EC7DBA43299C5E: You can play? You should play me a song next time we're both at the cantina.
ST_VoiceLines.C701B99B4065C9FD66E197A1E7A756F3: You can recycle loot while topside, or build a more efficient Recycler in your workshop.
ST_VoiceLines.67450CE34FF3F9D85BE2DDBB7700C4EC: You can recycle loot while topside, or build a more efficient Refiner in your workshop.
ST_VoiceLines.396DB89E48062841F8889BBBE8B49346: You can throw off a Bombardier’s aim by finding overhead cover, and by taking out the Spotters relaying your location. Let's see you do both.
ST_VoiceLines.CEAC50C142D32D71EC41BF9CCB6BE47B: You catch on quickly. Hoist it where people can see it, alright? Doesn’t have to be flashy; a small reminder is enough.
ST_VoiceLines.744EDE01478AE83831356F9C002E342A: You could do worse. Many do.
ST_VoiceLines.1D52F03640C0532F773FB59F3F259AA8: You could singe your eyebrows off if you get too close to this one.
ST_VoiceLines.A097DD3E4E2A45DF57C0EEBCF76A06BE: You deliver yet again! I’ll set my plan in motion — those rats won’t stand a chance. Thanks, buddy.
ST_VoiceLines.D79AEC754E6F7A18115A058ACD0D2707: You did it! Bees! The greenhouse head is not gonna believe this. It’s amazing these little things survived the Collapse somehow. Amazing.
ST_VoiceLines.DE0E42D24EEE2316BC562FA62FBC09A1: You did it, didn’t you? Don’t get smug about it.
ST_VoiceLines.DA025E6E4470E3009902518752ED8D45: You didn’t just show up to dazzle me, right? Because it’s working.
ST_VoiceLines.1024715D42BCEA6B8223E2AF0FA83F0E: You do know how to procure rare parts. And how to jump out of the way, it seems.
ST_VoiceLines.570AEFE14E33296819AC99958BA7ADD3: You do like to visit Lance a lot!  - Get it? Lance-a-lot. Haha! It's a joke.
ST_VoiceLines.6D027B584E6562CC17F538A7125893DE: You don’t want to be on the business end of their rockets. Don’t engage them unless you have a very good plan.
ST_VoiceLines.AF38D94348B1457A40690D97B73221CF: You either know how to use this, or you learn fast.
ST_VoiceLines.6534BA92434CF4D4627D1895488F0E81: You ever go to the other neighborhoods? Shani rarely does; that's all I'll say.
ST_VoiceLines.D40617D14385553F19B131A69C9DEC6F: You ever notice how everyone limps in here, but walks out fine? I call that job security.
ST_VoiceLines.F8EE1CB74031FE964B9093963035B191: You ever think about finishing things, or is that a next-week kinda vibe?
ST_VoiceLines.7EB792E1482F10EE0D044386D1AF38DE: You found a spare unit? Excellent! Now, to figure out what ESR stands for…
ST_VoiceLines.3A981F4245EA45C0A0132DA3812AC68E: You found something? Oh. This is bad.
ST_VoiceLines.AD3FE65F4307CBD4D745A2B1F142A85E: You found the actual project documents? I admit I didn’t expect these to still be there. I’ll start reading through them as soon as I have time.
ST_VoiceLines.96BC94704CCD5374BD038DA1CD1E7FCF: You found the hearing aids, huh? Swell. I’ll prepare a suitable serenade in your honor.
ST_VoiceLines.5D83F23046D5F2079ED069AF8E736E3D: You got a good eye for fine gear, my friend.
ST_VoiceLines.3BC19C894A03ACDB280694A0EC965F7C: You got something to report? I'm busy.
ST_VoiceLines.4E26542541ABEDE36C856DB9059A0708: You have 5 minutes left to make it out. I repeat: 5 minutes. Don’t be foolish.
ST_VoiceLines.7054630848C05DE1611964A6786F7742: You have eyes on a Queen? I'd... I'd run the other way as fast as you can.
ST_VoiceLines.1235A5324A53CF8CF177579D3548FBCA: You have that look. Either something went very wrong or you found something interesting. Show me.
ST_VoiceLines.2FADEA1445EDF1E840B81C869B7C439A: You having a party? Or exploring dark ruins? Either way, here's a green glowstick.
ST_VoiceLines.FDFE5CD94FD982F6E4644696D6E52EC2: You know I don’t do idle chatter. Finish the job.
ST_VoiceLines.46D9981E46713A55A77B4FB3060288B1: You know I’ve seen tumbleweeds get more done today.
ST_VoiceLines.427A397D48B97C2E9A40CEADF5482DD0: You know how to use that, right?
ST_VoiceLines.C48065F14586CE91698467BDB2AA899D: You know this door hatch closes as easily as it opens, right?
ST_VoiceLines.BAF2AF9242BEE98F474FD4893ECE90DD: You know what I've been dreaming of lately? A talking water distiller! Crazy, huh? But seriously, with purer compounds I could make explosives with more oumph! Would be something, right?
ST_VoiceLines.2924288C4071EA60CBB9C8BC3B91BD92: You know what a Bastion is and what it does. Just make sure you don't slag the one thing I care about. Bring the cell back intact.
ST_VoiceLines.608CC4344BD484055CC073A9D10DD4AF: You know where everything is by now. Makes this a lot easier.
ST_VoiceLines.1A52634246BC4D50D3D20EB8772FC8B5: You know, I have been meaning to hang a "Best Clinic in Toledo" sign in here. Might have to make my own.
ST_VoiceLines.23127F8D4419FE6E9232D9ADA3D1B99C: You know, I read somewhere humans blink twenty times a minute. I’ve been practicing, but I realized I don't have eyelids.
ST_VoiceLines.45B5EF7F4A638BC427F5F6AB438CF035: You know, I saw some teens use these for a dance party. I'm happy kids can still be kids down here.
ST_VoiceLines.5F86795746A306122686538AFF6B419C: You know, I’ve been thinking. Maybe the clinic needs a disco ball. Healing’s faster when the room sparkles.
ST_VoiceLines.09DC25364ADD00EF1A7AF49FD9D34919: You know, the task doesn’t complete itself. I checked.
ST_VoiceLines.542A42E242B90821B32807B3D3992240: You know, when I was young, we'd bang pipes, set off car alarms, anything to pull the machines away from where we were hiding. That was a different time, though, so be careful. And if three Bastions show up at once... improvise.
ST_VoiceLines.4200548F4910A84602DF1389FBC3DD93: You know: just because it's scented, doesn't mean you should be breathing in smoke.
ST_VoiceLines.4DBDC4CD4E0CE19669000B9D9707A532: You like a certain amount of uncertainty, right? A client wants the contents of a locked safe in Stella Montis. It's intact, so whatever's inside has been there since before the Exodus. Interested?
ST_VoiceLines.1F7ED091458E6A85086F719A479DD2DD: You like the décor? I designed it myself.
ST_VoiceLines.7946AFBD4D9123B3FCA262A077962C08: You look like someone who just made my day easier.
ST_VoiceLines.E27C8DC542E99A9E7839578595CAD585: You look like you need more than luck.
ST_VoiceLines.F07E3F324EB82B4AEFBB619603C4F886: You look like you’re pondering life’s great mysteries.
ST_VoiceLines.CE50C2004851D85FF40CB8BD7B106747: You look like you’re thinking real hard.
ST_VoiceLines.D34941514883429FB23FBF80DE05D120: You look ready for an upgrade.
ST_VoiceLines.64DC00034BBC0BB1D41B2A8566FFE78B: You make up your mind yet?
ST_VoiceLines.7D14AD98478D44763BFE0AA73E1AED1E: You marked them? Perfect. Those marks will hold until we’ve got boots on the ground. …Man, new outposts.
ST_VoiceLines.99BD52214353A3FFA1C4158FADA629B0: You might not be useless. You're just...not there yet.
ST_VoiceLines.E87B5D53482F5104B0E01CA7F1FC29FD: You need more, come back alive.
ST_VoiceLines.3FCB8DD84A862D84FA1FED9E1DAA40B6: You off to paint the town red?
ST_VoiceLines.29B7243B4E0EBEE4BB897DAAB6A04B96: You really stuck it to those Hornets, huh? Great stuff—now go spread the word.
ST_VoiceLines.59C6A0E14DBA79097444759A40E7939F: You seen my pants? Just kidding, I got none.
ST_VoiceLines.43C7F1034B5E637D635114821606C6E7: You set up in your Raider Den, yet? You wanna have a nice place to come home to, where you can kick back and relax... Nothing beats having a space to yourself.
ST_VoiceLines.9B0E44F84F09A3F055E2359DA8E8FBFD: You should be able to find the parts I need in any research or medical areas. Try not to die, and whatever.
ST_VoiceLines.B343722B450B6666A72B9089C4535A71: You should be able to find what I need in apartments and houses. I'd try Buried City, first.
ST_VoiceLines.AA73C13A421852CDD927D382F6E006F9: You should have a look at some of my amazing set of medical supplies.
ST_VoiceLines.DA7E0D704CBA2B16484A3D8582FA8C39: You smell like dust and gunpowder, my friend.
ST_VoiceLines.F7E3BFB143ABB5449E61059D64DC8DBA: You sure know how to waste a second chance.
ST_VoiceLines.05D887CA41332B152B95B18B7DD76066: You sure you can handle that?
ST_VoiceLines.C5CFA2C543FEB495A01EEC8ACD55F9F0: You survived! Not that I thought you wouldn’t, of course. All right, then — how about some proper bandages instead of those dirty rags?
ST_VoiceLines.6829670F4791659332B4F99C847194A1: You survived. Color me… mildly surprised.
ST_VoiceLines.3C5DC09D4EB28B641AB174BF78F638F9: You think I'd look good in a wig? Or maybe a hat?
ST_VoiceLines.AFB7F7E8413653DFF4AED799946287E6: You think wearing a stethoscope all the time would make me look more professional? Or just stylish?
ST_VoiceLines.4C2B37B14F2DD4FB36996BB2A20BE87E: You trying to think, or just wasting time?
ST_VoiceLines.4D2D39DE4780DFA288966E9D2573527A: You walk like someone with results.
ST_VoiceLines.057FA1164B02F8CB2FDDB89791E513A5: You want more? Uncle Lance got you covered.
ST_VoiceLines.71B37A8B4BA72F5DB5393B8290C51530: You want respect? Earn it first.
ST_VoiceLines.41E4E4424958F269A840F9886FE18DE6: You want that? Sure, it'll do the job, I suppose.
ST_VoiceLines.A9004036484E704D2F91D8BA3FBFCD8A: You want to browse? Fine. Just don’t block the monitors.
ST_VoiceLines.96BC90A84FBDA2E4F0A566B21CC20EE4: You were thorough. Excellent. I’ll look through what you found and make sure to document it in our archives.
ST_VoiceLines.2042838D4FEC64F32116A590CDBA3530: You will? Splendid! I just need some syringes and reagents, and I should be all set.
ST_VoiceLines.365B8E0F43772E2662D809BA40054A16: You won’t find the parts I need lying around just anywhere; you’ll need to head to where they prepared for the Exodus.
ST_VoiceLines.5F975E0D4DADB4D8FF1C0E919FE35AFB: You won’t move fast, but you’ll look unbreakable doing it.
ST_VoiceLines.818DCDF64C341655173AA79FCB569657: You wouldn't be setting any traps, would you?
ST_VoiceLines.29EFBE6945019065E4E8C7BDEC26483E: You wouldn’t believe how many people come in asking for love potions. Wrong shop, I tell them.
ST_VoiceLines.7AB3FB2E49606073873AEA869953594B: You wouldn’t believe the mess I had in here before you showed up.
ST_VoiceLines.6BC337AF438824C273142D97F9B4D261: You wouldn’t happen to be holding a present behind your back, would you?
ST_VoiceLines.199A18524C24D78E34AB9382761DCF9C: You wouldn’t understand. This is between us sensational medical types.
ST_VoiceLines.C797D9404725A43D1A264F8253206CCB: You! I've got an assignment for you. Don't worry, I will compensate you for it.
ST_VoiceLines.7EDE2C31495D21FE5D1C34878E916827: You'd look like a real superhero with this.
ST_VoiceLines.4FA00E58406F82A9BC04EF83490DC8CE: You'll be telling me if you appreciate it, won't you?
ST_VoiceLines.4CD46C7C4EC6A1A5B87FE397EE3B9316: You'll find the structures around the Blue Gate. Be on your guard; we're still learning what's out there.
ST_VoiceLines.F65536F14D9D5B92E45ECB9469C4A0CA: You'll have the best chance to find the materials I need around the industrial areas by The Dam. Stay safe out there, all right?
ST_VoiceLines.4B3C9091492F0E8536A147836D9AF360: You'll have to be quick on your feet, Raider, because the Leaper does not take any prisoners. Remember the flags: stand tall, and stand proud.
ST_VoiceLines.62BCFDF545E7263B93FA15A81C64AC03: You'll run farther than far with this.
ST_VoiceLines.8D9FD42242AEC20C33FA86A9A54FCAA3: You'll want to walk tall, in these halls.
ST_VoiceLines.89A1BF9B485F683515508A998482B5F3: You're back! And not bleeding! Right?
ST_VoiceLines.FE06B3DA4C03A4883A76A589789B597A: You're back. And still intact. That's promising.
ST_VoiceLines.2C51F64B490E6F1F289C589C567932C5: You're better at this than most. And that’s not something I say often.
ST_VoiceLines.09093F3B4E36F347F823489D7F464A5D: You're giving me time to brainstorm clinic names. Dangerous game.
ST_VoiceLines.F10BD55A4A7604D561EBAC832190D089: You're just standing there. Not a good look.
ST_VoiceLines.7B482CAC46A2C92E13AA61818B63F8A9: You're looking unusually efficient today. I approve.
ST_VoiceLines.8EA7DF94494D8CB9C02183A0519DBC52: You're lucky I have all the time in the world for you.
ST_VoiceLines.23D2EE24498D3AD9CBC8A9BBC3D33FEC: You're not one of my regulars. What do you need?
ST_VoiceLines.BA9CED7D464B8B36FE090886BF30B541: You're one of the new arrivals, right? I need a volunteer to test out this upgraded Ferro; should cut through ARC plating like butter. Go put holes in some machines, and report back to me.
ST_VoiceLines.E49D1E0B4E9EE213D5C285AADDDF60FA: You're persistent. I’ll give you that.
ST_VoiceLines.C5546AF04B3D3166609235A1972829E2: You're still alive! Great, remember that thing I asked of you?
ST_VoiceLines.A3E25E024F0A0E04D9D55A80C6B357BF: You're the one who fixed the backyard tube? I wanted to tackle that ages ago, but the hike over there's no picnic. But you know you swiped my job and cost me my commission. If you want to make amends - which you should - I have some more repairs up there on my ticket.
ST_VoiceLines.C45E97CE43AC5EA5F1F1A7A7C4096567: You've met Shani already, yeah? Down in security? I need someone to run down there and tell her that I need a new hatch key. Unless you happen to have a spare one on you? Mine is… displaced. It's nothing important; just a small, personal favor. I'll pay you!
ST_VoiceLines.2FBC5A924DBC1A5342E64E90EF3FE970: You've not been getting into any trouble, have you?
ST_VoiceLines.6ADEF44748E475FA4D4CBC88E4E51A08: You've really been on top of gathering seeds for us. Appreciate it.
ST_VoiceLines.D280D3B241EB67FDAB8C60AD51CC7C66: You. Are. A. Doll. Thank you so much. Here's your payment. Lance never misses a payment.
ST_VoiceLines.6EEFD39B471F0B81F4C89E9C701DDDBB: Your coin is always welcome here.
ST_VoiceLines.A6FED8974EC6D3AD06AA768473D58DD6: Your job is to go to the Spaceport and find the files. Take this key to the North Trench Tower, I had to bribe Shani with a jar of candied apricots for it, so keep it safe.
ST_VoiceLines.D08B00134DE571C8B8116090A6308361: Your old buddy Lance thanks you.
ST_VoiceLines.46B8266C4B291F8E4F8DEF990DDEFB70: Your silence is annoying. Just confirm it’s done.
ST_VoiceLines.B2AB2635498749A3B697779F372BE3E5: You’d venture out at a time like this? You must really want some Candleberries if you’d risk severe frostbite for them.
ST_VoiceLines.81E583A54BE5A4B575E9329E4E32CBC0: You’ll find the solar panel by a nice secluded roof terrace, near the Southern Station. Look for blue tarps. Rewire it so my surveillance gets priority. The rest of the grid can go dark, for all I care.
ST_VoiceLines.A0DD47EE473A9C2DDFED9C91D43659BF: You’ll find their cache around Marano station, marked with a ribbon. A little sabotage should do the trick.
ST_VoiceLines.3F276DC845F9A2DD7F2FABAAA559F46A: You’ll get a bit of punch and a lot of shots. Solid mix.
ST_VoiceLines.19955ABD431F8DBAD110869C84197BD9: You’ll get more shots with this, just not more power.
ST_VoiceLines.796C37CA4997FEB11981B0916DA43753: You’ll need to put the scanners pretty high up, so you may want to bring a zipline or two.
ST_VoiceLines.460BBEDF44F2D00CAC9F929BE4A0E071: You’ll probably find a football in the galleria in Buried City, though other places might be safer. Your choice.
ST_VoiceLines.3C341B6D443AE6A74E31658E100125AA: You’ll thank me for that one later, trust me.
ST_VoiceLines.5FA0578E4EF124FD9C703CB83806D513: You’re back early. That’s rarely good.
ST_VoiceLines.285BC1384D01073F1C39BDB3B06F03C7: You’re back in one piece. Don’t ruin it with weird silence.
ST_VoiceLines.89B7450940CA02C1FE06C89B69450D99: You’re back! Could I sweet-talk you into helping me out again? I need some more supplies for the medbay; I’m running low on both torch ginger and chemicals this time.
ST_VoiceLines.10999159485A57B3603AF19E54F6A213: You’re back. Got something in mind?
ST_VoiceLines.BF9D76254BF5D3D69FDD14B378DBBE58: You’re back. Took you long enough.
ST_VoiceLines.E9E4A03441B7499F0FEBAEA2BB010E31: You’re bringing the whole bunker with you, huh?
ST_VoiceLines.4EA593DD45E8D6305A8D5B95AA63B772: You’re burning time I could be using to watch for real threats.
ST_VoiceLines.84D09D644AA5A47551B4E3BD545F2916: You’re giving off big hero energy. Either that or you tripped into something important.
ST_VoiceLines.CC927AEE477E3335F781EFA32328A19E: You’re here. Fine. What do you need?
ST_VoiceLines.D0F79CEB4A7DEC9D4D9046A033E5F493: You’re holding out on me, aren’t you?
ST_VoiceLines.8829E2324A4452E252D1BB8B7DAB93EB: You’re in luck, I just finished restocking. And by restocking, I mean reorganizing the piles of junk around here.
ST_VoiceLines.CF4A4F8542A0D25D9BFE7D9CD51F1A72: You’re in luck, I just restocked the shelves and the charm.
ST_VoiceLines.B6227A9041FC8E653AB8669F480300A1: You’re likely going there to do your own thing regardless, right? So if you don’t mind, keep an eye out for me?
ST_VoiceLines.19E7A55F4D6402E4C500A6BF24122068: You’re looking for shipping containers labeled 'J Kozma': that’s all the help I can offer.
ST_VoiceLines.F5768ABB4CF64282401639B365534358: You’re looking for shipping containers that stand out: that’s all the help I can offer.
ST_VoiceLines.FAAC1DDB43B52F5DA8C0C88FC0156FD4: You’re lucky I’m so patient. Exceptionally patient.
ST_VoiceLines.C0413CCD43D9B0D0407AACB2C9505AB5: You’re lucky I’ve got all day. And all night.
ST_VoiceLines.13A23DE64E83E77A46491FB31014A3A8: You’re making me look good here. Keep it up.
ST_VoiceLines.8BF329F74C7B981335B03EB2EA7C9993: You’re making this more awkward than it has to be.
ST_VoiceLines.7030AAD84FF9F5210912E8B5EA6AF828: You’re not lost, are you? Just… detouring?
ST_VoiceLines.4217870C4494676B4284CF9BECC741F9: You’ve come to the right place. I patch folks up and send ’em back better than new.
ST_VoiceLines.06D3BB934B2AE44F3EECF9BBD7797E8C: You’ve got a bit of dust and a whole lot of accomplishment on you.
ST_VoiceLines.272EC4E446B8537DF327DC93658846DC: You’ve got a knack for picking the good stuff.
ST_VoiceLines.AD2368FF4223368B40037D975BD1E5CE: You’ve got an eye for the good stuff, I’ll give you that.
ST_VoiceLines.9388E53A492956510D0D7CB38032BF07: You’ve got coin, I’ve got weapons.
ST_VoiceLines.0E620AA948F89F03A1CAA3A51FFF6622: You’ve got good timing. Just restocked the good stuff.
ST_VoiceLines.CF32FA80496BC3129D8921BD2D8BC444: You’ve got nothing better to do?
ST_VoiceLines.2A50D17943EB43C3F152CEA065DFCAE8: You’ve got that post-boom confidence. I respect it.
ST_VoiceLines.08D11E274069A8A0CEC011914FF4BF48: You’ve got the look of someone who actually pulled it off. Huh.
ST_VoiceLines.C49988994BAD5D712EB142A8BEF99CC8: You’ve got time. Not much, but a little.
ST_VoiceLines.14B3B4164B932F0BDBD6B9AF340D0D42: You’ve handled it, haven’t you? Go on then.
ST_VoiceLines.EEEAF2AF41B0F7C295AF40A40B3A2575: Y’know, back in the day we actually used to have a flag - well, a scrap of cloth more than anything. Still, seeing it meant you knew you had allies nearby, that you were on your own home turf. So, I was thinking…
ST_VoiceLines.6A335B4842FA1DE63BFBC3A8F2EEF187: “A room with a great view.” Not too many of those left. Hopefully the place you’re looking for isn't covered by the sands.
ST_VoiceLines.7B392CBB48BD67D9583C1CAFCC16E57B: …So no plans, then. Shame. Still, you didn’t come back empty-handed. I’m grateful. I’ll make sure this ends up where it should be.

ST_VoiceLines_Custom.ID_ONBOARDINGLEVEL_BEINGAMBUSHED_0050: No time to waste, let's head back to Speranza.
ST_VoiceLines_Custom.ID_ONBOARDINGLEVEL_BEINGAMBUSHED_0050_AL: No time to waste, let's head back to Toledo.
ST_VoiceLines_Custom.ID_ONBOARDINGLEVEL_BEINGAMBUSHED_0020: Told you someone was prying the door.

ST_VOIP.ID_VOIP_OPTION_DESC:
Voice Chat is a tool for speaking with other raiders in Speranza, and Topside, if you have a microphone, or to simply listen in if you don't have one.
 
**You must enable Voice Moderation in order to use Voice Chat.**
ST_VOIP.ID_VOIP_MODERATION_OPTION_DESC:
Voice Moderation is an online safety tool for the purpose of preventing harmful behavior. 
 
**Recording Consent**
 
Once you’ve consented, moderation runs whenever Voice Chat or Proximity Chat is on.
 
Select "No" to withdraw your consent, disable Voice & Proximity Chat and stop any moderation.
 
**You must enable Voice Moderation in order to use Voice Chat.**
ST_VOIP.ID_VOIP_ERROR_DEFAULT_SHORT: Voice chat issues. Try again later
ST_VOIP.ID_VOIP_ERROR_DEFAULT: We are currently having issues with voice chat, and are working on resolving them. Please try again later.
ST_VOIP.ID_VOIP_MODERATION_NOTIFICATION_BODY:
We are implementing a new Voice Moderation system with the goal of providing a safe and a fun environment for all Raiders.
 
Our system may create recordings of snippets of your Voice Chat and Proximity Chat conversations if it detects potentially harmful behavior. We therefore need your consent if you want to enable Voice Chat or Proximity Chat. Recordings will be temporarily stored until reviewed and not used outside of moderation purpose.
 
**Recording Consent**
 
When Voice Chat is enabled in ARC RAIDERS, your voice activity may be captured and processed by Embark Studios for the purpose of preventing harmful behavior and significant violations of our Code of Conduct in our [Terms of Service and End User License Agreement](https://id.embark.games/arc-raiders/support/faq/126-terms-of-service-and-end-user-license-agreement).
 
If our systems identify potentially harmful activity, a snippet of your conversation may be recorded and temporarily stored for review and validation by our community team.
 
If you do not consent to the processing of your data for this purpose, you can always continue to play ARC RAIDERS with Voice Chat, and Proximity Chat, disabled. You can withdraw your consent at any time in the settings.
 
Learn more about Voice Moderation in ARC RAIDERS in our [FAQ](https://id.embark.games/arc-raiders/support/faq/130-voice-chat-moderation) and see our [Privacy Policy.](https://id.embark.games/arc-raiders/support/faq/128-privacy-policy)
ST_VOIP.ID_VOIP_MIC_TEST_DESCRIPTION:
We'll play your voice back to you. 

If the indicator bar fills up, your microphone works correctly.

You can't communicate with other Raiders while doing the test.
ST_VOIP.ID_VOIP_MODERATION_SANCTION_TEMP: You have been banned from speaking on voice chat for {0} {0}|plural(one=hour, few=hours, many=hours, other=hours).
ST_VOIP.ID_VOIP_MODERATION_SANCTION_PERMANENT: You have been permanently banned from speaking on voice chat.
